articles.title: Trump: 'ICC di luar kendali, tidak bisa masuk dan menangkap kepala dewan'
articles.description: Trump: 'ICC di luar kendali, tidak bisa masuk dan menangkap kepala negara' Presiden AS Donald Trump mengatakan Pengadilan Pidana Internasional adalah "di luar kendali", sambil mengklaim Cina "setuju untuk pertama kalinya untuk mengutuk pelanggaran dan melampaui" pengadilan, laporan AFP. Trump, saat kembali dari pertemuan dengan Xi Jinping dan Vladimir Putin dari Rusia, mengeluh bahwa ICC percaya "mereka bisa masuk dan menangkap para kepala negara, dan mereka tidak bisa melakukan itu. Mereka bisa melakukannya tanpa alasan -- jadi kita mengutuk itu sebagai kelompok". Washington telah bersumpah untuk membongkar pengadilan, yang ditargetkan dengan sanksi baru bulan lalu. Trump telah marah dengan pergerakan pengadilan untuk mengeluarkan surat penangkapan untuk Perdana Menteri Israel Benjamin Netanyahu atas pembantaian Gaza. Washington telah bersumpah untuk membongkar pengadilan, yang ditargetkan dengan sanksi baru bulan lalu. (AFP)
articles.originalTitle: Trump: 'ICC out of control, can't go in and arrest heads of countries'
articles.originalDescription: Trump: 'ICC out of control, can't go in and arrest heads of countries' US President Donald Trump has said the International Criminal Court was "out of control", while claiming China "agreed for the first time to condemn the abuses and overreach" of the court, AFP reported. Trump, on his return from a summit with China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin, complained that the ICC believes "they can go in and arrest the heads of countries, and they can't do that. They can do it for no reason -- so we condemned that as a group." Washington has vowed to dismantle the court, which it targeted with new sanctions last month. Trump has been angered by the tribunal's move to issue an arrest warrant for Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over Gaza genocide. Washington has vowed to dismantle the court, which it targeted with new sanctions last month. (AFP)

articles.title: Enam orang Palestina tewas dalam serangan Israel di Gaza, pertahanan sipil mengatakan
articles.description: Enam orang Palestina tewas dalam serangan Israel di Gaza, pertahanan sipil mengatakan Israel menyerang enam orang di Jalur Gaza pada hari Jumat, lembaga pertahanan sipil di medan perang hancur wilayah mengatakan AFP, meskipun gencatan senjata. Mahmoud Bassal, juru bicara lembaga pertahanan sipil Gaza, mengatakan bahwa empat orang Palestina tewas dan beberapa lainnya terluka dalam serangan udara Israel barat daya kamp pengungsi Bureij di pusat Jalur Gaza pada hari Jumat. Pertahanan sipil juga mengatakan satu Palestina tewas dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak Israel menargetkan sebuah tenda di kamp Al- Munasara untuk pengungsi orang di Deir Al- Balah. Orang lain tewas dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak utara kamp pengungsi Nuseyat, juga di Jalur Gaza Tengah. Militer Israel mengatakan kepada AFP itu telah "ditargetkan beberapa koperasi militer" dalam beberapa serangan, yang datang sehari setelah tentara mengatakan telah menyelesaikan serangan tanah di Jalur Gaza pusat. Lebih dari 1.600 warga Palestina telah terbunuh sejak dimulainya gencatan senjata, menurut perhitungan AFP berdasarkan data dari Departemen Kesehatan Gaza yang jumlahnya dianggap dapat diandalkan oleh PBB. Laporan oleh AFP
articles.originalTitle: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza, civil defence says
articles.originalDescription: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza, civil defence says Israeli strikes killed six people in the Gaza Strip on Friday, the civil defence agency in the war-shattered territory told AFP, despite a ceasefire. Mahmoud Bassal, the spokesman for Gaza's civil defence agency, said that four Palestinians were killed and several others wounded in an Israeli airstrike southwest of Bureij refugee camp in the central Gaza Strip on Friday. The civil defence also said one Palestinian was killed in an Israeli drone strike targeting a tent in the Al-Munasara camp for displaced people in Deir al-Balah. Another person was killed in a drone strike north of Nuseirat refugee camp, also in the central Gaza Strip. The Israeli military told AFP it had "targeted multiple military operatives" in several strikes, which came a day after the army said it had completed a ground incursion in the central Gaza Strip. More than 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the start of the ceasefire, according to an AFP tally based on data from the Gaza health ministry whose figures are considered reliable by the United Nations. Report by AFP

articles.description: Ledakan keras terdengar di Riyadh setelah pertahanan sipil Saudi memperingatkan ledakan keras terdengar di ibukota Saudi Riyadh jam pada hari Jumat, saksi mengatakan Reuters, segera setelah pertahanan sipil kerajaan mengeluarkan peringatan bahaya potensial di kota. Pertahanan sipil mengirim pesan kedua segera setelah itu mengatakan bahaya telah berlalu. Penyebab ledakan itu tidak segera jelas. Itu adalah peringatan pertama seperti di Riyadh sejak serangan Houthi menghantam gedung pencakar langit tertinggi pada hari Kamis. Sebelumnya, pertahanan sipil mengeluarkan peringatan serupa untuk pemerintah Sulayyil, di Arab Saudi pusat, sebelum kemudian mengatakan bahaya yang ada juga berlalu.
articles.originalTitle: Loud explosion heard in Riyadh after Saudi civil defence alerts
articles.originalDescription: Loud explosion heard in Riyadh after Saudi civil defence alerts A loud boom was heard in the Saudi capital Riyadh late hours on Friday, a witness told Reuters, shortly after the kingdom’s civil defence issued an alert warning of potential danger in the city. The civil defence sent a second message soon afterwards saying the danger had passed. The cause of the boom was not immediately clear. It was the first such alert in Riyadh since a Houthi attack struck the capital’s tallest skyscraper on Thursday. Earlier, the civil defence issued a similar alert for al-Sulayyil governorate, in central Saudi Arabia, before later saying the danger there had also passed.

articles.originalTitle: Inside the Iraqi Kurdish city caught between the US and Iran
articles.originalDescription: Inside the Iraqi Kurdish city caught between the US and Iran Submitted by Sean Mathews on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 19:37 Sulaymaniyah is reeling from the economic toll of the Iran war and grappling with an emboldened regional power next door A market in the city of Sulaymaniyah in Iraq's Kurdistan Region is said to be the largest bazaar in the region, on 11 November 2026 (Sean Mathews/MEE) Off If US President Donald Trump has his way, Baran* will be out of business. The thirty-year-old Kurd is a trader who buys diesel in Iraq and sells it in Afghanistan. It’s a stressful gig, but one that can generate a tidy profit in a place like Iraqi Kurdistan. A truck laden with $20,000 worth of diesel in Iraq can sell in Kabul for around $24,000, leaving around $2,000 for the trader once expenses are paid. But it has to make it through Iran first. “The journey is more dangerous now. It’s harder to find drivers. The border isn’t as reliable. The price of diesel has also shot up,” Baran, whose name has been changed to protect his identity, told Middle East Eye. Trump says instead of restarting strikes on Iran, he wants to choke its economy. In addition to a naval blockade, the US is pressing countries like Turkey , Iraq and Pakistan to seal their borders with Iran. Earlier this month, the US announced a task force to blockade trade across Iran’s land borders and the Caspian Sea. Baran has no political beef with the US. On the contrary, he says, “George W. Bush overthrew Saddam Hussein. He helped Kurdistan. I don’t prefer Iran to the US,” he said over a glass of anise-flavoured Arak and hookahs at a restaurant in Sulaymaniyah. “But this war has not been good for business or our economy.” Baran is a microcosm of the city he calls home. Sulaymaniyah Nestled in the Zagros Mountains, Sulaymaniyah is Iraqi Kurdistan’s second largest city. articles.title: Pembalasan atas serangan koalisi terhadap pembangkit listrik Saudi.
articles.description: Pembalasan atas serangan koalisi terhadap pembangkit listrik Saudi dan pelabuhan Yemen pada hari Jumat mengatakan bahwa mereka telah menyerang pembangkit listrik di Arab Saudi Al- Shuqaiq dan pelabuhan Jizan, dalam menanggapi Saudi-dipimpin koalisi menyerang Yaman. "Dengan bantuan Tuhan, angkatan bersenjata kami melakukan operasi militer presisi menargetkan pembangkit listrik Al- Shuqaiq dan Pelabuhan Jizan. Serangan itu akurat dan langsung, menyebabkan kerusakan parah," Juru bicara militer Houthi Yahya Saree mengatakan pada X Saree bilang serangan itu merupakan respon atas serangan koalisi terhadap pembangkit listrik Saada dan Mokha, dan pada salah satu badai di pelabuhan Hodeidah lebih awal pada hari itu. "Kami meyakinkan musuh Saudi bahwa setiap serangan di Port of Hodeidah atau stasiun daya akan bertemu dengan respon langsung menargetkan pelabuhan dan stasiun listrik", katanya. Pada hari Jumat, koalisi meluncurkan apa yang disebut "operasi khusus", menyerang Hodeidah juga target di Sanaa, Saada dan Taiz. Houthis mengatakan serangan menewaskan 41 orang dalam 24 jam terakhir.
articles.originalTitle: Houthis retaliate for coalition strikes with attack on Saudi power station and port
articles.originalDescription: Houthis retaliate for coalition strikes with attack on Saudi power station and port Yemen’s Houthis said on Friday that they had attacked a power station in Saudi Arabia’s Al-Shuqaiq and the port of Jizan, in response to Saudi-led coalition strikes on Yemen. “With God’s help, our armed forces carried out a precision military operation targeting the Al-Shuqaiq power station and the Port of Jizan. The strikes were accurate and direct, causing extensive damage,” Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said on X. Saree said the attack was a response to coalition strikes on the Saada and Mokha power stations, and on one of the quays at Hodeidah port earlier in the day. “We assure the Saudi enemy that any attack on the Port of Hodeidah or power stations will be met with an immediate response targeting its ports and power stations,” he wrote. On Friday, the coalition launched what it called a “special operation”, striking Hodeidah as well as targets in Sanaa, Saada and Taiz. The Houthis said strikes killed 41 people in the past 24 hours.

articles.title: Houthis mengatakan 41 tewas sebagai Saudi- dipimpin koalisi meluncurkan 'operasi khusus' di Yaman
articles.description: Houthis mengatakan 41 tewas sebagai Saudi- dipimpin koalisi meluncurkan 'operasi khusus' di Yaman Saudi- dipimpin koalisi serangan di Yaman menewaskan 41 orang dalam 24 jam terakhir, Houthis mengatakan pada hari Jumat, setelah koalisi menyerang kota pelabuhan Laut Merah Hodeidah dan target lainnya dalam apa yang disebut "operasi khusus". Koalisi mengatakan hal itu memukul penyelundupan dan senjata-transportasi operasi di Hodeidah sementara juga melaksanakan serangan di Sanaa, Saada dan Taiz mengatur. Sementara itu, Houthis telah bersumpah untuk menyerang Jeddah dan pelabuhan Laut Merah Saudi lainnya jika Hodeidah diserang, sementara peringatan penerbangan bahwa udara Saudi "tidak aman". Mereka juga mengancam distrik keuangan Riyadh dan pembangkit listrik di Al- Shuqaiq. "Kami menargetkan kemampuan operasional di pelabuhan Hodeidah yang digunakan dalam operasi penyelundupan dan pengiriman senjata dan rudal balistik", Juru bicara Koalisi Saudi Turki al- Malki diposting di X Koalisi menyerang "target militer" di Sanaa, termasuk fasilitas rudal dan drone dan depot pasokan, ia menambahkan. Dua rudal balistik dicegat selama daerah Jizan dekat perbatasan Yaman, ia diposting kemudian, dengan puing-puing jatuh di Al- Shuqaiq. The Houthis 'Al- Masirah siaran televisi gambar dari pembangkit listrik rusak di Mokha setelah serangan udara koalisi. HANYA DI: Arab Saudi telah melanda pelabuhan Hodeidah Yaman, menjadi negara ketiga untuk menyerang pelabuhan strategis setelah Amerika Serikat dan Israel. articles.originalTitle: Houthis say 41 killed as Saudi-led coalition launches 'special operation' in Yemen
articles.originalDescription: Houthis say 41 killed as Saudi-led coalition launches 'special operation' in Yemen Saudi-led coalition strikes on Yemen killed 41 people in the past 24 hours, the Houthis said on Friday, after the coalition attacked the Red Sea port city of Hodeidah and other targets in what it called a “special operation”. The coalition said it hit smuggling and weapons-transporting operations in Hodeidah while also carrying out attacks in Sanaa, Saada and Taiz governorates. Meanwhile, Houthis had vowed to hit Jeddah and other Saudi Red Sea ports if Hodeidah was attacked, while warning airlines that Saudi airspace was “unsafe”. They also threatened Riyadh’s financial district and a power station in Al-Shuqaiq. “We targeted operational capabilities at Hodeidah port that were used in smuggling operations and the transport of weapons and ballistic missiles,” Saudi coalition spokesman Turki al-Malki posted on X. The coalition hit “military targets” in Sanaa, including missile and drone facilities and a supply depot, he added. Two ballistic missiles were intercepted over the Jizan region near the Yemen border, he posted later, with debris falling in Al-Shuqaiq. The Houthis’ Al-Masirah television broadcast images of a damaged power station in Mokha after a coalition air raid. JUST IN: Saudi Arabia has struck Yemen's Hodeidah port, becoming the third country to attack the strategic port after the United States and Israel. In response Ansarallah warned that Jeddah, Jizan and Yanbu ports, along with Riyadh's financial district, would be targeted. https://t.co/lHCVGpfkxf — Current Report (@Currentreport1) November 20, 2026

articles.title: Fergie Chambers dirilis di Spanyol sebagai AS mengakui kesalahan terjemahan pengadilan
articles.description: Fergie Chambers dibebaskan di Spanyol karena AS mengakui kesalahan terjemahan pengadilan yang diikuti oleh Amandla Thomas- Johnson di Fri, 11 / 20 / 2026 - 15: 53 pro- Palestina aktivis Amerika 'senang untuk menghirup udara segar' berikut pembebasan bersyarat dari penjara sementara ia memerangi permintaan ekstradisi AS Fergie Chambers di luar Aranjuez penjara berikut pembebasannya pada hari Jumat, 20 November 2026 (Reuters) Off Fergie Chambers, donor provinsi-Palestina yang ditahan di Spanyol mengikuti permohonan ekstradisi, yang diberikan pada Jumat tersebut. Berbicara di luar penjara Aranjuez pada hari Jumat setelah pembebasannya, Chambers menjelaskan tuduhan terhadap dirinya sebagai "tidak berdasar" dan mengatakan dia berharap pembebasannya adalah "langkah pertama dalam proses mengakui bahwa internasional". "Saya pikir kasus ini penting untuk hak asasi manusia, untuk orang-orang yang ingin berbicara di mana saja di dunia", katanya. Keputusan dari Ruang Kriminal Pengadilan Nasional Spanyol, dikenal sebagai Audiencia Nacional, datang setelah Chambers telah menghabiskan lebih dari empat bulan dalam tahanan sejak penahanannya di Ibiza pada bulan Juli. Dalam kuasanya, dilihat oleh Mata Timur Tengah, pengadilan mengatakan kesalahan dalam terjemahan dokumen yang diajukan oleh pihak berwenang AS telah menimbulkan keraguan pada keandalan permintaan ekstradisi dan melemahkan dasarnya. Para hakim menemukan bahwa pembangunan tampaknya mengurangi risiko dari melarikan diri Chambers dan berarti bahwa nya lanjutan penahanan tidak bisa lagi dibenarkan. articles.originalTitle: Fergie Chambers released in Spain as US admits court translation errors
articles.originalDescription: Fergie Chambers released in Spain as US admits court translation errors Submitted by Amandla Thomas-Johnson on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 15:53 American pro-Palestinian activist is 'happy to breathe fresh air' following conditional release from prison as he fights US extradition request Fergie Chambers outside Aranjuez prison following his release on Friday, 20 November 2026 (Reuters) Off Fergie Chambers, the American pro-Palestinian donor detained in Spain following a US extradition request, was granted provisional release on Friday after the Trump administration admitted to “substantial” translation errors in court documents submitted in support of its case. Speaking outside Aranjuez prison on Friday following his release, Chambers described the charges against him as “baseless” and said he hoped his release was “the first step in a process of recognising that internationally”. “I think this case is important for human rights, for people who want to speak out anywhere in the world,” he said. The decision by the Criminal Chamber of Spain's National Court, known as the Audiencia Nacional, comes after Chambers had spent more than four months in custody since his arrest in Ibiza in July. In its ruling, seen by Middle East Eye, the court said errors in the translation of documents submitted by US authorities had cast doubt on the reliability of the extradition request and weakened its basis. The judges found that the development appeared to reduce the risk of Chambers fleeing and meant that his continued detention could no longer be justified. His release is subject to several conditions, including weekly appearances before the court nearest his residence every Monday, surrendering his passport, a prohibition on leaving Spain and an obligation to appear before the court whenever summoned. articles.title: Kesepakatan konsep Cop31 'terburuk yang pernah ada', kampanye memperingatkan
articles.description: Kesepakatan konsep Cop31 'yang terburuk yang pernah ada', para kampanye memperingatkan Diberikan oleh Katherine Hearst pada Fri, 11 / 20 / 2026 - 14: 55 Sebuah konsep kedua dari teks kunci merangkum pembicaraan iklim telah mereferensikan sebuah fase dari bahan bakar fosil yang telah dihapus sementara yang berpusat pada teknologi penangkapan karbon Cop31 konferensi iklim diadakan di Antalya Expo Centre di Turki (AFP) dari kampanye keadilan iklim telah memukul keluar pada hasil rancangan pembicaraan iklim global, menggambarkannya sebagai "terburuk" dalam sejarah konferensi tersebut. Perjanjian draft, yang menguraikan komitmen kunci dari konferensi iklim Cop31 di Turki, telah dilucuti dari semua referensi mengenai fase- dari bahan bakar fosil, tetapi didukung "mempercepat penangkapan karbon, utilisasi dan penyimpanan", dimana aktor masyarakat sipil telah dicemooh sebagai "solusi palsu" untuk kerusakan iklim. "Bahasa yang jauh lebih lemah di seluruh front, dan secara keseluruhan, ketika kita melihatnya, agresif, pelacakan balik, dan tidak akan membantu negara-negara berkembang", Harjeet Singh, penasihat strategis ke Fuel Fosil Treatty Initiative, kata Mata Timur Tengah. "Sebaliknya, itu akan membantu sektor swasta, industri bahan bakar fosil, dan itu bukan apa yang kita datang ke sini untuk," kata Singh. "Keputusan penutup" adalah teks overarching yang merangkum hasil negosiasi yang berbeda, berisi janji janji yang dimaksudkan untuk memenuhi tujuan Perjanjian Paris. Sebuah draft awal yang muncul pada hari Senin sangat diedit, dengan banyak komitmen utama, termasuk transisi jauh dari bahan bakar fosil dan target $120bn untuk keuangan untuk membantu negara-negara berkembang beradaptasi dengan krisis iklim, dilucuti. Secara radikal, teks substitusi terbaru komitmen untuk "transisi jauh dari bahan bakar fosil" untuk janji untuk "transisi global tidak dapat dikembalikan menuju emisi gas rumah kaca rendah dan daya tahan iklim". Draft baru ini juga pusat kontroversial teknolog
articles.originalTitle: Cop31 draft agreement ‘the worst ever', campaigners warn
articles.originalDescription: Cop31 draft agreement ‘the worst ever', campaigners warn Submitted by Katherine Hearst on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 14:55 A second draft of the key text summarising the climate talks had references to a phase out of fossil fuels removed while centring carbon capture technologies The Cop31 climate conference is being held at the Antalya Expo Centre in Turkey (AFP) Off Climate justice campaigners have hit out at the draft outcome of the global climate talks, describing it as the “worst” in the conference’s history. The draft agreement, which outlines the key commitments of the Cop31 climate summit in Turkey, was stripped of all references to a phase-out of fossil fuels, but backed “accelerating carbon capture, utilisation and storage”, which civil society actors have derided as a “false solution” to climate breakdown. “It's much weaker language across all fronts, and overall, when we look at it, it’s aggressive, it is backtracking, and it's not going to help developing countries," Harjeet Singh, strategic adviser to the Fossil Fuel Treaty Initiative, told Middle East Eye. "Rather, it is going to help the private sector, fossil fuel industry, and that is not what we came here for,” Singh said. The “cover decision” is an overarching text which summarises the different negotiation outcomes, containing pledges intended to meet the goals of the Paris Agreement. An initial draft which appeared on Monday was heavily edited, with many of the main commitments, including a transition away from fossil fuels and a $120bn target for finance to help developing countries adapt to the climate crisis, stripped out. Crucially, the latest text substitutes a commitment to “transition away from fossil fuels” for a pledge to “irreversible global transition towards low greenhouse gas emissions and climate resilience”. The new draft also centres controversial carbon capture technologies, pledging to increase them 20- to 40-fold by 2035. Cop31: Turkey signs $5.1bn loan deals to boost green transition

articles.originalTitle: Palestinian and Israeli films present different shades of reality amid genocide
articles.originalDescription: Palestinian and Israeli films present different shades of reality amid genocide Submitted by Joseph Fahim on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 09:59 Hosam Abu Dan's Thirteen in Gaza and Ahmed Hassouna's Citizen Osama were filmed amid destruction Thirteen in Gaza is an exploration of the moral rot that affects a society undergoing genocide (Toronto International Film Festival) Off A year after the so-called ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas in October 2025, Palestinian and Israeli cinemas have been scrambling to capture a volatile reality shaped by questions more complex than those that emerged in the immediate aftermath of 7 October. Maintaining one’s dignity while surviving a sadistically dehumanising campaign targeting civilians was the central preoccupation of the handful of films about Gaza released between 2024 and early 2026. The 2026 autumn season, however, offers a different set of inquiries: the deeply asymmetrical power dynamics between the Israeli aggressor and the Palestinians ; the viability of what has now become the wistful dream of a two-state solution; the lingering ache for a lost, irretrievable homeland; and the newly exposed, unflattering realities of Gaza’s informal economy. As the colossal success of NAZA has made evident, Gaza will continue to dominate cinema's narrative on Palestine for the foreseeable future. Yet, as this fall's crop of films suggests, new dimensions will gradually come into focus as Palestinian filmmakers continue to grapple with uncertain terrain post-7 October. Israeli cinema, meanwhile, will remain divided, caught between the pressure exerted by jingoist political leaders desperate to give their country a PR facelift and the competing impulse of leftist filmmakers seeking to restore the diminished international standing of a national cinema whose motivations can only be assessed on a case-by-case basis. articles.description: Ekslusif: dokter Inggris yang dituduh antisemitisme mencari tindakan hukum terhadap regulator atas kebocoran data pribadi Diberikan oleh Amara Sophia Elahi pada Fri, 11 / 20 / 2026 - 14: 08 Para dokter mengeluhkan keamanan mereka setelah Majelis Medis Umum membocorkan data kepada para pekerja kesehatan Pro-Palestina yang berkumpul di alun-alun Parlemen London dengan solidaritas-solidaritas para pekerja medis yang mengalami suspensi melalui pos media sosial, pada tanggal 15 Oktober 2025 (Vuk Valcic / ZUMA Press Wire / Reuters) Off Doctors di Inggris yang telah disebut sebagai Dewan Medis Umum (GMC) untuk dugaan antisemitim dan Islamo (Islamo) mempertimbangkan tindakan yang legal di koran tersebut telah menerbitkan surat kabar sakit tersebut. Kebocoran terjadi setelah Permintaan Kebebasan Informasi yang diajukan oleh Times ke GMC, yang meminta untuk jumlah dokter yang telah mengeluh tentang, diselidiki dan disetujui untuk antisemitisme dan Islammophobia sejak Oktober 2023. Dalam responnya, GMC berbagi nomor referensi 223 dokter, yang memungkinkan mereka untuk diidentifikasi melalui publikasi regulator yang menghadap basis data. GMC juga termasuk rincian etnis dokter, di bawah hukum Inggris adalah karakteristik yang dilindungi. Dalam sebuah surat yang dikirim kepada kelompok dokter minggu ini, Claire Light, kepala kesetaraan GMC, keragaman dan penyertaan, menyatakan bahwa data internal telah dibagikan kepada The Times "dalam kesalahan, dan regulator secara resmi meminta melalui pengacara mereka bahwa surat kabar menghapus data rahasia dan tidak menyebarkannya. articles.originalDescription: Exclusive: UK doctors accused of antisemitism seek legal action against regulator over personal data leak Submitted by Amara Sophia Elahi on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 14:08 Doctors complained about over pro-Palestine posts fear for their safety after General Medical Council leaked data to national newspaper Pro-Palestine healthcare workers and protesters gather in London’s Parliament Square in solidarity with medical workers facing suspension over social media posts, on 15 October 2025 (Vuk Valcic/ZUMA Press Wire/Reuters) Off Doctors in the UK who have been referred to the General Medical Council (GMC) for alleged antisemitism and Islamophobia are considering legal action after the regulator leaked sensitive data about them to The Times newspaper, Middle East Eye has learned. The leak occurred following a Freedom of Information request submitted by the Times to the GMC, which asked for the number of doctors who had been complained about, investigated and sanctioned for antisemitism and Islamophobia since October 2023. In its response, the GMC shared the reference numbers of 223 doctors, which allows them to be identified through the regulator’s public-facing database. The GMC also included details of doctors’ ethnicities, which under UK law is a protected characteristic. In a letter sent to doctors' groups this week, Claire Light, the GMC’s head of equality, diversity and inclusion, stated that internal data had been shared with The Times “in error”, and that the regulator had formally requested through their lawyers that the newspaper deletes the confidential data and does not disseminate it. The Times has told the GMC that it will not publish the information but will retain it. The regulator was forced to contact doctors affected to apologise for the disclosure. Some doctors were not previously aware of complaints about them, because the evidence did not meet the threshold for initiating an investigation. articles.originalTitle: Coalition launches major military operation to neutralize Houthi threats against Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Joint Forces Command of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen launched on Friday a military operation to neutralize sources of threat used by the Houthi terrorist militia to target civilians in Saudi Arabia and Yemen, including vital facilities supporting its military activities.The coalition said the operation targeted Houthi military capabilities and infrastructure involved in weapons smuggling and transportation, adding that operations were continuing against military targets in the governorates of Sanaa, Saada and Taiz.The coalition announced the destruction of seven legitimate military targets that had been designated for military use and supporting the Houthis’ military activities.It also confirmed the destruction of six workshops used by the militia to support its military capabilities.The coalition said its operations in Sanaa focused on destroying and neutralizing sources of threat to prevent attacks against civilians in Saudi Arabia and Yemen.It also announced the neutralization of one of the Houthi terrorist militia’s main supply facilities in Sanaa.The Joint Forces Command had earlier called on civilians to evacuate the port of Hodeidah in accordance with an accompanying map to ensure their safety.

Dalam sebuah pernyataan bersama, menteri-menteri asing dari negara-negara besar termasuk Mesir, Arab Saudi, Pakistan, Turki, Qatar, Uni Arab Emirat dan Aljazair mengatakan sanksi tersebut datang "sebagai respon atas aktivitas pemukiman ilegal Israel di wilayah Palestina yang telah diduduki, termasuk mengukur yang melibatkan perusahaan yang terlibat dalam pembangunan pemukiman". articles.originalTitle: Sixteen countries back sanctions targeting Israel’s illegal settlement expansion
articles.originalDescription: Sixteen countries back sanctions targeting Israel’s illegal settlement expansion Submitted by Elis Gjevori on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 12:14 Joint statement welcomes measures against settlement firms and an Israeli settler group blocking humanitarian aid to Gaza Israeli settlers who want to occupy Gaza in a field outside Kibbutz Nir-Am by the Israel-Gaza boundary on 27 September 2026 (Ilia Yefimovich/AFP) Off Sixteen Muslim-majority countries have welcomed decisions by the UK and Australia to impose sanctions over Israel’s illegal settlement activities in occupied Palestine . In a joint statement , foreign ministers from major countries including Egypt , Saudi Arabia , Pakistan , Turkey , Qatar , the United Arab Emirates and Algeria said the sanctions came "in response to illegal Israeli settlement activities in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including measures targeting companies involved in settlement construction". They also welcomed the UK’s decision to sanction an organisation obstructing humanitarian aid deliveries to Gaza . UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announced the sanctions on Tuesday, shortly before the Israeli government was scheduled to allocate tenders for the E1 settlement bloc, which would effectively split the occupied West Bank in two. Hours after the announcement, Israel postponed the issuing of tenders for construction in the E1 settlement in the West Bank until a new government is formed. Israeli officials insisted the decision was not in response to the sanctions. The sanctions target eight Israeli construction, property development and architectural firms. The UK also sanctioned Tsav9, an Israeli group involved in blocking aid deliveries into Gaza . The United States sanctioned the group in 2024. articles.originalDescription: Israeli experts warn Myanmar genocide ruling could strengthen Gaza case at ICJ Submitted by Nadav Rapaport on Fri, 11/20/2026 - 12:48 Israeli officials and legal experts fear the International Court of Justice's landmark ruling could influence its eventual judgment on South Africa's genocide case against Israel Displaced Palestinians living in tents set up among the rubble of their destroyed homes in Jabalia, northern Gaza Strip (Salah Hashem/ZUMA Press Wire via Reuters) Off Thursday's landmark ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ), holding Myanmar responsible for genocide against its Rohingya minority, has raised alarm among Israeli officials and legal experts over its potential implications for the genocide case against Israel over Gaza. "This is a dangerous precedent," a senior Israeli official told Ynet , referring to the ruling, which marked the first time the ICJ had found a state responsible for committing genocide. "This sets parameters and standards that, admittedly, you can't apply one-to-one to Israel, but it opens the door," the official added. While Israel's case in Gaza is "more complicated", the ruling "certainly doesn't do us any good". Another Israeli official told the public broadcaster Kan 11 that the decision reflected "worrying trends" at the top UN court, but insisted Israel could avoid a similar ruling in the case brought by South Africa in December 2023. The official said Israel could withstand "any legal test", insisting that "we did not commit a genocide". articles.title: ZATCA foils enam upaya menyelundupkan lebih dari 2,3 juta pil amfetamin melalui Duba Port
articles.description: RIYADH - otoritas adat Saudi di Duba Port telah menggagalkan enam upaya menyelundupkan lebih dari 2.3 juta pil amfetamin tersembunyi dalam pengiriman tiba di Kingdom melalui pelabuhan. Hamoud Al- Harbi, juru bicara untuk badan amal, pajak dan Bea Cukai (ZATCA), mengatakan enam truk tiba di Kerajaan melalui Duba Port membawa pengiriman batu bata beton. Narkotika ditemukan tersembunyi di dalam rongga berongga batu bata selama pemeriksaan bea cukai menggunakan teknologi keamanan canggih dan anjing deteksi. Al- Harbi mengatakan bahwa setelah kejang, otoritas berkoordinasi dengan Direktorat Umum Kontrol Narkotika (GDNC) untuk menangkap penerima yang dimaksud dari narkotika di dalam Kerajaan, menghasilkan penahanannya. Dia menegaskan kembali komitmen ZATCA untuk memperketat bea cukai atas impor dan ekspor Kingdom di semua pelabuhan bea cukai dan memerangi upaya penyelundupan. Al- Harbi menekankan bahwa upaya ini sejalan dengan salah satu tujuan strategis otoritas dari meningkatkan keamanan dan melindungi masyarakat dengan mencegah penyelundupan narkotika dan zat terlarang lainnya. Dia menambahkan bahwa otoritas terus melaksanakan tugasnya dalam koordinasi dekat dan kerjasama dengan mitra di Kementerian Dalam Negeri dan Direktorat Umum Kontrol Narkotika.
articles.originalTitle: ZATCA foils six attempts to smuggle over 2.3 million amphetamine pills through Duba Port
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi customs authorities at Duba Port have foiled six attempts to smuggle more than 2.3 million amphetamine pills concealed in shipments arriving in the Kingdom through the port.Hamoud Al-Harbi, spokesperson for the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA), said six trucks arrived in the Kingdom through Duba Port carrying shipments of concrete bricks.The narcotics were discovered concealed inside the hollow cavities of the bricks during customs inspections using advanced security technologies and detection dogs.Al-Harbi said that following the seizures, the authority coordinated with the General Directorate of Narcotics Control (GDNC) to apprehend the intended recipient of the narcotics inside the Kingdom, resulting in his arrest.He reaffirmed ZATCA's commitment to tightening customs controls over the Kingdom's imports and exports across all customs ports and combating smuggling attempts.Al-Harbi emphasized that these efforts are in line with one of the authority's key strategic objectives of enhancing security and protecting society by preventing the smuggling of narcotics and other prohibited substances.He added that the authority continues to carry out its duties in close coordination and cooperation with its partners at the Ministry of Interior and the General Directorate of Narcotics Control.

articles.title: Pasukan Israel menahan tahanan yang baru-baru ini dibebaskan dalam penggerebekan Bank Barat
articles.description: Pasukan Israel menahan tahanan baru-baru ini di serangan Bank Barat pasukan Israel telah menyerbu rumah-rumah dan menangkap beberapa warga Palestina, termasuk baru-baru ini membebaskan tahanan, di seluruh Tepi Barat yang diduduki, menurut agen berita Palestina Wafa. Saat fajar, tentara menangkap Muadh Nader Sawafta, 23, di desa Tubas, dan Naji Ibrahim Bisharat, 50, di kota terdekat Tammun, selatan Tubas. Kamal Bani Odeh, direktur Lembaga Tahanan Palestina di Tubas, mengatakan bahwa Sawafta telah dibebaskan dari penahanan Israel dua bulan lalu. Pasukan Israel telah menahan 20 orang muda dari dua desa pada malam sebelumnya, kebanyakan dari mereka dari Tubas, sebelum melepaskan mereka, laporan mengatakan. Dalam serangan terpisah pada hari Jumat, pasukan Israel menangkap tiga orang Palestina di Qarawa Bani Hassan, barat daya Nablus. Salah satunya adalah mantan tahanan yang dibebaskan hanya dua hari sebelumnya setelah menghabiskan dua tahun di penjara Israel, menurut Wafa. Sebelumnya pada hari Jumat, tentara menyerbu rumah-rumah di lingkungan Iktaba, timur Tulkarem, dan menangkap tiga orang Palestina. Sumber lokal mengidentifikasi salah satu dari mereka sebagai Jihad-Qazli, mantan tahanan dari kamp pengungsi Nur Shams. Pasukan Israel mengusir pemilik tanah Palestina dan aktivis Israel mencoba menanam pohon zaitun di Idna, utara Hebron, menduduki Tepi Barat, 18 November 2026 (Hazem Bader / AFP)
articles.originalTitle: Israeli forces detain recently released prisoners in West Bank raids
articles.originalDescription: Israeli forces detain recently released prisoners in West Bank raids Israeli forces have raided homes and arrested several Palestinians, including recently released prisoners, across the occupied West Bank, according to the Palestinian news agency Wafa. At dawn, soldiers arrested Muadh Nader Sawafta, 23, in the village of Tubas, and Naji Ibrahim Bisharat, 50, in the nearby town of Tammun, south of Tubas. Kamal Bani Odeh, director of the Palestinian Prisoners Society in Tubas, said that Sawafta had been released from Israeli detention two months ago. Israeli forces had detained 20 young men from the two villages the previous night, most of them from Tubas, before releasing them, the report said. In a separate raid on Friday, Israeli forces arrested three Palestinians in Qarawa Bani Hassan, southwest of Nablus. One of them was a former prisoner who had been released just two days earlier after spending two years in Israeli prisons, according to Wafa. Earlier on Friday, soldiers raided homes in the Iktaba neighbourhood, east of Tulkarem, and arrested three Palestinians. Local sources identified one of them as Jihad al-Qazli, a former prisoner from Nur Shams refugee camp. Israeli forces drive away Palestinian landowners and Israeli activists attempting to plant olive trees in Idna, north of Hebron, occupied West Bank, 18 November 2026 (Hazem Bader/AFP)

articles.title: Jepang berencana menawarkan Arab Saudi 16 juta barel penyimpanan minyak tambahan, membeli hingga 8 juta barel
articles.description: RIYADH - Jepang bermaksud untuk menyediakan Arab Saudi dengan tambahan 16 juta barel kapasitas penyimpanan minyak mentah dan membeli hingga 8 juta barel Saudi mentah untuk cadangan nasional, Saudi Pers Agency melaporkan pada hari Jumat. Pengumuman ini datang setelah pertemuan virtual antara Menteri Energi Saudi dan Menteri Industri dan Mineral Resource Prince Abdullah bin Salman dan Menteri Ekonomi Jepang, Perdagangan dan Industri Ryoseti Akazawa pada Nov 9, 2026. Selama pertemuan, dua menteri menegaskan kembali kemitraan strategis yang kuat dan berlangsung lama antara Arab Saudi dan Jepang dan mendiskusikan cara untuk memperkuat kerjasama bilateral, terutama di sektor energi. Setelah diskusi dalam satuan tugas gabungan didirikan pada Mei 2026, Arab Saudi menegaskan kembali bahwa hal itu menyangkut Jepang sebagai mitra strategis dan menempel sangat penting untuk mendukung jangka panjang energi keamanan melalui stabil dan dapat diandalkan pasokan minyak mentah. Jepang menyatakan apresiasi yang mendalam kepada Arab Saudi untuk penyediaan yang stabil dan dapat diandalkan pasokan minyak mentah. Kerajaan sudah mulai mengisi ulang minyaknya di Jepang. Mengenali pentingnya lama dari Proyek Penimbunan Minyak Kaus Gabungan, didirikan pada tahun 2010, dan yang baru-baru ini menunjukkan efektivitas, Jepang bermaksud untuk membuat tambahan 16 juta barel kapasitas minyak mentah tersedia ke Arab Saudi untuk jangka waktu terbatas melalui fasilitas penimbunan nasional. Kapasitas tambahan akan membawa total kapasitas penyimpanan yang tersedia untuk Kerajaan di bawah pengaturan untuk 24 juta barel, termasuk kapasitas yang ada 8 juta barel. Jepang juga berniat untuk membeli hingga 8 juta barel minyak mentah Saudi untuk cadangan stockpile nasional, subjek kondisi pasar yang menguntungkan dan penyelesaian prosedur internal yang diperlukan. Kedua negara ini juga akan bekerja sama di bawah inisiatif "POWERR Asia" Jepang untuk meningkatkan keamanan energi di seluruh Asia, membangun Program
articles.originalTitle: Japan plans to offer Saudi Arabia 16 million barrels of additional oil storage, buy up to 8 million barrels
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Japan intends to provide Saudi Arabia with an additional 16 million barrels of crude oil storage capacity and purchase up to 8 million barrels of Saudi crude for its national reserves, Saudi Press Agency reported on Friday.The announcement came following a virtual meeting between Saudi Minister of Energy and Minister of Industry and Mineral Resources Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman and Japanese Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Ryosei Akazawa on Nov. 9, 2026.During the meeting, the two ministers reaffirmed the strong and longstanding strategic partnership between Saudi Arabia and Japan and discussed ways to further strengthen bilateral cooperation, particularly in the energy sector.Following discussions within the joint task force established in May 2026, Saudi Arabia reaffirmed that it regards Japan as a strategic partner and attaches great importance to supporting its long-term energy security through stable and reliable crude oil supplies.Japan expressed its deep appreciation to Saudi Arabia for its continued provision of stable and reliable crude oil supplies.The Kingdom has already begun replenishing joint oil stockpiling tanks in Japan.Recognizing the longstanding importance of the Joint Crude Oil Stockpiling Project, established in 2010, and its recently demonstrated effectiveness, Japan intends to make an additional 16 million barrels of crude oil storage capacity available to Saudi Arabia for a limited period through its national stockpiling facilities.The additional capacity would bring the total storage capacity available to the Kingdom under the arrangement to 24 million barrels, including the existing capacity of 8 million barrels.Japan also intends to purchase up to 8 million barrels of articles.title: Arab Saudi berhak mempertahankan wilayahnya, rakyat dan kepentingan nasional:
articles.description: NAPLES - Wakil Menteri Luar Negeri Saudi Waleed Al- Khuraiji menegaskan kembali bahwa Kerajaan berhak untuk mempertahankan wilayahnya, rakyat dan kepentingan nasional sesuai dengan hukum internasional. Kata-katanya datang selama sesi berjudul "Mengamankan Strategic Chokepoints dan memikirkan ulang Keamanan Maritime" pada hari Kamis, diadakan di sela-sela dialog Mediterania (MED) konferensi di Naples, Italia. Al- Khuraiji mengatakan perkembangan terbaru di koridor maritim mendasari keterhubungan dekat antara keamanan maritim, stabilitas regional dan kemakmuran global. Dia mencatat bahwa keamanan saluran air strategis, dari Laut Merah dan Bab Al- Mandab Selat ke Selat Hormuz, adalah masalah perhatian internasional. Dia menekankan bahwa melindungi koridor maritim strategis tetap menjadi prioritas fundamental yang membutuhkan efektif regional dan kerjasama internasional. Wakil menteri menekankan pentingnya fokus pada upaya diplomatik, de- eskalasi dan menangani akar penyebab ketidakstabilan daerah untuk memastikan bahwa jalur air penting tetap aman dan terbuka sesuai dengan hukum internasional. Di Yaman, Al- Khuraiji menegaskan kembali Saudi Arabia terus berkomitmen untuk mencapai keamanan dan kemakmuran di negara ini. Dia juga menekankan pentingnya menghadapi segala upaya untuk menggunakan wilayah Yaman untuk mengancam negara-negara tetangga atau navigasi internasional.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia reserves legitimate right to defend its territory, people and national interests: Al-Khuraiji
articles.originalDescription: NAPLES — Saudi Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Waleed Al-Khuraiji reaffirmed that the Kingdom reserves its legitimate right to defend its territory, people and national interests in accordance with international law.His remarks came during a session titled "Securing Strategic Chokepoints and Rethinking Maritime Security" on Thursday, held on the sidelines of the Mediterranean Dialogues (MED) conference in Naples, Italy.Al-Khuraiji said recent developments in maritime corridors underscore the close interconnectedness between maritime security, regional stability and global prosperity.He noted that the security of strategic waterways, from the Red Sea and Bab Al-Mandab Strait to the Strait of Hormuz, is a matter of international concern.He emphasized that protecting strategic maritime corridors remains a fundamental priority that requires effective regional and international cooperation.The deputy minister stressed the importance of focusing on diplomatic efforts, de-escalation and addressing the root causes of regional instability to ensure that vital waterways remain safe and open in accordance with international law.On Yemen, Al-Khuraiji reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's continued commitment to achieving security and prosperity in the country.He also stressed the importance of confronting any attempts to use Yemeni territory to threaten neighboring countries or international navigation.

articles.title: Riyadh host Ethnosport Festival Kebudayaan untuk pertama kalinya di luar Türkiye
articles.description: RIYADH - Festival Kebudayaan Ethnoport dibuka pada hari Kamis di New Murabba di Riyadh, menandai pertama kalinya festival internasional diadakan di luar Türkiye, dengan lebih dari 18 negara menampilkan 38 olahraga dan game tradisional. Upacara pembukaan dihadiri oleh General Entertainment Authority (GEA) Ketua Turki Alalshikh, Presiden Konfederasi Ethnosport Dunia Necmeddin Bilal Erdogan, para pejabat, perwakilan dari negara-negara dan federasi olahraga, dan para tamu dari seluruh dunia. Menjadi tuan rumah di Riyadh Season, festival menyatukan ratusan atlet, seniman, dan pengrajin untuk merayakan olahraga tradisional, warisan budaya dan nilai-nilai manusia bersama. Di alamat pembuka, Alalshikh menyatakan rasa terima kasihnya kepada pemimpin Saudi atas dukungan tak terbatas bagi sektor hiburan dan Riyadh Musim. Dia menyambut kesempatan untuk menjadi tuan rumah festival untuk pertama kalinya di luar Türkiye, menggambarkannya sebagai acara internasional yang menyatukan bangsa dan merayakan olahraga dan warisan budaya mereka. Alalshikh mengatakan Riyadh Musim, sekarang di edisi ketujuh, terus menarik acara internasional utama dan menawarkan pengalaman yang beragam. Dia mencatat bahwa sejak peluncuran pada tahun 2019, Riyadh Musim telah berusaha untuk mengubah persembahan di berbagai bidang, dengan Festival Kebudayaan Ethnosport mewakili perpanjangan dari pendekatan itu. Dia menyoroti kemitraan dengan Konfederasi Ethnosport Dunia, yang diumumkan di Istanbul September lalu, mengatakan festival di Riyadh merupakan hasil dari kerjasama itu. Alalshikh juga mengumumkan bahwa kemitraan akan berlanjut tahun depan, dengan Riyadh Season mensponsori 2027 edisi festival di Istanbul. Dia menyatakan harapan bahwa hosting acara di Riyadh akan membuka jalan untuk kerjasama lebih lanjut dengan Konfederasi, mempromosikan olahraga tradisional, melestarikan warisan mereka dan melewati mereka ke generasi mendatang. articles.title: Arab Saudi memperingatkan terhadap eksploitasi sumber daya alam untuk membiayai kekerasan dan konflik perpanjang
articles.description: NEW YORK - Arab Saudi telah memperingatkan terhadap eksploitasi sumber daya alam untuk membiayai kekerasan dan konflik memperpanjang, menyerukan intensifed kerjasama internasional untuk memerangi perdagangan terlarang dalam sumber daya dan melindungi fasilitas energi, koridor maritim dan rantai pasokan. Pernyataan tersebut dibuat oleh Chargé d 'Affaires dari Saudi Arabia' s Permanent Mission kepada PBB di New York Fares Al- Otaibi selama sesi Dewan Keamanan PBB pada sumber daya alam dan konflik. Arab Saudi menekankan pentingnya menghormati kedaulatan negara-negara atas sumber daya alam mereka dan memperkuat transparansi dan akuntabilitas untuk memastikan bahwa pendapatan mereka menguntungkan rakyat mereka. The Kingdom menunjukkan bahwa serangan Houthi terhadap fasilitas minyak telah mengganggu ekspor Yaman dan kekurangan rakyat Yaman sumber daya ekonomi penting. Arab Saudi juga menyoroti usahanya di bawah Saudi Vision 2030 untuk mempromosikan pengelolaan sumber daya berkelanjutan dan diversifikasi ekonomi. Kerajaan menekankan pentingnya kemitraan internasional dalam menangani akar penyebab konflik dan mempromosikan stabilitas.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia warns against exploitation of natural resources to finance violence and prolong conflicts
articles.originalDescription: NEW YORK — Saudi Arabia has warned against the exploitation of natural resources to finance violence and prolong conflicts, calling for intensified international cooperation to combat illicit trade in these resources and protect energy facilities, maritime corridors and supply chains.The remarks were made by Acting Chargé d'Affaires of Saudi Arabia's Permanent Mission to the United Nations in New York Fares Al-Otaibi during a UN Security Council session on natural resources and conflicts.Saudi Arabia stressed the importance of respecting countries' sovereignty over their natural resources and strengthening transparency and accountability to ensure that their revenues benefit their people.The Kingdom pointed out that Houthi attacks on oil facilities have disrupted Yemen's exports and deprived the Yemeni people of vital economic resources.Saudi Arabia also highlighted its efforts under Saudi Vision 2030 to promote sustainable resource management and economic diversification.The Kingdom emphasized the importance of international partnerships in addressing the root causes of conflicts and promoting stability.

articles.title: Tingkat Riyadh pertama secara global dalam Indeks Layanan Daring Lokal PBB dengan skor sempurna
articles.description: RIYADH - Riyadh telah peringkat pertama secara global di United Nations Online Services Index (LOSI) dalam laporan PBB 2026, yang menilai kota di seluruh 194 negara. Ibukota Saudi mencapai nilai sempurna 100% di semua kategori penilaian, maju dari tempat ketiga di 2024 peringkat. Riyadh Municipality berkontribusi untuk prestasi ini dengan memajukan layanan digital di enam area kunci indeks: layanan digital, konten digital, kerangka institusi, literasi digital, infrastruktur dan partisipasi digital. Pemimpin global Riyadh dalam indeks juga mencerminkan kemajuan yang dicapai di bawah Program Transformasi Riyadh Municipal, yang bertujuan untuk memberikan transformasi digital komprehensif melalui layanan tinggi-kualitas, resident-sentris. Program ini berusaha meningkatkan kualitas hidup warga melalui layanan cerdas canggih yang memenuhi kebutuhan dan aspirasi sehari-hari mereka, lebih lanjut memposisikan posisi Riyadh di antara kota-kota terkemuka di pemerintahan digital.
articles.originalTitle: Riyadh ranks first globally in UN Local Online Services Index with perfect score
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Riyadh has ranked first globally in the United Nations Local Online Services Index (LOSI) in the 2026 UN report, which assessed cities across 194 countries.The Saudi capital achieved a perfect score of 100% across all assessment categories, advancing from third place in the 2024 rankings.Riyadh Municipality contributed to this achievement by advancing its digital services across the index's six key areas: digital services, digital content, institutional framework, digital literacy, infrastructure and digital participation.Riyadh's global leadership in the index also reflects the progress achieved under the Riyadh Municipal Transformation Program, which aims to deliver comprehensive digital transformation through high-quality, resident-centric services.The program seeks to enhance residents' quality of life through advanced smart services that meet their daily needs and aspirations, further cementing Riyadh's position among the world's leading cities in digital governance.

articles.title: Pro- pemukim grafiti ditemukan di masjid ditargetkan dalam serangan pembakaran di Israel
articles.description: Pro- pemukim grafiti ditemukan di masjid yang ditargetkan dalam serangan pembakaran di Israel Sebuah masjid di desa Dahi di utara Israel dibakar dalam suatu malam pembakaran, dengan grafiti Ibrani di dinding terdekat menuntut balas dendam untuk kematian pemukim Bank Barat, polisi Israel mengatakan. Graffiti itu mengacu pada Yehuda Sherman, seorang pemukim tewas pada bulan Maret setelah ditabrak mobil yang dikendarai oleh orang Palestina, menurut The Times of Israel. Rekaman kamera keamanan yang diterbitkan oleh media Israel menunjukkan tiga orang mendekati gedung dengan wadah sebelum melarikan diri. Badan keamanan Shin Bet telah bergabung dengan penyelidikan, Haaretz melaporkan, menambahkan bahwa Polisi sedang menyelidiki kebakaran dan mencari tersangka. Imam masjid, Sheikh Khalad Zuabi, mengatakan pada Ynet bahwa para pemuja menemukan api ketika mereka tiba untuk doa pagi.
articles.originalTitle: Pro-settler graffiti found at mosque targeted in arson attack in Israel
articles.originalDescription: Pro-settler graffiti found at mosque targeted in arson attack in Israel A mosque in the village of Dahi in northern Israel was set on fire in an arson attack overnight, with Hebrew graffiti on nearby walls demanding revenge for the death of a West Bank settler, Israeli police said. The graffiti referred to Yehuda Sherman, a settler killed in March after being struck by a car driven by a Palestinian, according to The Times of Israel. Security camera footage published by Israeli media appeared to show three people approaching the building with a container before fleeing. The Shin Bet security agency has joined the investigation, Haaretz reported, adding that Police were investigating the fire and searching for suspects. The mosque’s imam, Sheikh Khalad Zuabi, told Ynet that worshippers discovered the fire when they arrived for morning prayers.

articles.title: Serangan udara menyerang gudang dan pabrik di Yaman Sanaa, pihak berwenang Houthi mengatakan
articles.description: Serangan udara ke gudang-gudang dan pabrik-pabrik di Yaman Sanaa, pihak berwenang Houthi mengatakan serangkaian serangan udara berat menghantam ibukota Yaman, Sanaa, dengan otoritas Houthi melaporkan kerusakan ke gudang penyimpanan makanan, gudang dan pabrik milik Perusahaan Air Mineral Yaman Saudi, Al Jazeera melaporkan. Serangan itu diikuti klaim oleh juru bicara militer Houthis 'bahwa kelompok telah dilakukan empat operasi di dalam Arab Saudi, menargetkan bandara Raja Khalid, pusat keuangan dan perusahaan petrokimia di Riyadh, serta Khamis Mushait pangkalan udara. Juru bicara mengatakan serangan itu adalah pembalasan atas serangan udara pada perahu membawa orang-orang yang mengungsi di pelabuhan Ras Al- Ara di Yaman Selatan. Dia mengatakan 19 dari 25 orang kapal tewas dan empat terluka, dengan tubuh mereka tersebar di pantai. Sebuah pemandangan umum menunjukkan kerusakan di pabrik alas kaki berikut dugaan serangan udara Saudi di lingkungan Sanaa-Nahda, 17 November 2026 (Mohammed Huwais / AFP)
articles.originalTitle: Air strikes hit warehouses and factory in Yemen’s Sanaa, Houthi authorities say
articles.originalDescription: Air strikes hit warehouses and factory in Yemen’s Sanaa, Houthi authorities say A series of heavy air strikes hit Yemen’s capital, Sanaa, with Houthi authorities reporting damage to a food storage warehouse, a warehouse and a factory belonging to the Yemeni-Saudi Mineral Water Company, Al Jazeera reported. The attacks followed claims by the Houthis’ military spokesman that the group had carried out four operations deep inside Saudi Arabia, targeting King Khalid airport, a financial centre and a petrochemicals company in Riyadh, as well as Khamis Mushait airbase. The spokesperson said the attacks were in retaliation for an air strike on a boat carrying displaced people at the port of Ras al-Ara in southern Yemen. He said 19 of the 25 people aboard were killed and four were wounded, with their bodies scattered along the coast. A general view shows damage at a footwear factory following an alleged Saudi airstrike in Sanaa’s al-Nahda neighbourhood, 17 November 2026 (Mohammed Huwais/AFP)

articles.title: Kementerian Gaza menuntut pembebasan direktur rumah sakit yang ditahan dan 81 pekerja kesehatan
articles.description: Menteri Gaza menuntut pembebasan direktur rumah sakit yang ditahan dan 81 pekerja kesehatan Departemen Kesehatan Gaza telah mengkritik keputusan Israel untuk memperpanjang penahanan Dr Hussam Abu Safila, direktur Rumah Sakit Kamal Adwan, dengan enam bulan lainnya tanpa biaya atau percobaan, menggambarkan itu sebagai "kejahatan senyawa". Dalam sebuah pernyataan, menteri mengatakan penahanan Abu SaSofia terus melanggar hukum internasional, termasuk Konvensi Jenewa, yang memberikan perlindungan bagi para pekerja medis dan kemanusiaan. Dikatakan 81 pekerja kesehatan Palestina tetap dalam penahanan Israel, di mana mereka menghadapi penyiksaan fisik dan psikologis, penyangkalan perwakilan hukum dan kelalaian medis. Sebuah pengadilan Israel di Beersheba memperpanjang penahanan Abu SaSofia pada hari Rabu, menolak permintaan pengacaranya untuk dibebaskan. Dia ditahan selama serangan Israel di Rumah Sakit Kamal Adwan pada Desember 2024. Kantor HAM PBB mengatakan menerima informasi bahwa dia mengalami penyiksaan, kurungan yang berkepanjangan dan penyangkalan terhadap perawatan medis.
articles.originalTitle: Gaza ministry demands release of detained hospital director and 81 health workers
articles.originalDescription: Gaza ministry demands release of detained hospital director and 81 health workers Gaza’s health ministry has criticised Israel’s decision to extend the detention of Dr Hussam Abu Safia, director of Kamal Adwan Hospital, by another six months without charge or trial, describing it as a “compound crime”. In a statement, the ministry said Abu Safia’s continued detention violated international law, including the Geneva Conventions, which provide protections for medical and humanitarian workers. It said 81 Palestinian health workers remained in Israeli detention, where they faced physical and psychological torture, denial of legal representation and medical neglect. An Israeli court in Beersheba extended Abu Safia’s detention on Wednesday, rejecting his lawyer’s request for his release. He was detained during an Israeli raid on Kamal Adwan Hospital in December 2024. The UN human rights office has said it received information that he was subjected to torture, prolonged solitary confinement and denial of medical care.

Perjanjian tersebut berfokus pada teknologi pendidikan, kandungan kurikulum dan digital, bertujuan untuk mengembangkan alat-alat pendidikan dan sumber daya, memanfaatkan keahlian internasional dan meningkatkan kualitas pendidikan dan pembelajaran. * * media [2797132] * * Perjanjian tersebut termasuk kerjasama antara Dewan Persatuan Urusan dan Universitas Galladet, yang mengkhususkan diri dalam mendidik siswa dengan gangguan pendengaran, untuk mengembangkan program akademik dan khusus, memajukan penelitian ilmiah dan studi bersama, personil kereta api dan keahlian pertukaran. Al- Benyan juga menyaksikan perjanjian antara Princess Nourah Bint University Abdulrahman dan Layanan Pengujian Pendidikan (ETS), Maarif untuk Pendidikan dan Google, dan Maarif untuk Pendidikan dan National Geographic. Kesepakatan lain ditandatangani antara Perusahaan Teknologi Pendidikan Tatweer (TETCO) dan Google dan Cisco, sementara Perusahaan Pendidikan Tatweer menandatangani perjanjian dengan Savvas, McGraw Hill dan National Geographic untuk mengembangkan kurikulum dan konten pendidikan. * * media [2797133] * * Rekanan-rekanan ini mencakup pendidikan khusus, penilaian dan evaluasi, integrasi teknologi modern ke dalam pendidikan, dan pengembangan solusi digital dan sumber daya pendidikan untuk memperkaya kurikulum dan meningkatkan pengalaman belajar. Mereka juga bertujuan untuk memanfaatkan keahlian internasional dalam mengembangkan alat-alat pendidikan, platform, dan sumber daya sambil memperkuat kerjasama teknologi dan pendidikan antara lembaga-lembaga Saudi dan mitra global. Perjanjian mendukung upaya Kementerian Pendidikan untuk mempercepat transformasi digital, memajukan kurikulum dan konten pendidikan, dan memperluas penggunaan teknologi dan ino
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Education Minister witnesses signing of 9 cooperation agreements with US universities and companies
articles.originalDescription: WASHINGTON — Saudi Minister of Education Yousef bin Abdullah Al-Benyan witnessed the signing of nine bilateral cooperation agreements between Saudi educational entities and American universities, institutions and companies during his official visit to the United States. The agreements focus on educational technologies, curricula and digital content, aiming to develop educational tools and resources, leverage international expertise and improve the quality of education and learning outcomes. **media[2797132]** The agreements include cooperation between the Council of Universities' Affairs and Gallaudet University, which specializes in educating students with hearing disabilities, to develop academic and specialized programs, advance scientific research and joint studies, train personnel and exchange expertise. Al-Benyan also witnessed agreements between Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University and Educational Testing Service (ETS), Maarif for Education and Google, and Maarif for Education and National Geographic. Another agreement was signed between Tatweer Educational Technologies Company (TETCO) and Google and Cisco, while Tatweer Education Company signed agreements with Savvas, McGraw Hill and National Geographic to develop curricula and educational content. **media[2797133]** The partnerships cover specialized education, assessment and evaluation, the integration of modern technologies into education, and the development of digital solutions and educational resources to enrich curricula and improve the learning experience. They also aim to leverage international expertise in developing educational tools, platforms and resources while strengthening technological and educational cooperation between Saudi institutions and global partners. The agreements support the Ministry of Education's efforts to accelerate digital transformation, advance curricula and educational content, and expand the use of modern technologies and innovation to improve educational practice

articles.title: Update pagi
articles.description: Pagi pembaruan Selamat pagi pembaca Mata Timur Tengah, Berikut adalah perkembangan terbaru: Koalisi Saudi- dipimpin mengatakan dalam pernyataan terpisah bahwa hal itu dicegat dan menghancurkan drone dan rudal diluncurkan oleh Houthis Yaman menuju Arab Saudi selama beberapa jam terakhir, termasuk yang menargetkan daerah selatan Kingem dan ibukota Riyadh. Lebih dari 115 serangan yang diklaim oleh Iran atau kelompok yang bersekutu dengan Teheran telah merusak 26 pangkalan militer dan infrastruktur lainnya milik AS di Timur Tengah, The Associated Press melaporkan. Analisisnya, menggunakan citra satelit, menunjukkan bahwa serangan Iran terhadap situs-situs AS di wilayah tersebut sebagian besar menargetkan sistem peringatan awal, pesawat dan bangunan, menghasilkan kerusakan senilai miliaran dolar pada peralatan AS. Seorang pejabat Pentagon mengatakan kepada penegak hukum bahwa perang AS terhadap Iran telah biaya diperkirakan $48.3 miliar. "Angka itu termasuk amunisi, biaya penggantian peralatan, dan biaya operasional", kata Arthur Miller. Namun, angka tidak termasuk harga perbaikan instalasi militer AS di wilayah rusak sejak Februari. Duta Besar Israel kepada Yechiel Leiter AS berkata pada hari Kamis bahwa keputusan untuk memperbarui serangan terhadap Iran "akan diambil oleh Presiden Trump". Berbicara dengan media AS Newsmax, Leiter berkata Israel akan mendukung AS jika Trump memutuskan untuk menyerang Iran.
articles.originalTitle: Morning update
articles.originalDescription: Morning update Good morning Middle East Eye readers, Here are the latest developments: The Saudi-led coalition said in separate statements that it intercepted and destroyed drones and a missile launched by Yemen's Houthis towards Saudi Arabia over the past few hours, including ones targeting the kingom's southern region and its capital of Riyadh. Over 115 strikes claimed by Iran or groups aligned with Tehran have damaged 26 military bases and other infrastructure belonging to the US across the Middle East, The Associated Press reported. The analysis, using satellite imagery, indicated that Iranian attacks on US sites in the region have mostly targeted early-warning systems, aircraft and buildings, resulting in billions of dollars’ worth of damage to US equipment. A Pentagon official told lawmakers that the US war on Iran has cost an estimated $48.3 billion. "That number includes munitions, equipment replacement costs, and operational cost," Arthur Miller said. However, the figure does not include the price of repairing US military installations in the region damaged since February. Israel’s Ambassador to the US Yechiel Leiter said on Thursday that the decision to renew strikes against Iran “will be taken by President Trump”. Speaking to US media outlet Newsmax, Leiter said Israel will support the US if Trump decides to attack Iran.

articles.title: Koalisi mencegat lima pesawat tak berawak, satu rudal balistik saat isu pertahanan sipil memperingatkan di Asir, Jazan
articles.description: RIYADH - Koalisi untuk menyokong Legitimasi di Yaman mengumumkan bahwa lima pesawat tak berawak dan satu rudal balistik yang diluncurkan oleh teroris milisi Houthi telah dicegat dan dihancurkan pada hari Jumat, ketika pertahanan sipil mengeluarkan peringatan darurat di bagian daerah Asir dan Jazan. Jumaat pagi, Juru bicara Koalisi, Mayor Jenderal Turki Al- Malki mengkonfirmasi kedatangan dan penghancuran pesawat tanpa awak yang diluncurkan oleh milisi Houthi menuju daerah Arab Saudi. Koalisi kemudian mengumumkan interception dan kehancuran dari drone lain diluncurkan ke arah daerah yang sama. Kemudian pagi itu, Al-Malki mengumumkan bahwa pertahanan udara telah dicegat dan menghancurkan rudal balistik diluncurkan ke arah daerah selatan. The Coalition kemudian dikonfirmasi interception dan kehancuran dari drone ketiga diluncurkan ke arah daerah yang sama. Dalam pengumuman terbaru, Koalisi mengkonfirmasi bahwa dua drone tambahan telah dicegat dan dihancurkan di Riyadh dan daerah selatan. Sementara itu, Direktorat Umum Pertahanan Sipil mengeluarkan peringatan melalui National Early Warning Plaform untuk darurat di kota Jazan, serta Abha dan Khamis Mushait di daerah Asir. Peringatan pertama diumumkan Jumat pagi di kota Jazan, diikuti dengan peringatan terpisah di Abha dan Khamis Mushait kemudian pagi itu, memperingatkan penduduk untuk potensi bahaya. Pertahanan sipil mendesak warga menerima peringatan darurat untuk tetap tenang, mengikuti instruksi resmi dan segera mencari tempat berlindung di lokasi yang aman terdekat, lebih baik di dalam gedung atau ruang interior jauh dari jendela. Pihak berwenang juga menyarankan warga untuk tetap di dalam rumah sampai bahaya telah berlalu, menghindari daerah terbuka dan berpotensi lokasi berbahaya, dan mengikuti petunjuk yang dikeluarkan melalui saluran resmi. Pertahanan sipil terus mendesak publik untuk melaporkan keadaan darurat dengan memanggil 911 di Mekah, Madinah, Riyadh dan Provinsi Timur, atau 998 di bagian lain dari Kerajaa
articles.originalTitle: Coalition intercepts five drones, one ballistic missile as Civil Defense issues alerts in Asir, Jazan
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen announced that five drones and one ballistic missile launched by the terrorist Houthi militia had been intercepted and destroyed on Friday, as Civil Defense issued emergency warnings in parts of the Asir and Jazan regions. Early Friday morning, Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Malki confirmed the interception and destruction of a drone launched by the Houthi militia toward Saudi Arabia’s southern region. The Coalition subsequently announced the interception and destruction of another drone launched toward the same region. Later that morning, Al-Malki announced that air defenses had intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched toward the southern region. The Coalition then confirmed the interception and destruction of a third drone launched toward the same region. In its latest announcement, the Coalition confirmed that two additional drones had been intercepted and destroyed in the Riyadh and southern regions. Meanwhile, the General Directorate of Civil Defense issued warnings through the National Early Warning Platform for Emergencies in Jazan city, as well as Abha and Khamis Mushait in the Asir region. The first warning was announced early Friday morning in Jazan city, followed by separate warnings in Abha and Khamis Mushait later that morning, alerting residents to potential danger. Civil Defense urged residents receiving emergency alerts to remain calm, follow official instructions and immediately seek shelter in the nearest safe location, preferably inside a building or an interior room away from windows. The authority also advised residents to remain indoors until the danger had passed, avoid open areas and potentially dangerous locations, and follow instructions issued through official channels. Civil Defense further urged the public to report emergencies by calling 911 in Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh and the Eastern Province, or 998 in other parts of the Kingdom.

articles.description: Kepercayaan diri di Hormuz telah dihancurkan oleh perang melawan Iran, IEA mengatakan diturunkan oleh staf MEE pada Thu, 11 / 19 / 2026 - 21: 17 Kepala Energi mengatakan dunia bisa 'mengelola tanpa Hormuz' tapi itu akan membutuhkan $240bn dalam investasi Sebuah anggota pemerintah Irak berjalan di samping pipa di Lapangan Minyak Bai Hassan, barat dari utara kota Irak Kirkuk, pada 19 Oktober 2017 (Ahmad all-baye / AFP) Off Perang AS-Israel di Iran telah "hancur" kepercayaan Selat Hormuz sebagai aliran air yang dapat diandalkan untuk ekspor energi, Fatih Biope, Badan Internasional (Organisasi Internasional) "Saya tidak melihat jalur kredibel untuk kembali ke situasi yang ada pada bulan Februari 2026", tulis Birol untuk majalah The Economist dalam esai diterbitkan pada hari Rabu. "Pengiriman mengalir melalui Selat Hormuz telah diblokir sekali, dengan efek sangat mengganggu di pasar minyak dan gas. Itu bisa terjadi lagi. Percaya diri dalam Selat sebagai aman dan dapat diandalkan koridor untuk energi dan barang-barang lain telah hancur," tambahnya. Birol mengatakan bahwa dunia "dapat dibayangkan mengelola tanpa selat", tapi itu akan "sulit". Dalam laporan World Energy Outlook yang diterbitkan pada hari Kamis, IEA mengatakan mengembangkan jaringan pipa alternatif di sekitar jalur air akan memerlukan sekitar $40bn. Ini akan menambahkan sekitar $2 dengan biaya laras minyak diekspor dari Timur Tengah. Tambahan $200bn perlu dibelanjakan untuk sumber energi alternatif di luar Timur Tengah. IEA mengatakan bahwa dalam kasus minyak saja, proyek pipa baru berada di bawah pembangunan atau pertimbangan di Timur Tengah yang dapat memompa sekitar tujuh juta barel per hari minyak, memungkinkan produsen untuk mencapai pasar internasional tanpa melalui selat. "Jika semua proyek ini selesai, produsen non-Gulf meningkatkan output, dan importir menurunkan permintaan, maka Kasus Hormuz Rendah kami mengurangi kebutuhan untuk transit melalui Selat 2 mbp pada tahun 2035", kata IEA, merangkum bag
articles.originalTitle: Confidence in Hormuz has been 'crushed' by war on Iran, IEA says
articles.originalDescription: Confidence in Hormuz has been 'crushed' by war on Iran, IEA says Submitted by MEE staff on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 21:17 Energy chief says world can 'manage without Hormuz' but it will require $240bn in investments An Iraqi government forces member walks next to a pipeline at the Bai Hassan Oil Field, west of the northern Iraqi city of Kirkuk, on 19 October 2017 (Ahmad al-Rubaye/AFP) Off The US-Israeli war on Iran has “crushed” confidence in the Strait of Hormuz as a reliable waterway for the export of energy, Fatih Birol, the head of the International Energy Agency (IEA), has warned. “I don’t see any credible pathway back to the situation that existed in February 2026,” Birol wrote for The Economist magazine in an essay published on Wednesday. “Shipping flows through the Strait of Hormuz have been blocked once, with a hugely disruptive effect on oil and gas markets. It can happen again. Confidence in the Strait as a safe and reliable corridor for energy and other goods has been crushed,” he added. Birol said that the world "can conceivably manage without the strait," but it would be "difficult". In its World Energy Outlook report published on Thursday, the IEA said developing alternative pipelines around the waterway would require around $40bn. This would add around $2 to the cost of a barrel of oil exported from the Middle East. An additional $200bn would need to be spent on alternative sources of energy outside the Middle East. The IEA said that in the case of oil alone, new pipeline projects are under construction or consideration in the Middle East that could pump around seven million barrels per day of oil, allowing producers to reach international markets without going through the strait. “If all these projects are completed, non-Gulf producers step up output, and importers bring down demand, then our Low Hormuz Case reduces the need for transit through the Strait to 2 mbp by 2035,” the IEA said, summarising how the strategic waterway could be made less relevant. articles.originalTitle: Senate vote to curb Trump war on Iran fails again
articles.originalDescription: Senate vote to curb Trump war on Iran fails again Submitted by Yasmine El-Sabawi on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 20:25 This is the 15th time lawmakers have tried to pass a largely symbolic resolution A temporary security fence is erected outside the US Capitol building in Washington, DC, on 19 November 2026 (Reuters/Cedeno) Off For the 15th time this year, the US Senate has tried to curb President Donald Trump's warmaking authority in Iran. It succeeded twice, once in May and once in June, but failed on Thursday by a vote of 51-48. Fifty Republicans and Democratic Senator John Fetterman voted against the resolution, while only 43 Democrats were present to vote in favour. They were joined by two Independents, and three Republicans in Rand Paul, Lisa Murkowski, and Susan Collins. Republican Senator Thom Tillis, who previously voted alongside Democrats, suggested the repeat votes were becoming fruitless, telling reporters on Thursday that there should be "more weight on solving the fundamental problem" instead. Tillis decided not to run in this month's midterm elections after a spate of Trump-led attacks on him last year. He will now be replaced by Democrat Roy Cooper, the senator-elect, in North Carolina. The election results were a decisive rebuke of the Trump administration's domestic and foreign policy, as Vice President JD Vance himself acknowledged the very next day . Trump has previously just ignored the two successful resolutions stipulating that only Congress has the authority to declare - and thereby fund - the US at war. The move effectively rendered the Senate's efforts moot. After the 23 June vote, which was adopted 50-48, the White House responded that "there are no present hostilities from which to remove US Armed Forces", because "the hostilities that began on February 28, 2026, have terminated with the ceasefire ordered by the President on April 7, 2026". articles.title: Kepala GCC mengutuk serangan Houthi terhadap KAFD, menyerukan tindakan internasional
articles.description: RIYADH - Dewan Kerjasama Teluk (GCC) Sekretaris Jenderal Jasem Albudaiwi dikutuk dalam kondisi terkuat serangan teroris berbahaya dilakukan oleh milisi Houthi terhadap salah satu menara di Distrik Keuangan King Abdullah (KAFD) di Riyadh. "Serangan ini merupakan pelanggaran terang-terangan dari Kerajaan kedaulatan Arab Saudi dan eskalasi yang berbahaya, mencerminkan milisi terus ancaman terhadap kehidupan sipil, menargetkan fasilitas sipil, dan upaya untuk melemahkan keamanan dan stabilitas daerah," katanya dalam sebuah pernyataan. Albudaiwi memanggil komunitas internasional dan Dewan Keamanan PBB untuk memenuhi tanggung jawab mereka dan mengambil langkah-langkah efektif untuk menahan milisi Houthi yang bertanggung jawab atas tindakan teroris dan mencegah ancaman lebih lanjut. Dia menekankan bahwa kegagalan untuk mengambil tindakan tegas terhadap serangan terhadap warga sipil dan fasilitas sipil akan mendorong milisi untuk melaksanakan serangan lebih lanjut dan meningkatkan risiko untuk regional dan internasional keamanan dan stabilitas. Kepala GCC menegaskan kembali solidaritas yang penuh dan tak tergoyahkan dengan Arab Saudi dan dukungan mereka untuk semua langkah yang diperlukan untuk melindungi keamanan, kedaulatan, dan integritas teritorial, serta keselamatan warganya dan warganya.
articles.originalTitle: GCC chief condemns Houthi attack on KAFD, calls for international action
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) Secretary General Jasem Albudaiwi condemned in the strongest terms the treacherous terrorist attack carried out by the Houthi militia against one of the towers in the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD) in Riyadh. “The attack constitutes a blatant violation of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty and a dangerous escalation, reflecting the militia's continued threats to civilian lives, targeting of civilian facilities, and efforts to undermine regional security and stability,” he said in a statement. Albudaiwi called on the international community and the UN Security Council to fulfill their responsibilities and take effective measures to hold the Houthi militia accountable for its terrorist acts and prevent further threats. He stressed that failure to take firm action against attacks on civilians and civilian facilities would encourage the militia to carry out further attacks and increase risks to regional and international security and stability. The GCC chief reaffirmed the Gulf states' full and unwavering solidarity with Saudi Arabia and their support for all measures it takes to protect its security, sovereignty, and territorial integrity, as well as the safety of its citizens and residents.
