articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Ministers of foreign affairs of Saudi Arabia and several other Arab and Islamic countries welcomed the decisions of the governments of the United Kingdom and Australia to impose sanctions in response to illegal Israeli settlement activities in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including measures targeting companies involved in settlement construction. In a joint statement, they also welcome the United Kingdom’s decision to sanction an organization obstructing the delivery of humanitarian aid to Gaza.The countries also include Jordan, Egypt, Pakistan, Indonesia, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Niger, Palestine, Libya, Maldives, Türkiye, Kuwait, Algeria, Somalia and Oman. The ministers expressed support for all efforts to ensure accountability, including through appropriate international measures and the imposition of sanctions on entities and individuals responsible for settlement activities, including the E1 settlement plan, as well as those that support, facilitate or implement settlement expansion and annexation policies. They expressed the hope that this decision by the UK and Australia would encourage many in the international community to follow suit. articles.originalTitle: Ten killed in Saudi strikes in Sanaa over two days, Houthi health ministry says
articles.originalDescription: Ten killed in Saudi strikes in Sanaa over two days, Houthi health ministry says Yemen’s Saudi-backed government forces said on Thursday that they killed or wounded at least 144 Houthi commanders and fighters in recent hours. Spokesman Majed al-Nuzaili said in a post on X that forces launched at least 715 targeted operations against the Houthis in Taiz, Marib and al-Jawf governorates, including at least 631 artillery strikes and 36 drone strikes. Meanwhile, Saudi-led coalition forces carried out at least 15 air strikes. The Houthi health ministry said on Thursday that several strikes by the Saudi-led coalition on Yemen’s capital, Sanaa, killed 10 people over the past two days, one of which allegedly targeted a footwear and textile factory in the al-Nahda neighbourhood, according to Saba news agency.

In February, the ministry reported that 1,360 patients in Gaza died while waiting for medical travel permits after the Rafah crossing was closed in May 2024. articles.originalTitle: Houthis hit Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund skyscraper
articles.originalDescription: Houthis hit Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund skyscraper Submitted by MEE staff on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 16:31 Saudi crown prince meets Centcom commander in Riyadh amid high profile attack A screengrab from a social media video shows a projectile hitting the Public Investment Fund tower, Riyadh's tallest skyscraper, as it was struck by a suspected Houthi missile, in Riyadh, on 19 November 2026 (Social Media/via Reuters) Off The skyscraper housing Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF) in Riyadh was damaged on Thursday by a Houthi strike, the kingdom has confirmed. The strike destroyed windows across seven to eight floors of the tower, Riyadh's tallest skyscraper, and bent part of its metal facade, according to a Reuters journalist. Video footage shared from the Saudi capital showed crews already working to replace the glass. The attack is the second time this month that the Houthis have struck at the heart of Saudi Arabia’s image as a safe investment destination. PIF says it has around $1 trillion in assets. Earlier this month, the Houthis struck Aramco Tower in Riyadh. “One of the towers of the Financial Center in Riyadh was targeted in a terrorist attack by the terrorist Houthi militia, causing material damage but no injuries -praise be to God,” the Saudi authorities said in a statement released on Thursday. The press release included an image showing notable but relatively minor damage to the PIF headquarters. Video footage appeared to show a missile slamming into the 80-storey tower, but Middle East Eye could not independently verify the footage. Reuters reported that three sources said the building was struck by a missile while the kingdom said it had dealt with the incoming missile threat and that debris had fallen. Sources on the ground in Riyadh told MEE that they were awakened by a massive explosion around 5am. Sekolah dasar adalah bagian dari Akademi Singa, yang menjalankan 11 akademisi utama di London timur. Kasus ini telah memperbarui kekhawatiran tentang penggunaan kerangka balik terorisme Inggris dalam pengaturan pendidikan dan perawatan solidaritas Palestina di sekolah. articles.originalTitle: UK school pays compensation to children threatened over Palestinian badges
articles.originalDescription: UK school pays compensation to children threatened over Palestinian badges Submitted by Areeb Ullah on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 16:12 Lion Academy Trust threatened to refer children to Prevent for wearing colours in memory of children killed in Gaza Hundreds of parents and supporters staged a protest outside Barclay primary school in east London after the Lion Academy Trust did not respond to a parent letter (Supplied) Off A UK school trust has apologised and agreed to pay compensation to four children who were threatened with referrals to the government’s counterterrorism Prevent programme after wearing Palestinian colours and badges at a school charity event. The children attended Barclay Primary School in Leyton, east London, in November 2023, when they wore Palestinian colours in memory of children killed in Gaza during the school’s Children in Need event. The primary school is part of the Lion Academy Trust, which runs 11 primary academies in east London. Following the event, the children's parents received letters warning that they could be referred to Prevent or to the police’s hate crime unit for wearing the Palestine flag or its colours, which it deemed “overt demonstrations of political beliefs” that could be “deemed offensive". Middle East Eye understands that the letter was sent to the families of a number of children, including an eight-year-old who lost 14 members of his family in Gaza. Prevent Watch, which has supported the families throughout its three-year legal battle, confirmed to MEE that a court approved the settlement on Thursday after the families, represented by law firm Leigh Day, brought claims under the Equality Act 2010 and the Human Rights Act 1998. The case has renewed concerns about the use of the UK’s counterterrorism framework in educational settings and the treatment of Palestinian solidarity in schools. articles.title: ICJ memerintah genosida Rohingya bisa memperkuat kasus Afrika Selatan terhadap Israel
articles.description: ICJ menentang genosida Rohingya dapat memperkuat kasus Afrika Selatan terhadap Israel. Pengadilan Internasional Hakim memutuskan bahwa Myanmar melakukan genosida terhadap Rohingya dapat memiliki banyak konsekuensi untuk Israel, setelah hakim menolak argumen bahwa operasi militer terhadap kelompok bersenjata memberikan penjelasan yang memadai untuk kampanye pembunuhan massal, kekerasan seksual dan kehancuran yang meluas. Penilaian, pertama kalinya pengadilan tertinggi PBB menyatakan bertanggung jawab atas genosida, menawarkan preseden hukum yang berpotensi signifikan dalam kasus ini menuduh Israel melakukan genosida melawan Palestina di Gaza, terutama atas bagaimana hakim menilai niat genosida ketika negara mengklaim tindakan militer didorong oleh tujuan keamanan. Dalam keputusan 9- 6 pada hari Kamis, ICJ menemukan bahwa pasukan keamanan Myanmar telah melakukan genosida terhadap populasi Rohingya di Negara Rakhine Utara selama operasi 2017 militer. "Satu-satunya alasan yang masuk akal yang dapat menjelaskan tindakan Myanmar adalah niat untuk menghancurkan sebagian besar dari kelompok yang dilindungi, yaitu populasi Rohingya di Negara Rakhine Utara", kata pengadilan. Penilaian ini sangat penting bagi kasus Afrika Selatan, yang bergantung pada penetapan bahwa Israel bertindak dengan maksud khusus menghancurkan Palestina, secara keseluruhan atau sebagian, sebagai kelompok nasional, etnis, rasial atau agama. articles.originalTitle: ICJ ruling on Rohingya genocide could strengthen South Africa's case against Israel
articles.originalDescription: ICJ ruling on Rohingya genocide could strengthen South Africa's case against Israel The International Court of Justice's landmark ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya could have far-reaching consequences for Israel, after judges rejected the argument that military operations against armed groups provided an adequate explanation for a campaign of mass killings, sexual violence and widespread destruction. The judgment, the first time the UN's highest court has found a state responsible for genocide, offers South Africa a potentially significant legal precedent in its case accusing Israel of committing genocide against Palestinians in Gaza, particularly over how judges assess genocidal intent when a state claims its military actions are driven by security objectives. In a 9-6 decision on Thursday, the ICJ found that Myanmar's security forces had committed genocide against the Rohingya population in northern Rakhine State during the military's 2017 operations. "The only reasonable inference that can explain Myanmar's actions is an intention to destroy a substantial part of the protected group, namely the Rohingya population in Northern Rakhine State," the court said. The judgment is particularly significant for South Africa's case, which hinges on establishing that Israel acted with the specific intention of destroying Palestinians, in whole or in part, as a national, ethnic, racial or religious group. Read more: ICJ ruling on Rohingya genocide could strengthen South Africa's case against Israel Judge Navi Pillay enters the International Court of Justice in The Hague, the Netherlands, to deliver its judgment against Myanmar, on 19 November 2026 (Reuters/Piroschka van de Wouw)

articles.title: Utusan perdagangan Inggris untuk Israel kembali akun troll yang menyerang Ed Miliband dan Buruh atas Muslim
articles.description: Utusan perdagangan Inggris untuk Israel kembali akun troll yang menyerang Ed Miliband dan Buruh atas Muslim Utusan perdagangan Inggris untuk Israel telah mendukung akun media sosial yang telah disparagingly berlabel sekretaris asing "Sekretaris Palestina" dan berulang kali menyerang pemerintah Tenaga Kerja, mengklaim itu mencoba untuk menenangkan Muslim. Awal minggu ini Byline Times melaporkan bahwa @ habibi _ uk, akun anonim pada X yang berkampanye melawan pro-Palestina tokoh publik di Inggris, adalah cucu Amerika-Inggris dari filsuf Bertrand Russell dan seorang ahli negara bagian AS dalam "diplomasi politik-militer" yang disebut Benjamin Tait. Tait telah sebelumnya bekerja dengan Lord Ian Austin, mantan MP dan rekan hidup yang telah menjadi utusan perdagangan ke Israel di bawah pemerintahan berturut-turut sejak Juli 2019. Austin memposting di X pada hari Rabu, sebagai respon terhadap akun Habibi: "Teruskan", diikuti dengan dua emoji lengan berotot dan dua emoji bertepuk tangan. Habibi telah memberi label Sekretaris Luar Negeri Inggris Ed Miliband "Palestina Sekretaris", berkomentar bulan lalu: "Oh lihat, Sekretaris Palestina bekerja keras". articles.originalTitle: UK trade envoy to Israel backs troll account which attacked Ed Miliband and Labour over Muslims
articles.originalDescription: UK trade envoy to Israel backs troll account which attacked Ed Miliband and Labour over Muslims The UK's trade envoy to Israel has endorsed a social media account which has disparagingly labelled the foreign secretary the "Palestine secretary" and repeatedly attacked the Labour government, claiming it is trying to appease Muslims. Earlier this week Byline Times reported that @habibi_uk, the anonymous account on X which campaigns against pro-Palestine public figures in the UK, is the American-British grandson of the philosopher Bertrand Russell and a US State Department-trained expert in "political-military diplomacy" called Benjamin Tait. Tait has previously worked with Lord Ian Austin, a former Labour MP and life peer who has been the trade envoy to Israel under successive governments since July 2019. Austin posted on X on Wednesday, in response to the Habibi account: "Keep going", followed by two emojis of a muscled arm and two clapping emojis. Habibi has labelled British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband the "Palestine Secretary", commenting last month: "Oh look, the Palestine Secretary is hard at work." articles.title: Dua orang Palestina tewas, beberapa terluka dalam serangan Israel di Gaza
articles.description: Dua orang Palestina tewas, beberapa terluka dalam serangan Israel di seluruh Gaza Dua Palestina tewas dan beberapa lainnya terluka pada hari Kamis dalam serangan Israel menargetkan beberapa daerah di Jalur Gaza. Saksi mata, Berita Wafa melaporkan bahwa pesawat tak berawak Israel menembaki sekelompok orang Palestina di Jalan Salah Al- Din, tenggara Gaza City, membunuh satu orang seketika. Palestina lain tewas ketika artileri Israel shelled Zeitoun lingkungan timur Gaza City dengan beberapa putaran. Sementara itu, dua orang Palestina, termasuk seorang anak, terluka oleh tembakan di barat Siham School Khan Younis di Gaza selatan, dan lainnya terluka dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak Israel di stasiun Bahloul, tempat penampungan untuk pengungsi orang-orang di timur Gaza City.
articles.originalTitle: Two Palestinians killed, several injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Two Palestinians killed, several injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza Two Palestinians were killed and several others injured on Thursday in Israeli attacks targeting multiple areas across the Gaza Strip. Citing eyewitnesses, Wafa news reported that an Israeli drone opened fire on a group of Palestinians on Salah al-Din Street, southeast of Gaza City, killing one person instantly. Another Palestinian was killed when Israeli artillery shelled the Zeitoun neighbourhood east of Gaza City with several rounds. Meanwhile, two Palestinians, including a child, were injured by Israeli gunfire at the Siham School west of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, and another was injured in an Israeli drone strike on Bahloul station, a shelter for displaced people east of Gaza City.

articles.title: Saudi, menteri asing Suriah bertemu untuk membahas penguatan keamanan regional
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Luar Negeri Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan menerima Menteri Luar Negeri Suriah dan Expatriates Asaad Al- Shaibani di kantor pusat kementerian di Riyadh pada hari Kamis. Selama pertemuan, mereka meninjau hubungan persaudaraan antara dua negara dan rakyat mereka, serta cara untuk meningkatkan kerjasama bersama dalam berbagai bidang. Mereka juga mendiskusikan perkembangan regional terbaru dan tantangan yang dihadapi wilayah tersebut. Para menteri menekankan pentingnya mengintensifkan koordinasi dan konsultasi mengenai isu-isu ini untuk berkontribusi untuk memperkuat keamanan daerah dan stabilitas. Dr. Saud Al- Sati, Wakil Menteri Luar Negeri untuk urusan politik, dan Pangeran Musab Al- Farhan, penasihat Menteri Luar Negeri untuk urusan politik, juga menghadiri pertemuan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi, Syrian foreign ministers meet to discuss strengthening regional security
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan received Syrian Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates Asaad Al-Shaibani at the ministry's headquarters in Riyadh on Thursday. During the meeting, they reviewed the fraternal relations between the two countries and their peoples, as well as ways to further enhance joint cooperation in various fields. They also discussed the latest regional developments and challenges facing the region. The ministers emphasized the importance of intensifying coordination and consultation regarding these issues to contribute to strengthening regional security and stability. Dr. Saud Al-Sati, undersecretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for political affairs, and Prince Musab Al-Farhan, advisor to the Minister of Foreign Affairs for political affairs, also attended the meeting.

articles.title: Pertahanan sipil mendesak hati-hati karena badai diatur untuk bertahan sampai Selasa
articles.description: RIYADH - Direktorat Umum Pertahanan Sipil mendorong orang untuk berlatih hati-hati dan tetap di tempat yang aman di tengah-tengah perkiraan badai petir terus memukul beberapa daerah Arab Saudi melalui Selasa depan. Ini disebut pada publik untuk menjauh dari daerah flood- rawan dan lembah, serta untuk menghindari berenang di dalamnya, dan mengikuti petunjuk dari pihak yang bersangkutan. Pusat Nasional untuk Meteorologi (NCM) mengatakan bahwa daerah Mekah akan terpengaruh oleh curah hujan menengah disertai dengan banjir kilat, hujan es, dan angin turun mengaduk debu dan pasir. Hal ini menambahkan bahwa Jazan, Asir, dan Al- Baha daerah akan terpengaruh dengan moderat untuk hujan deras disertai dengan banjir kilat, hujan es, dan angin turun mengaduk debu dan pasir.
articles.originalTitle: Civil Defense urges caution as thunderstorms set to persist through Tuesday
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The General Directorate of Civil Defense urged people to exercise caution and remain in safe places amid forecast of thunderstorms continue hitting some regions of Saudi Arabia through next Tuesday. It called on the public to stay away from flood-prone areas and valleys, as well as to avoid swimming in them, and follow instructions of the concerned authorities. The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) said that the Makkah region will be affected by moderate rainfall accompanied by flash floods, hail, and downdraft winds stirring up dust and sand. It added that Jazan, Asir, and Al-Baha regions will be affected by moderate to heavy rainfall accompanied by flash floods, hail, and downdraft winds stirring up dust and sand.

Juru bicara menghukum fasilitas sipil sebagai pelanggaran kemanusiaan internasional. Dia mengatakan serangan mencerminkan bahaya yang ditimbulkan oleh milisi Houthi terus bermusuhan tindakan. articles.title: Arab Saudi untuk memperkenalkan minimum domestik top-up pajak untuk multinasional efektif Jan. 1, 2027
articles.description: RIYADH - Sumbangan, Pajak dan Otoritas Bea Cukai (ZATCA) telah mengumumkan bahwa itu akan mulai menerapkan pajak minimum domestik (DMTT) efektif 1 Januari 2027. Pajak tersebut berlaku untuk entitas konstituen perusahaan multinasional (MNE) kelompok yang telah mengkonsolidasikan pendapatan tahunan setidaknya 750 juta euro atau setara dalam riyal Saudi. Otoritas tersebut menegaskan bahwa pajak akan berlaku untuk pertemuan entitas ambang pendapatan ini sesuai dengan pernyataan keuangan konsolidasikan dari entitas orangtua utama setidaknya dua dari empat tahun fiskal awal tahun di mana pajak diterapkan. Lingkup aplikasi terbatas pada entitas yang memenuhi kriteria eligibilitas dalam kelompok multinasional dan tidak diperpanjang ke semua perusahaan yang beroperasi di Arab Saudi. Oleh karena itu, itu termasuk murni perusahaan domestik yang tidak memiliki cabang di luar Arab Saudi atau tidak termasuk dalam kelompok MNE tertutup. Pajak ini didasarkan pada pernyataan keuangan konsolidasikan dari entitas orangtua terakhir setidaknya dalam dua dari empat tahun sebelum tahun fiskal di mana pajak berlaku, dalam langkah ditujukan untuk melindungi hak pajak Arab Saudi dan menjaga kecepatan dengan perkembangan pajak internasional. Menurut siaran pers yang dikeluarkan oleh ZATCA pada hari Kamis, pajak ini datang dalam kerangka kerja internasional yang bertujuan untuk menetapkan aturan minimum global di bawah Pillar Dua, dipimpin oleh Organisasi untuk Operasi dan Pengembangan Cotik Ekonomi (OECD) dan G20, dengan demikian berkontribusi pada perlindungan hak pajak Kerajaan atas keuntungan yang dihasilkan dalam yurisdiksi oleh kelompok MNE. ZATCA menjelaskan bahwa DMTT memungkinkan untuk koleksi pajak atas-atas dalam Kerajaan pada keuntungan kapanpun tingkat pajak yang efektif turun di bawah batas minimal global 15 persen, sesuai dengan aturan yang relevan. Persentase ini mengacu pada tingkat pajak minimal yang efektif pada keuntungan dan bukan pada total pendapatan perusahaan. Otoritas
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia to introduce domestic minimum top-up tax for multinationals effective Jan. 1, 2027
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) has announced that it will start implementing the domestic minimum top-up tax (DMTT) effective January 1, 2027. The tax applies to constituent entities of multinational enterprise (MNE) groups that have consolidated annual revenues of at least 750 million euro or its equivalent in Saudi riyal. The authority clarified that the tax will apply to entities meeting this revenue threshold according to the consolidated financial statements of the ultimate parent entity in at least two of the four fiscal years preceding the year in which the tax is applied. The scope of application is limited to entities that meet the eligibility criteria within multinational groups and does not extend to all companies operating in Saudi Arabia. Accordingly, it excludes purely domestic companies that do not have branches outside Saudi Arabia or do not belong to a covered MNE group. The tax is based on the consolidated financial statements of the ultimate parent entity in at least two of the four fiscal years preceding the fiscal year in which the tax applies, in a step aimed at protecting Saudi Arabia's tax rights and keeping pace with international tax developments. According to a press release issued by the ZATCA on Thursday, this tax comes within the framework of international trends aimed at establishing global minimum tax rules under Pillar Two, led by the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) and the G20, thereby contributing to the protection of the Kingdom's tax rights on profits generated within its jurisdiction by the covered MNE groups. ZATCA explained that the DMTT allows for the collection of the top-up tax within the Kingdom on profits whenever the effective tax rate falls below the established global minimum threshold of 15 percent, in accordance with the relevant rules. Perjanjian ini merupakan tonggak penting dalam perjalanan Inggris menuju Expo 2030 Riyadh, membangun kerangka kerja untuk eksekusi paviliun, pemrograman dan pengalaman pengunjung. Persetujuan terakhir ini menambahkan jumlah penandatangan Kontrak Partipatik yang meningkat, mencerminkan peningkatan momentum di balik Expo 2030 Riyadh dan nilai negara-negara yang menempatkan pada menjadi bagian dari itu. articles.originalTitle: UK signs Participation Contract for Expo 2030 Riyadh
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The United Kingdom has signed its Participation Contract for Expo 2030 Riyadh, confirming its place at one of the world’s largest global gatherings. Conceived as an exhibition for “All Nations”, the Great Exhibition brought countries together to showcase human progress, innovation and industry, establishing a model of international exchange that has continued to shape World Expos ever since.In 2030, the United Kingdom will continue that tradition in Riyadh, bringing its ideas, expertise and innovation to a global gathering centered on the future. Through its pavilion and wider participation, the UK will contribute to the exchange of ideas and international collaboration at the heart of Expo 2030 Riyadh and its theme, Foresight for Tomorrow. articles.originalTitle: Electric bikes enhance 'Absher Travel for Visitors' service at land border crossings
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The General Directorate of Passports is streamlining entry procedures for travelers at land border crossings by deploying electric bikes for passport security personnel to assist users of the "Absher Travel for Visitors" service. **media[2796780]**This service is available to citizens of Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries and visitors arriving in the Kingdom by land. The bikes allow passport security personnel to reach users faster so as to provide them with support. The directorate urged travelers to use the service via the Absher app. The service will become mandatory six months after October 26, 2026. It is designed to automate entry procedures for travelers and their vehicles by allowing them to complete travel requirements digitally before arriving at the border crossing across the Kingdom.

articles.title: Kedutaan Besar AS di Riyadh menyangkal laporan serangan pesawat tak berawak
articles.description: RIYADH - Kedutaan Besar AS di Riyadh pada Kamis menyangkal laporan dan klaim beredar di media sosial yang menyatakan bahwa tempatnya telah ditargetkan dalam serangan pesawat tak berawak, menegaskan bahwa klaim ini sepenuhnya palsu. "Klaim beredar online bahwa Kedutaan Besar AS di Riyadh telah terkena serangan pesawat tanpa awak hari ini adalah palsu," kata kedutaan dalam pernyataan pada akun X nya. Beberapa hari yang lalu, Kedutaan Besar mendesak warga AS untuk meninjau Departemen Perjalanan Negara untuk Amerika tentang Arab Saudi untuk informasi keamanan tambahan dan bimbingan perjalanan. "Amerika saat ini di Timur Tengah harus melatih tingkat kewaspadaan karena meningkatnya ancaman serangan bersenjata oleh Iran - mendukung upaya Houthis dan Iran untuk menargetkan pejabat pemerintah AS di wilayah tersebut", kata kedutaan dalam nasihatnya dikeluarkan pada Nov 14.
articles.originalTitle: US Embassy in Riyadh denies drone attack reports
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The US Embassy in Riyadh on Thursday categorically denied reports and claims circulating on social media alleging that its premises had been targeted in a drone attack, affirming that these claims were entirely false.“Claims circulating online that the U.S. Embassy in Riyadh has been hit by a drone strike today are false,” the embassy said in a statement on its X account. A few days ago, the Embassy urged U.S. citizens to review the Department of State’s travel advisory for Americans regarding Saudi Arabia for additional security information and travel guidance. “Americans currently in the Middle East should exercise heightened vigilance due to the increased threat of armed attacks by Iranian-supported Houthis and Iranian efforts to target U.S. government officials in the region,” the embassy said in its advisory issued on Nov. 14.

articles.title: Tabungan harta sebesar US Arabia jatuh $5.33 miliar menjadi $135.9 miliar pada bulan September
articles.description: WASHIINGTON - Arab Saudi kepemilikan Keamanan Keuangan AS jatuh sekitar $5.33 miliar di September 2026 menjadi $135.9 miliar, turun dari sekitar $141,2 miliar pada Agustus, menurut Departemen Keuangan AS. Kerajaan ini berada di peringkat 18 secara global di antara pemegang terbesar di US Treasury Securities. Data keuangan menunjukkan bahwa kepemilikan Arab Saudi terdiri dari 112.8 miliar dolar dalam sekuritas jangka panjang, akuntansi sebesar 83 persen total, dan $23,1 miliar dalam sekuritas jangka pendek, mewakili 17 persen sisanya. Secara global, Jepang berperingkat sebagai pemegang asing terbesar AS Treasury Securities dengan $1,06 triliun, diikuti oleh Inggris dengan sekitar $985.8 miliar dan Cina dengan $563,9 miliar. Sementara itu, kepemilikan investor asing dari US Treasury Securities menurun sekitar $75.5 miliar September hingga $9.24 triliun, menandai penurunan bulanan terbesar dalam enam bulan dan tingkat terendah dalam setahun.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s US Treasury holdings fall $5.33 billion to $135.9 billion in September
articles.originalDescription: WASHIINGTON — Saudi Arabia's holdings of US Treasury securities fell by approximately $5.33 billion in September 2026 to $135.9 billion, down from around $141.2 billion in August, according to the US Department of the Treasury. The Kingdom ranked 18th globally among the largest foreign holders of US Treasury securities. Treasury data showed that Saudi Arabia's holdings comprised $112.8 billion in long-term securities, accounting for 83 percent of the total, and $23.1 billion in short-term securities, representing the remaining 17 percent. Globally, Japan ranked as the largest foreign holder of US Treasury securities with $1.06 trillion, followed by the United Kingdom with approximately $985.8 billion and China with $563.9 billion. Meanwhile, foreign investors' holdings of US Treasury securities declined by approximately $75.5 billion in September to $9.24 trillion, marking the largest monthly drop in six months and the lowest level in a year.

Namun, ia merasa dipaksa untuk meninggalkan pada tahun 2019, percaya bahwa Houthis (juga dikenal sebagai Tuhan) berjuang untuk tujuan mulia di Yaman dan bahwa ia perlu untuk mendukung mereka. Mukhtar telah tinggal di daerah yang dikendalikan oleh pemerintah Arab Saudi, dan prospek untuk tinggal di sana lebih lama telah menjadi berbahaya. Kembali di desanya, Mukhtar telah bekerja sebagai petani dan paruh waktu broker, tapi ia kehilangan mata pencaharian ketika ia melarikan diri. articles.originalDescription: Cousin fights cousin as war in Yemen splits families down the middle Submitted by MEE correspondent on Wed, 11/18/2026 - 15:27 Communities fracture with loyalties split between the Houthis and the internationally recognised government A fighter loyal to Yemen's government on the front line around Mount al-Midan in Taiz province, on 26 October 2026 (Ahmad al-Basha/AFP) Off It wasn’t easy for Mukhtar, 45, to flee his home in the village where he was born and raised, 50 kilometres south of Taiz city. However, he felt forced to leave in 2019, believing that the Houthis (also known as Ansar Allah) were fighting for a noble cause in Yemen and that he needed to support them. Mukhtar had been living in an area controlled by the Saudi Arabia -backed government, and the prospect of staying there any longer had become dangerous. Many of his relatives, including his brothers and cousins, supported government forces, and he feared he might be detained, like so many others. “Many Ansar Allah supporters were detained or fled their villages; not just fighters, but civilians and sheikhs who supported them. So there was no choice but to flee my village and live in Ansar Allah-controlled areas,” Mukhtar told Middle East Eye. Back in his village, Mukhtar had worked as a farmer and part-time land broker, but he lost his livelihood when he fled. When he reached a Houthi area, he joined the group, convinced that they were driven not by money but by a desire to defend Islam. “Ansar Allah’s project is for the hereafter; they implement what is in the Quran rather than following the orders of foreign countries. Theirs is a project for the afterworld, not a project of mercenaries,” Mukhtar added. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia, UK sign MoU to strengthen veterinary medicine regulation and safety
articles.originalDescription: LONDON — The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the UK's Veterinary Medicines Directorate (VMD) to strengthen cooperation in the regulation of veterinary medicines and products. The agreement was signed by SFDA Chief Executive Officer Dr. Hisham bin Saad Al-Jadhey and VMD Chief Executive Abigail Seager on the sidelines of a meeting of the International Coalition of Medicines Regulatory Authorities (ICMRA) working group on the development of medicines for small populations and rare diseases, held in London. The MoU aims to facilitate the exchange of regulatory and supervisory information and expertise to improve regulatory practices and enhance safety. It also covers cooperation and the exchange of expertise on the regulation and availability of veterinary medicines, evaluation requirements, regulatory practices and laboratory testing. The agreement includes oversight of manufacturers and veterinary products before and after marketing, as well as drawing on the expertise of specialists from both sides and implementing training programs to strengthen technical and regulatory capabilities. articles.description: Dalam penilaian sejarah, ICJ menyimpulkan bahwa Myanmar melakukan genosida terhadap Muslim Rohingya Diberikan oleh Sondos Asem pada Thu, 11 / 19 / 2026 - 08: 16 Pengadilan Atas PBB menyatakan bahwa Iwasawa Yuji bertanggung jawab atas kasus genosida dalam kasus bersejarah yang akan membantu membentuk keputusan dalam kasus di Afrika Selatan melawan Pengadilan Internasional Israel (ICJ) Presiden Iwasawa Yuji membaca keputusan Pengadilan dalam kasus genosida yang dibawa oleh Gambia melawan Myanmar, dengan 11 Amerika Serikat, pada sidang umum di Istana Perdamaian di The Hague pada 19 November 2026 (McGREGen Jumelet) di Pengadilan Internasional di Pengadilan Internasional (ClJ) yang dilakukan oleh pasukan Islam pada Kamis). Pengadilan mengatakan niat genosida adalah "satu-satunya kesimpulan yang masuk akal" yang dapat diambil dari bukti perilaku Myanmar diambil secara keseluruhan dan bahwa Mynamar dimaksudkan untuk menghancurkan sebagian besar dari kelompok yang dilindungi. Pengadilan menemukan bahwa Rohingya adalah kelompok etnis dilindungi di bawah Pasal II dari Konvensi Genosida. Para juri mengatakan bukti-bukti yang mendukung perkiraan bahwa 10.000 Rohingya tewas selama operasi 2017. Pengadilan mengidentifikasi sekitar 815.000 Rohingya tinggal di Rakhine utara sebelum operasi sebagai bagian dari kelompok yang ditargetkan. Para juri mengatakan bahwa populasi cukup besar, baik dalam istilah mutlak dan relatif terhadap populasi Rohingya di Myanmar, untuk membentuk bagian substansial dari kelompok. Juga memegang bahwa tindakan pasukan keamanan Mynmar disebabkan oleh negara, dan memerintahkan Mynmar untuk memberikan balasan kepada kelompok dan korban individu, termasuk memastikan kelompok itu kembali ke negara asal mereka dan memfasilitasi pencarian untuk menghilang. "Pengadilan sepenuhnya yakin bahwa Myanmar melakukan tindakan di bawah Acts 2 (a) (b) dan (d) dengan maksud untuk menderoy substansial bagian Rohingya," yang diadakan ICJ. articles.originalTitle: In historic judgment, ICJ concludes that Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims
articles.originalDescription: In historic judgment, ICJ concludes that Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims Submitted by Sondos Asem on Thu, 11/19/2026 - 08:16 The UN's top court holds a state responsible for genocide in a historic precedent that will help shape the decision in South Africa's case against Israel International Court of Justice (ICJ) President Iwasawa Yuji reads the Court's judgment in the genocide case brought by Gambia against Myanmar, with 11 States intervening, at a public hearing at the Peace Palace in The Hague on 19 November 2026 (Jeroen Jumelet/AFP) Off Judges at the International Court of Justice (ICJ) in The Hague on Thursday concluded that Myanmar’s security forces committed genocide during the brutal 2017 “clearance operations” against its Muslim Rohingya minority. The court said genocidal intent was “the only reasonable inference” that could be drawn from the evidence of Myanmar's conduct taken as a whole and that Mynamar intended to destroy a substantial part of the protected group. The court found that the Rohingya are a protected ethnic group under Article II of the Genocide Convention. The judges said the evidence supported an estimate that 10,000 Rohingya were killed during the 2017 operations. The court identified the approximately 815,000 Rohingya living in northern Rakhine before the operations as the part of the group that was targeted. The judges said that population was large enough, both in absolute terms and relative to the Rohingya population in Myanmar, to constitute a substantial part of the group. It also held that the conduct of Myanmar’s security forces was attributable to the state, and ordered Mynmar to provide reparations to the group and individual victims, including ensuring the group's return to their home country and facilitating the search for the disappeared. articles.title: Saudi, menteri asing Yordania mendiskusikan ketegangan daerah, upaya de- eskalasi
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Luar Negeri Saudi Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan menerima panggilan dari rekan Yordania-nya, Ayman Safadi, pada hari Kamis untuk mendiskusikan pengembangan daerah dan upaya untuk meringankan ketegangan. Selama panggilan dengan Jordan Wakil Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Luar Negeri dan Expatriates, dua menteri meninjau terbaru perkembangan regional dan kerjasama upaya bertujuan untuk mengurangi ketegangan dan mengurangi eskalasi. Diskusi tersebut berfokus pada mendukung keamanan dan stabilitas di wilayah tersebut, menurut pernyataan yang dikeluarkan oleh Kementerian Luar Negeri Saudi.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi, Jordanian foreign ministers discuss regional tensions, de-escalation efforts
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan received a phone call from his Jordanian counterpart, Ayman Safadi, on Thursday to discuss regional developments and efforts to ease tensions. During the call with Jordan’s Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, the two ministers reviewed the latest regional developments and joint efforts aimed at easing tensions and reducing escalation. The discussions focused on supporting security and stability in the region, according to a statement issued by the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

articles.title: Putra Mahkota Saudi, komandan CENTCOM AS membahas hubungan militer, perkembangan regional
articles.description: RIYADH - Putra Mahkota Muhammad bin Salman bertemu dengan Laksamana Brad Cooper, Komandan Komando Pusat AS, di Riyadh untuk membahas hubungan bilateral dan perkembangan regional. Selama pertemuan pada hari Kamis, kedua belah pihak meninjau hubungan antara Arab Saudi dan Amerika Serikat, terutama di bidang militer, dan mendiskusikan perkembangan di wilayah tersebut. Pertemuan ini dihadiri oleh Pangeran Khalid bin Salman Abdulaziz, Menteri Pertahanan; Dr Musaed bin Mohammed Al- Aiban, Menteri Negara, Anggota Dewan Menteri dan Penasihat Keamanan Nasional; dan Jenderal Fayyad bin Hamed Al- Ruwaili, Kepala Staf Umum dan Bertindak Komandan Pasukan Gabungan.

articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met with Admiral Brad Cooper, Commander of U.S. Central Command, in Riyadh to discuss bilateral relations and regional developments. During the meeting on Thursday, the two sides reviewed relations between Saudi Arabia and the United States, particularly in the military field, and discussed developments in the region. The meeting was attended by Prince Khalid bin Salman bin Abdulaziz, Minister of Defense; Dr. Musaed bin Mohammed Al-Aiban, Minister of State, Member of the Council of Ministers and National Security Adviser; and General Fayyad bin Hamed Al-Ruwaili, Chief of the General Staff and Acting Commander of the Joint Forces.

articles.title: Update pagi
articles.description: Pagi pembaruan Selamat pagi pembaca Mata Timur Tengah, Berikut adalah terbaru perkembangan: Saudi Arabia 's berdaulat dana PIF Tower rusak dalam mogok pada hari Kamis, Reuters melaporkan tiga sumber. Sebelumnya, Saudi- dipimpin koalisi mengatakan bahwa hal itu ditangani dengan rudal Houthi ancaman diluncurkan ke arah ibukota Saudi, menambahkan bahwa penilaian awal menunjukkan bahwa kerusakan material berkelanjutan karena puing-puing. Pertahanan sipil Arab Saudi telah mengeluarkan beberapa peringatan selama beberapa jam terakhir, termasuk di ibukota Riyadh, pemerintah Khamis Mushait, Abha City, Wadi-Dawasir dan al- Sulayyil. Sementara itu, Saudi- dipimpin koalisi juga mengatakan bahwa kekuatan telah menanggapi sejumlah ancaman rudal Houthi di Riyadh dan kerajaan bagian selatan AS Presiden Donald Trump mengatakan bahwa Washington tidak "membutuhkan bantuan apapun" dari Cina atau Rusia untuk mengakhiri perang di Iran. Dia juga mengklaim bahwa rudal Teheran adalah "ke sekitar 12, 13% dari apa yang mereka, dan mereka ingin membuat kesepakatan, jadi saya tidak perlu bantuan. Saya tidak akan meminta bantuan apapun," tambahkan bahwa AS memiliki "kendali total Selat Hormuz". Putra Mahkota Saudi Mohammed bin Salman dan Menteri Pertahanan Pangeran Khalid bin Salman bin Abdullah bertemu kepala Komando Pusat AS di Riyadh. Delapan orang Palestina, termasuk empat wanita, terluka pada hari Rabu ketika pemukim Israel dilaporkan sengaja berlari mereka di lima lokasi yang berbeda di Kafr Qassem. Beberapa korban menderita cedera sementara dan dibawa ke rumah sakit.
articles.originalTitle: Morning update
articles.originalDescription: Morning update Good morning Middle East Eye readers, Here are the latest developments: Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund's PIF Tower was damaged in a strike on Thursday, Reuters reported citing three sources. Earlier, the Saudi-led coalition said that it dealt with a Houthi missile threat launched towards the Saudi capital, adding that an initial assessment showed that material damage was sustained due to debris. Saudi Arabia’s civil defence has issued several alerts over the past few hours, including in the capital of Riyadh, the Khamis Mushait governorate, Abha City, Wadi ad-Dawasir and al-Sulayyil. Meanwhile, the Saudi-led coalition also said that its forces have responded to a number of Houthi missile threats in Riyadh and the kingdom's southern region US President Donald Trump said that Washington does not "need any help" from China or Russia to end the war on Iran. He also claimed that Tehran's missiles are "down to about 12, 13% of what they were, and they want to make a deal, so I don’t need help. I’m not going to go in asking for any help," adding that the US has "total control of the Hormuz Strait". Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Minister of Defense Prince Khalid bin Salman bin Abdulaziz met the chief of the US Central Command in Riyadh. Eight Palestinians, including four women, were injured on Wednesday when an Israeli settler reportedly deliberately ran them over at five different locations in Kafr Qassem. Several victims sustained moderate injuries and were taken to hospital.

articles.title: Koalisi menghancurkan dua platform peluncuran rudal Houthi balistik yang digunakan untuk mencoba menyerang Arab Saudi
articles.description: RIYADH - Koalisi untuk mendukung Legitimasi di Yaman menghancurkan dua platform peluncuran rudal balistik Houthi di Yaman yang mengatur Saada dan Dhamar setelah mereka digunakan untuk mencoba menyerang daerah selatan Arab Saudi dan Riyadh. Juru bicara Koalisi Mayor Jenderal Turki Al- Malki mengumumkan Kamis pagi bahwa Koalisi telah menghancurkan platform peluncuran rudal di Saada. Al- Malki mengatakan milisi Houthi telah menggunakan platform dalam upaya serangan di Arab Saudi daerah selatan awal hari itu. Kemudian di pagi hari, Al- Malki mengumumkan penghancuran lain peluncuran rudal platform di Dhamar. Menurut Koalisi, milisi Houthi telah menggunakan platform dalam percobaan serangan terhadap Riyadh hari itu.
articles.originalTitle: Coalition destroys two Houthi ballistic missile launch platforms used in attempted attacks on Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen destroyed two Houthi ballistic missile launch platforms in the Yemeni governorates of Saada and Dhamar after they were used in attempted attacks on Saudi Arabia’s southern region and Riyadh. Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Malki announced early Thursday morning that the Coalition had destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform in Saada. Al-Malki said the Houthi militia had used the platform in an attempted attack on Saudi Arabia’s southern region earlier that day. Later in the morning morning, Al-Malki announced the destruction of another ballistic missile launch platform in Dhamar. According to the Coalition, the Houthi militia had used the platform in an attempted attack on Riyadh that day.

articles.title: Mahmoud Khalil menuntut Departemen Kehakiman AS atas kegagalan untuk mengungkapkan korespondensi dengan hakim imigrasi
articles.description: Mahmoud Khalil menggugat Departemen Kehakiman AS atas kegagalan untuk mengungkapkan korespondensi dengan hakim imigrasi Mantan mahasiswa lulusan Columbia Mahmoud Khalil menggugat Departemen Kehakiman AS (DOJ) pada hari Rabu karena kegagalannya untuk mengungkapkan dokumen yang menunjukkan apa yang pejabat pemerintah miliki dengan hakim imigrasi dan panel banding dalam kasusnya. Ini mengikuti kegagalan administrasi untuk mematuhi permintaan UU Kebebasan Informasi Khadil yang diajukan pada bulan Mei, atas dasar penyelidikan New York Times yang mengungkapkan kasusnya dipercepat dan menghasilkan pengembalian anggota Dewan Imigrasi (BIA). Pada bulan April, BIA mengeluarkan apa yang disebut "perintah terakhir dari penghapusan" untuk Khalil, berarti dia bisa dideportasi dari AS. Namun, ia tidak diizinkan untuk ditangkap kembali sementara kasus bebas pidato di pengadilan federal terus. Para hakim yang membentuk BIA tidak beroperasi sebagai pengadilan independen. BIA berada di bawah kendali pemerintah cabang eksekutif - dalam hal ini, pemerintahan Trump. Hal yang sama berlaku untuk semua pengadilan imigrasi, yang beroperasi di bawah lingkup DOJ. "Pemerintahan Trump bertekad untuk mendeportasi saya untuk mencegah orang lain untuk berbicara tentang pembebasan Palestina, sehingga mereka mencurangi pengadilan imigrasi terhadap saya", kata Khalil dalam pernyataan pada hari Rabu dari pengacaranya di Klinik Hak Imigran NYU, Pusat Hak Konstitusional, dan Van Der Hout LLP. "Sekarang mereka mencoba untuk menyembunyikan kesalahan mereka. Saya menuntut kebenaran atas kebohongan mereka, korupsi, dan mengabaikan hak-hak konstitusi yang memalukan". Khalil telah mencari catatan dan dokumen menunjukkan keterlibatan apa, jika ada, anggota dewan banding, pejabat federal lainnya, atau aktor swasta telah dalam keputusan hakim imigrasi. Kasusnya, pengacaranya mengatakan, diperlakukan "tidak normal di setiap tingkat". Baca lebih lanjut: Mahmoud Khalil menuntut Departemen Kehakiman AS atas kegagalan
articles.originalTitle: Mahmoud Khalil sues US Justice Department over failure to disclose correspondence with immigration judge
articles.originalDescription: Mahmoud Khalil sues US Justice Department over failure to disclose correspondence with immigration judge Former Columbia University graduate student Mahmoud Khalil sued the US Department of Justice (DOJ) on Wednesday for its failure to disclose documents showing what correspondence government officials may have had with the immigration judge and the appeal panel in his case. This follows the administration’s failure to comply with a Freedom of Information Act request Khalil submitted in May, on the heels of a New York Times investigation that revealed his case was expedited and resulted in the recusal of members of the Board of Immigration Appeals (BIA). In April, the BIA issued what it called a "final order of removal" for Khalil, meaning he could be deported from the US. However, he is not permitted to be re-arrested while his free speech case in federal court continues. The judges who make up the BIA do not operate as an independent judiciary. The BIA falls under the control of the executive branch of government - in this case, the Trump administration. The same applies to all immigration courts, which operate under the purview of the DOJ. “The Trump administration is determined to deport me to deter others from speaking out for Palestinian liberation, so they rigged the immigration court against me,” Khalil said in a statement on Wednesday from his lawyers at NYU Immigrant Rights Clinic, the Center for Constitutional Rights, and Van Der Hout LLP. “Now they’re trying to conceal their misconduct. I’m suing to shed light on their lies, corruption, and disgraceful disregard for constitutional rights.” Khalil had sought records and documents showing what involvement, if any, members of the appeals board, other federal officials, or private actors had in the immigration judge’s decisions. His case, his lawyers said, was treated "abnormally at every level". Read more: Mahmoud Khalil sues US Justice Department over failure to disclose correspondence with immigration jud

articles.originalTitle: Israeli court extends detention of Gaza doctor Hussam Abu Safia
articles.originalDescription: Israeli court extends detention of Gaza doctor Hussam Abu Safia Dr Hussam Abu Safia will remain in Israeli detention for at least another six months, after a court extended his detention without bringing any charges against him. The decision, handed down by a court in Beersheba, came despite mounting concerns over the deteriorating health of the Palestinian doctor, who was seized by Israeli forces in late 2024 after refusing to abandon the Kamal Adwan Hospital he headed in response to Israeli evacuation orders. Physicians for Human Rights Israel said the court had rejected a request for his release filed by his lawyer. articles.description: ROME - Saudi Menteri Kesehatan Fahad Al- Jalajel dimulai pada hari Rabu kunjungan resmi ke Italia untuk memperkuat hubungan bilateral, memperluas kerjasama kesehatan, dan menjelajahi kesempatan untuk membangun kemitraan strategis antara dua negara. Selama kunjungan dua hari, menteri dijadwalkan untuk mengadakan pertemuan tingkat tinggi dengan pejabat sektor kesehatan Italia dan para pemimpin untuk mendiskusikan kerjasama dalam kesehatan maju dan khusus, investasi kesehatan, kesehatan digital, bioteknologi, dan pengembangan tenaga kesehatan. Al- Jalajel juga akan mengunjungi beberapa lembaga kesehatan dan penelitian untuk belajar tentang praktek Italia dan keahlian pertukaran dalam layanan kesehatan berkembang. Kunjungan ini datang dalam kerangka kerja hubungan kuat antara Arab Saudi dan Italia dan mencerminkan komitmen kedua negara untuk memperkuat kemitraan, penyelesaian kesepakatan, dan bertukar pengetahuan untuk memajukan sektor kesehatan mereka dan menciptakan kesempatan untuk investasi dan inovasi.
articles.originalTitle: Health minister embarks on Italian visit to strengthen health partnerships
articles.originalDescription: ROME — Saudi Minister of Health Fahad Al-Jalajel began on Wednesday an official visit to Italy to strengthen bilateral relations, expand health cooperation, and explore opportunities to establish strategic partnerships between the two countries.During the two-day visit, the minister is scheduled to hold high-level meetings with Italian health sector officials and leaders to discuss cooperation in advanced and specialized healthcare, health investment, digital health, biotechnology, and health workforce development.Al-Jalajel will also visit several healthcare and research institutions to learn about Italian practices and exchange expertise in developing health services. The visit comes within the framework of the strong relations between Saudi Arabia and Italy and reflects both countries’ commitment to strengthening partnerships, concluding agreements, and exchanging knowledge to advance their health sectors and create opportunities for investment and innovation.

articles.title: Riyadh Emir meresmikan 25 taman baru di ibukota kota
articles.description: RIYADH - Emir Pangeran Riyadh bin Bandar meresmikan 25 taman baru yang dikembangkan oleh Riyadh Mayoralty di ibukota lingkungan pada tahun 2026. Walikota Riyadh Pangeran Faisal bin Abdullah bin Ayyaf dan beberapa pejabat menghadiri upacara perdana diadakan di Qasr Al- Hukm di Riyadh pada hari Rabu. Emir menyaksikan presentasi tentang upaya mayoralty untuk memperluas ruang hijau, meningkatkan lanskap kota, dan meningkatkan kualitas hidup. Walikota telah membuka 144 taman sejak 2021. Pangeran Faisal memuji dukungan pemimpin Saudi untuk pengembangan kota. Dia menekankan pentingnya untuk terus mengembangkan taman dan fasilitas publik untuk memenuhi kebutuhan warga dan menjaga kecepatan dengan pertumbuhan daerah tersebut, sejalan dengan Saudi Vision 2030.
articles.originalTitle: Riyadh Emir inaugurates 25 new parks in capital city
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Emir of Riyadh Prince Faisal bin Bandar inaugurated 25 new parks developed by Riyadh Mayoralty across the capital’s neighborhoods in 2026. Mayor of Riyadh Prince Faisal bin Abdulaziz bin Ayyaf and several officials attended the inaugural ceremony held at Qasr Al-Hukm in Riyadh on Wednesday. The Emir watched a presentation on the mayoralty’s efforts to expand green spaces, improve the urban landscape, and enhance quality of life. The mayoralty has opened 144 parks since 2021.Prince Faisal praised the Saudi leadership’s support for urban development. He stressed the importance of continuing to develop parks and public facilities to meet residents’ needs and keep pace with the region’s growth, in line with Saudi Vision 2030.

articles.title: Pasukan Israel mengatakan operasi darat di Gaza untuk membongkar terowongan Hamas
articles.description: Pasukan Israel mengatakan operasi darat di Gaza untuk membongkar Hamas terowongan Israel mengatakan pada hari Rabu bahwa mereka meluncurkan operasi militer baru di Gaza untuk membongkar terowongan sebelah barat dari "Yellow Line". Militer Israel mengatakan dalam pernyataan bahwa tentara dan lembaga keamanan internal Shin Bet meluncurkan operasi gabungan untuk "membongkar terowongan teror barat dari Garis Kuning yang menimbulkan ancaman langsung dan langsung kepada pasukan IDF". Garis Kuning memisahkan daerah yang dikendalikan Palestina dan Israel di Gaza, dengan tentara Israel mengatakan garis kuning ini mengontrol lebih dari 60 persen dari strip, dan berniat untuk melanjutkan pekerjaannya tanpa batas. Sumber keamanan Gaza mengatakan kepada AFP ada "serangan artileri Israel intens" di utara kamp pengungsi Nuseyat dan melaporkan kendaraan militer Israel di pusat Gaza "di tengah baku tembak dan serangan udara sejak tengah hari", ketika Israel menyerang seluruh Gaza pada hari Rabu.
articles.originalTitle: Israeli forces say ground operation in Gaza to dismantle Hamas tunnels
articles.originalDescription: Israeli forces say ground operation in Gaza to dismantle Hamas tunnels Israeli forces said on Wednesday that they launched a new military operation in Gaza to dismantle a tunnel west of the "Yellow Line". The Israeli military said in a statement that the army and the internal security agency Shin Bet launched the joint operation to "dismantle a terror tunnel west of the Yellow Line that posed an immediate and direct threat to IDF troops". The Yellow Line separates the Palestinian and Israeli-controlled areas in Gaza, with the Israeli army saying it controls more than 60 percent of the strip, and intends to continue its occupation indefinitely. A Gaza security source told AFP there was "intense Israeli artillery shelling" north of Nuseirat refugee camp and reported Israeli military vehicles in central Gaza "amid ongoing gunfire and airstrikes since midday", as Israeli strikes across Gaza killed three people on Wednesday.

articles.title: 'Nyalakan spigot senjata': Arab Saudi meminta mitra untuk mencegah Houthis
articles.description: 'Hidupkan spigot senjata': Arab Saudi meminta mitra untuk mencegah Houthis Diberikan oleh Sean Mathews pada Wed, 11 / 18 / 2026 - 18: 53 Dalam pertemuan dengan pemerintah barat dan Turki, pejabat Saudi mengatakan mereka berada di pasar untuk kemampuan pencegahan baru A Saudi K239 Chunmoo kendaraan ditampilkan selama parade militer menandai Hari Nasional Saudi ke-96 di Riyadh, pada 22 September 2026 (Fayez Nureldine / AFP) Off Arab Saudi mengumpulkan mitra-mitra barat di Riyadh minggu ini dengan permintaan: menyalakan senjata-senjata spigot untuk membantu kerajaan dalam perang dengan Housewida ini, tiga pertemuan di Timur. Sumber-sumber mengatakan bahwa Arab Saudi sedang mencari persediaan senjata untuk "mencegah" Houthi serangan, karena menyiapkan untuk drawn- out konflik. "Arab Saudi ada di pasar", salah satu pejabat mengatakan MEE. Pencarian Arab Saudi untuk persenjataan segar juga diperpanjang ke sekutu Timur Tengah yang merupakan bagian dari aliansi Mekkah Pact. Delegasi pengadaan Saudi yang dipimpin oleh Bandar al- Khorayef, presiden bertindak dari Otoritas Umum untuk Industri Militer, mengunjungi Turki minggu lalu dan bertemu dengan Haluk Gorgun, ketua lembaga pertahanan Turki. Delegasi ini termasuk perwakilan dari lusinan perusahaan Saudi. Seorang pejabat Turki mengatakan kepada MEE bahwa Ankara melakukan yang terbaik untuk membantu Riyadh sebanyak mungkin dengan menyediakan peralatan sebagai pertunjukan solidaritas. Seorang pejabat regional yang terpisah mengatakan MEE bahwa Arab Saudi sedang mencari untuk memperoleh apa pun yang mereka bisa menemukan di pasar, termasuk jangka pendek sistem pertahanan udara efektif terhadap drone. "Orang Saudi ingin apa pun yang kita miliki di rak", kata orang itu. Arab Saudi sudah menjadi salah satu pemboros pertahanan tertinggi di dunia, mengalokasikan setidaknya 6,5 persen dari PDB untuk pengeluaran militer pada tahun 2025, menurut Institut Penelitian Perdamaian Internasional Stockholm. The sources said that Saudi Arabia is seeking weapons supplies to “deter” Houthi attacks, as it prepares for a drawn-out conflict. “Saudi Arabia is in the market,” one of the officials told MEE. Saudi Arabia's search for fresh armaments has also extended to Middle Eastern allies that are part of the Mecca Pact alliance. A Saudi procurement delegation led by Bandar al-Khorayef, the acting president of the General Authority for Military Industries, visited Turkey last week and met with Haluk Gorgun, the chairman of Turkey’s defence procurement agency. The delegation included representatives from dozens of Saudi companies. A Turkish official told MEE that Ankara was doing its best to help Riyadh as much as possible by providing equipment as a show of solidarity. A separate regional official told MEE that Saudi Arabia was looking to acquire anything they could find on the market, including short-range air defence systems effective against drones. “The Saudis want whatever we have on the shelf,” the person said. Saudi Arabia is already one of the highest defence spenders in the world, allocating at least 6.5 percent of its GDP to military spending in 2025, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute. articles.originalDescription: Houthis say they targeted King Khalid Airport and financial centre in Riyadh Yemen's Houthi forces spokesperson Yahya Saree said that the group had targeted King Khalid International Airport and the financial centre in Riyadh with a large number of cruise missiles on Wednesday, Reuters reported. articles.description: Serangan udara Israel menargetkan Qantara Israel selatan Lebanon telah menargetkan kota Qantara di Marjayoun, Lebanon selatan, dengan serangan udara, Al Jazeera melaporkan pada hari Rabu. Sebelumnya, Menteri Pertahanan Isreali Israel Katz mengatakan bahwa negara akan terus menduduki Lebanon, Gaza dan Suriah tanpa batas sampai semua kelompok bersenjata dihancurkan.

articles.title: Komite PBB mengadopsi resolusi rancangan tentang bantuan Palestina, hak milik dan pendudukan Israel
articles.description: Komite PBB mengadopsi resolusi rancangan untuk bantuan Palestina, hak-hak properti, dan pendudukan Israel kepada Komite Umum PBB yang diadopsi pada hari Rabu tiga penyelesaian tentang dukungan untuk mandat dan operasi PBB untuk pengungsi Palestina (UNRWA), hak-hak pengungsi Palestina untuk properti mereka, dan penegasan kembali dari illegalitas pendudukan Israel di wilayah Palestina, termasuk Yerusalem Timur dan Golan Suriah. Gerakan ini disambut oleh Kementerian Luar Negeri Palestina dan Expatriates, menurut badan berita Wafa, yang menyerukan komunitas internasional untuk menghormati kewajibannya terhadap hukum internasional dan resolusi PBB untuk melindungi hak-hak rakyat Palestina.
articles.originalTitle: UN committee adopts draft resolutions on Palestinian aid, property rights and Israeli occupation
articles.originalDescription: UN committee adopts draft resolutions on Palestinian aid, property rights and Israeli occupation The United Nations General Assembly's Fourth Committee adopted on Wednesday three draft resolutions concerning support for the mandate and operations of the UN Agency for Palestinian refugees (UNRWA), the rights of Palestinian refugees to their properties, and the reaffirmation of the illegality of Israeli occupation of Palestinian territory, including East Jerusalem and the Syrian Golan. The move was welcomed by Palestine's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, according to Wafa news agency, which called on the international community to honour its obligations to international law and UN resolutions to protect the rights of the Palestinian people.

articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Luar Negeri menyatakan kutukan Arab Saudi dan pengungkapan pemerintah pendudukan Israel terus terang pelanggaran di wilayah tersebut, yang baru-baru ini serangan Israel ke daerah pedesaan Quneitra Suriah dan pemerintah Daraa. "Arab Saudi mengungkapkan penolakan kategorik dari pendudukan Israel pasukan 'intimidasi perdamaian-mencintai warga sipil dan pelanggaran hukum internasional dan norma," kata Menteri dalam sebuah pernyataan. Mentri ini menekankan pentingnya menghentikan inflasi Israel terhadap kedaulatan wilayah Suriah dan mematuhi Perjanjian Disengagement 1974 untuk mempertahankan keamanan dan stabilitas di wilayah tersebut. Kerajaan juga mendukung kedaulatan dan integritas teritorial Suriah.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia condemns Israeli incursions into Syria
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed Saudi Arabia's condemnation and denunciation of the Israeli occupation authorities' continued blatant violations in the region, most recently the Israeli incursions into the rural areas of Syria's Quneitra and Daraa governorates."Saudi Arabia expresses its categorical rejection of the Israeli occupation forces' intimidation of peace-loving civilians and violations of international laws and norms,” the ministry said in a statement. The ministry stressed the importance of halting Israeli infringements on the sovereignty of Syrian territory and adhering to the 1974 Disengagement Agreement to preserve security and stability in the region. The Kingdom also reiterated its support for Syria's sovereignty and territorial integrity.

Dalam penyelidikan yang diterbitkan, CBC tidak mengidentifikasi pihak ketiga atau lokasinya, mengatakan bahwa "akuntabilitas terletak pada pengembang aplikasi". articles.originalTitle: Tim Hortons app sending user data to Israeli cybertech company, advocacy group confirms
articles.originalDescription: Tim Hortons app sending user data to Israeli cybertech company, advocacy group confirms Submitted by MEE staff on Wed, 11/18/2026 - 15:56 Coffee chain has been sharing sensitive user data with Forter, a company founded by Israeli military intelligence alumni Tim Hortons, a coffee chain popular in Canada, is seen in Brampton, Ontario, on 27 May 2026 (Mike Campbell/NurPhoto) Off The Tim Hortons app has been sharing sensitive user data with Forter, an Israeli cybertech company founded by alumni of the Israeli military's infamous intelligence Unit 8200, Canadians for Justice and Peace in the Middle East (CJPME) has confirmed. An investigation by the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation (CBC) published last week found that the coffee chain app sends data to third-party companies overseas as soon as the app is launched. Joel Reardon, an associate professor in the department of computer science at the University of Calgary who scanned the app's network traffic with his team, said the third party built into the app receives enough information to create a digital fingerprint of each device that can be identified later. Some of the data includes the device's name and unique identifier, details of the device's camera and sensors, and the names of Wi-Fi routers nearby, which can be used to determine the user's location. "This was beyond the pale," Reardon told the CBC. Celeste Rollason, an independent analyst, told the CBC that the third party brands itself as a fraud protection service, but the amount of data collected "seems quite excessive" for simply purchasing a cup of coffee. In its published investigation, CBC did not identify the third party or its location, saying that "accountability rests with the app developer". articles.description: "Aku masih mencintaimu, sobat": panggilan terakhir Biden dengan konflik Netanyahu dengan pernyataan memo oleh staf MEE pada Wed, 11 / 18 / 2026 - 16: 29 presiden AS mengatakan kepada Netanyahu dia 'berani', bertentangan dengan penggambaran sendiri dari hubungan dalam buku A salinan mantan Presiden Joe Biden 's memoir,' Promise Me, 'Amerika,' yang sedang dipajang dengan Politis dan Prose Boodwood di Washington, bagaimana Presiden-nya masih menelepon 20-nya pada tanggal 27, "" Anda telah melalui neraka. Saya tidak bisa mengatakan betapa saya menghargai Anda dan apa yang telah Anda lalui ", kata Biden, sesuai dengan transkrip percakapan yang diperoleh oleh The Jerusalem Post." Aku tahu kita sudah tidak setuju pada kesempatan tapi, kau tahu... aku masih mencintaimu, sobat ". Dia melanjutkan:" Saya tidak tahu bagaimana Anda telah melakukan semuanya... Lain kali aku pikir aku punya pekerjaan yang sulit, aku akan memikirkanmu... kau orang yang baik... aku mengagumimu. Butuh banyak keberanian untuk melakukan apa yang Anda lakukan. "Namun pujian Biden untuk konflik Netanyahu dengan bagaimana ia menggambarkan hubungan mereka dalam memoarnya, Promise Me, Amerika, menurut Newsweek dan outlet lainnya yang diperoleh kutipan buku. Pujian Biden untuk Netanyahu datang saat pemimpin Israel menghadapi surat perintah Pengadilan Pidana Internasional atas kejahatan terhadap kemanusiaan atas genosida Israel di Gaza. Korban keseluruhan orang Palestina tewas sejak Israel meluncurkan serangan pada enclave pada Oktober 2023 berdiri di lebih dari 74.644, dengan 175.978 lainnya terluka. articles.title: PIF bernama paling berharga di dunia kekayaan merek untuk tahun ketiga berturut-turut
articles.description: RIYADH - Dana Investasi Arab Saudi (PIF) ranking sebagai merek dana berdaulat paling berharga di dunia untuk tahun ketiga berturut-turut, menurut Brand Finance. Peringkat ini mencerminkan upaya PIF untuk membangun kepercayaan diri dalam merek global, yang nilainya naik dari $1,183 miliar di tahun 2025 sampai $1,2 miliar pada tahun 2026, sementara ratingnya meningkat dari A + ke AA-. Merek ini adalah yang paling berharga di antara dana kekayaan berdaulat dan lembaga investasi global di luar Amerika Serikat dan Eropa, dan hanya berdaulat dana merek dinilai di atas $1 miliar. PIF juga peringkat di peringkat teratas dari lembaga investasi global dan dana berdaulat, sebagai satu-satunya dana berdaulat dalam kategori ini, berdasarkan rasio nilai merek untuk aset investasi, metrik yang mencerminkan kinerja investasi. Rekomendasi investasi untuk kemitraan dengan PIF mencapai dua kali rata-rata sektor dari 2024 sampai 2026. Menurut Brand Finance, prestasi dana mencerminkan transformasi selama dekade- panjang yang telah memposisikan itu di antara investor paling berpengaruh di dunia. Memimpin merek global diharapkan untuk memperkuat lebih lanjut selama fase penciptaan berharga dari 2026- 2030 strategi, yang berfokus pada investasi aktif, menarik modal swasta, menghasilkan keuntungan, dan memastikan keunggulan institusi dan pemerintahan yang kuat. Peringkat internasional mencerminkan berdiri global dana kekayaan berdaulat dan besar lembaga keuangan dan memperkuat kehadiran mereka di pasar internasional. Selain menilai kinerja keuangan dan institusional, mereka bekerja sebagai pilar strategis untuk membangun kepercayaan diri institusi di tengah fluktuasi ekonomi global. PIF adalah pengemudi utama dari transformasi ekonomi berkelanjutan di Kerajaan dan kontributor utama untuk mencapai Saudi Vision 2030. Di samping upaya untuk mengembangkan sektor strategis dan diversifikasi dan mengembangkan ekonomi lokal, peringkat internasional semakin memperkuat berdiri global dan memperluas
articles.originalTitle: PIF named world’s most valuable sovereign wealth fund brand for third year in a row
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF) ranked as the world’s most valuable sovereign wealth fund brand for the third consecutive year, according to Brand Finance. The ranking reflects PIF’s efforts to build confidence in its global brand, whose value rose from $1.183 billion in 2025 to $1.2 billion in 2026, while its rating improved from A+ to AA-. The brand is the most valuable among sovereign wealth funds and global investment institutions outside the United States and Europe, and the only sovereign wealth fund brand valued above $1 billion. PIF also ranks in the top tier of global investment institutions and sovereign wealth funds, as the only sovereign fund in this category, based on the ratio of its brand value to its investment assets, a metric that reflects investment performance. Investor recommendations for partnerships with PIF reached twice the sector average from 2024 to 2026. According to Brand Finance, the fund’s achievements reflect a decade-long transformation that has positioned it among the world’s most influential investors. Its global brand leadership is expected to strengthen further during the value-creation phase of its 2026-2030 strategy, which focuses on active investment, attracting private capital, generating returns, and ensuring institutional excellence and robust governance. International ratings reflect the global standing of sovereign wealth funds and major financial institutions and bolster their presence in international markets. Beyond assessing financial and institutional performance, they serve as a strategic pillar for building institutional confidence amid global economic fluctuations. PIF is a key driver of sustainable economic transformation in the Kingdom and a major contributor to achieving Saudi Vision 2030. articles.originalTitle: Herding: A living legacy woven into Saudi Arabia’s social fabric
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Herding, an ancient profession deeply woven into life in the Arabian Peninsula, has shaped its social, economic, and cultural ways of life and remains present across the Kingdom's regions, both as an economic activity and as a heritage passed down through generations. Bedouins historically relied on camels and sheep for meat, milk, wool, and hides, and on camels for transport and trade. Herders moved seasonally in search of pasture and water, guided by environmental conditions. **media[2796390]** The profession is part of the Arabian Peninsula's cultural heritage, carrying inherited knowledge of the land, water sources, forage plants, and livestock care, and fostering values of cooperation and the sharing of expertise. Camels and desert life are prominent themes in Arab poetry, literature, and proverbs, from descriptions of journeys and desert encampments to oral arts tied to herding. Among them is Alheda'a, the rhythmic calls herders use to communicate with and guide their camels, which UNESCO inscribed in 2022 on its Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity as "Alheda’a, oral traditions of calling camel flocks." **media[2796388]** Herding has evolved with technology. GPS devices can track animals' locations and movements, while modern veterinary tools support examinations, diagnosis, and early disease detection, improving herd health and reducing losses. The profession calls for skills in managing herds, understanding their feed and water needs, choosing grazing sites, monitoring animals' health and behavior, protecting them from risks, and coping with varied environments. Tools range from staffs and trained dogs to modern communication and tracking equipment, depending on the livestock and terrain. Herding retains its place in the Kingdom's economic and social life, supported by efforts to develop livestock resources and preserve the cultural heritage linked to it.

articles.title: Utara Bentuk pariwisata arteri menghubungkan 16 sejarah, tujuan alam lebih dari 1.200 km
articles.description: RIYADH - Perkembangan jaringan jalan the Kingdom, yang meluas lebih dari 73.000 kilometer, telah berkontribusi pada peringkat pertama Kingdom secara global di Indeks Konektivitas Jaringan Jalan, menurut laporan dari Forum Kompetitivitas Dunia. Hal ini telah meningkatkan konektivitas antara kota-kota dan pemerintah dan difasilitasi perjalanan melintasi wilayah-wilayah Kingdom. Otoritas Umum Roads mencatat bahwa Trail Utara merupakan tambahan berharga bagi sektor pariwisata Kerajaan sebagai produk pariwisata memperluas sekitar 1.200 kilometer dan menghubungkan 16 tujuan wisata di Riyadh, Qassim, dan daerah Hail. Penentuan jejak ini melebihi yang dilakukan sebagai jalan raya, menawarkan pengalaman menyeluruh yang meliputi lebih dari 130 kegiatan wisata, seperti petualangan padang pasir, mendaki gunung, kunjungan budaya dan warisan, pengalaman pertanian dan pedesaan, cicipan makanan lokal, dan kerajinan tradisional. Ini juga termasuk 15 peternakan, sementara lebih dari 335 pemandu wisata membantu pengunjung mengeksplorasi sejarah dan situs alami dan menemukan identitas budaya dari tujuan. Jejak menyoroti warisan sejarah dan peradaban daerah yang ia lewati, memperpanjang ke situs arkeologi dan prasasti rock di Jubbah, yang terdaftar sebagai UNESCO World Heritage Site. Menara Al- Marqab atau Ragbah Menara Pengawal adalah menara pengawas bersejarah terletak di Raghbah di daerah Riyadh, ditampilkan sepanjang rute Trail Utara. Menara pengawas sejarah silinder di Najd yang berada di awal abad ke-13 berdiri setinggi 22 meter dalam enam bagian. Dimana alam bertemu pesona masa lalu, Ragbah Menara Pengawal menceritakan kisah-kisah warisan yang kaya.
articles.originalTitle: Northern Trail forms tourism artery connecting 16 historical, natural destinations over 1,200 km
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The development of the Kingdom's road network, which extends for more than 73,000 kilometers, has contributed to the Kingdom ranking first globally in the Road Network Connectivity Index, according to reports by the World Competitiveness Forum. This has enhanced connectivity between cities and governorates and facilitated travel across the Kingdom's regions. The Roads General Authority noted that the Northern Trail represents a valuable addition to the Kingdom's tourism sector as a tourism product extending approximately 1,200 kilometers and connecting 16 tourist destinations across Riyadh, Qassim, and Hail regions. The trail's significance goes beyond serving as a road, offering a comprehensive experience that includes more than 130 tourism activities, such as desert adventures, mountain hiking, cultural and heritage visits, agricultural and rural experiences, local food tasting, and traditional crafts. It also includes 15 farms, while more than 335 tour guides help visitors explore historical and natural sites and discover the cultural identity of the destinations. The trail highlights the historical and civilizational heritage of the regions it passes through, extending to the archaeological sites and rock inscriptions in Jubbah, which is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.Al-Marqab Tower or Raghbah Watchtower is a historic watchtower located in Raghbah in the Riyadh region, featured along Northern Trail route. The cylindrical historical watchtower in Najd dating back to the early 13th century AH, standing around 22 meters tall in six sections. Where nature meets the charm of the past, Raghbah Watchtower tells stories of a rich heritage.

articles.title: Qiwa menguraikan 4 kondisi untuk mentransfer layanan karyawan
articles.description: RIYADH - platform Qiwa, berafiliasi dengan Kementerian Sumber Daya Manusia dan Pengembangan Sosial, telah diklarifikasi persyaratan regulasi mengatur transfer layanan karyawan, menguraikan empat kondisi kunci yang harus dipenuhi untuk menyelesaikan proses. Kondisi ini termasuk memegang izin tinggal yang sah (iqama), sebagai nomor perbatasan saja tidak cukup; tidak memiliki ijin kerja yang valid dengan visa keluar terakhir yang diterbitkan atau visa keluar terakhir yang kadaluarsa; dan memperoleh persetujuan karyawan ke kedua permintaan transfer layanan dan permintaan otentikasi kontrak. Platform Qiwa mengklarifikasi bahwa mengubah jabatan karyawan mengharuskan majikan untuk mengajukan permintaan Amandemen Kontrak, asalkan judul yang diusulkan konsisten dengan profesi karyawan. Karyawan harus menyetujui permintaan dalam waktu 10 hari. Ini menjelaskan lebih lanjut bahwa pilihan profesi diatur oleh Unified Saudi Clasfication of Occupations, dengan pengusaha yang diperlukan untuk mematuhi profesi yang tersedia pada daftar yang ditunjuk untuk karyawan Saudi. Profesi seorang pekerja adalah tercermin dalam informasi yang terdaftar dalam catatan mereka dengan Kementerian Dalam Negeri. Platform ini juga mencatat bahwa para pekerja dapat diuntungkan dari layanan Manajemen Pekerjaan sesuai dengan peraturan dan kondisi yang berlaku, sementara setiap amandemen untuk kontrak karyawan Saudi memerlukan persetujuan karyawan. Qiwa mengkonfirmasi bahwa informasi yang terkandung dalam sertifikat layanan, termasuk durasi layanan dan jabatan, diambil dari kontrak yang sudah kadaluarsa yang terdaftar di platform. Sebuah pengecualian berlaku bagi kontrak yang ditransfer dari asuransi sosial yang tidak diperbarui sebelum kadaluarsa, dalam hal ini catatan asuransi sosial bergantung pada untuk menerbitkan sertifikat.
articles.originalTitle: Qiwa outlines 4 conditions for transferring employees’ services
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Qiwa platform, affiliated with the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development, has clarified the regulatory requirements governing the transfer of employees’ services, outlining four key conditions that must be met to complete the process.These conditions include holding a valid residency permit (iqama), as a border number alone is insufficient; not having a valid work permit with a final exit visa issued or an expired final exit visa; and obtaining the employee’s consent to both the service transfer request and the contract authentication request. The Qiwa platform clarified that changing an employee’s job title requires the employer to submit a contract amendment request, provided that the proposed title is consistent with the employee’s profession. The employee must approve the request within 10 days. It further explained that the selection of professions is governed by the Unified Saudi Classification of Occupations, with employers required to adhere to the professions available on the list designated for Saudi employees. The profession of a resident worker is reflected in the information registered in their records with the Ministry of Interior. The platform also noted that resident workers can benefit from the Occupational Management service in accordance with its applicable regulations and conditions, while any amendment to a Saudi employee’s contract requires the employee’s consent. Qiwa confirmed that information contained in service certificates, including the duration of service and job title, is drawn from expired contracts registered on the platform. An exception applies to contracts transferred from social insurance that were not updated before their expiry, in which case social insurance records are relied upon for issuing the certificate.
