articles.title: Arab Saudi mengutuk serangan Iran di Kuwait, Bahrain dan kapal tanker minyak UAE
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi dengan keras mengutuk serangan Iran terhadap Kuwait dan Bahrain, serta serangan terhadap kapal tanker minyak milik UEE, menyerukan untuk segera mengakhiri permusuhan dan upaya diplomatik baru untuk menyelesaikan krisis. Dalam sebuah pernyataan yang dikeluarkan oleh Kementerian Luar Negeri pada hari Rabu, Arab Saudi menyatakan hukumannya dan pengungkapan kuat dari serangan terhadap dua negara Teluk dan kapal tanker milik UAEE. Kerajaan menegaskan kembali penolakan kategorinya terhadap serangan terus-menerus terhadap negara-negara tetangga dan ancaman terhadap kebebasan navigasi maritim dan rute pengiriman komersial. Ini juga memperbarui panggilan untuk mengakhiri semua serangan dan menghormati hukum internasional dan prinsip-prinsip lingkungan yang baik. Kesimpulannya, Arab Saudi menekankan pentingnya memungkinkan upaya diplomatik untuk mencapai perdamaian dan menyelesaikan krisis melalui negosiasi, dengan cara yang menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas wilayah dan rakyatnya.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia condemns Iranian attacks on Kuwait, Bahrain and UAE oil tanker
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia strongly condemned Iranian attacks against Kuwait and Bahrain, as well as an attack on an oil tanker belonging to the UAE, calling for an immediate end to hostilities and renewed diplomatic efforts to resolve the crisis. In a statement issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Wednesday, Saudi Arabia expressed its condemnation and strongest denunciation of the attacks against the two Gulf states and the UAE-owned oil tanker. The Kingdom reaffirmed its categorical rejection of Iran’s continued attacks against neighboring countries and threats to freedom of maritime navigation and commercial shipping routes. It also renewed the call for an end to all attacks and respect for international law and the principles of good neighborliness. In conclusion, Saudi Arabia stressed the importance of allowing diplomatic efforts to achieve peace and resolve the crisis through negotiations, in a manner that safeguards the security and stability of the region and its peoples.

articles.description: Tiga puluh tahun setelah pembunuhan Rabin, Israel lagi menggoda dengan kekerasan politik Diberikan oleh Lubna Masarwa pada Tue, 11 / 17 / 2026 - 21: 02 Dalam kebangkitan pemilu orang Arab yang memberikan keseimbangan kekuasaan, kita menyaksikan pernyataan kebencian yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya dan rasisme Benjamin Netanyahu, lalu pemimpin oposisi Israel, berbicara pada Knesset pada September 1993, dua tahun sebelum pembunuhan Yitzhak Rabin (Menahem Kahana / AFP) Seminggu sebelum pemilu Israel baru-baru ini, saya mengajak keponakan saya yang berusia 10 tahun ke bioskop di Yerusalem Barat. Ketika kami masuk ke lift di taman mobil, seorang Yahudi Israel muda masuk memegang senapan M16. Orang Yahudi Israel lainnya masuk juga. Ketika kami keluar di tingkat bioskop, keponakan saya berkata dengan senyum: "Saya akan memberikan 100 shekels jika Anda berani berbicara bahasa Arab di lift". Berbicara Arab di depan umum telah menjadi masalah nyata di Israel. Ini adalah subjek perdebatan panel di televisi, di mana pembicara bersaing untuk mengekspresikan pandangan yang semakin ekstrim dan menghasut terhadap dokter-dokter Palestina, sopir bus, dan siswa. Seorang wanita di kota Arab campuran Yaffa mengatakan kepada saya dia takut untuk menggunakan transportasi umum di kota, takut dia akan diserang oleh kelompok Israel. Musim panas lalu, tiga karyawan perempuan Arab diberhentikan dari toko fashion di Afula setelah menolak untuk mematuhi larangan manajer cabang berbahasa Arab di tempat kerja. Benci pidato dan rasisme mendominasi kehidupan publik Israel ke tingkat yang belum pernah saya saksikan sebelumnya. Diserang oleh kelompok Yahudi Israel di Palestina yang berbicara bahasa Arab, atau pada perempuan yang memakai headscarves di jalan, telah menjadi rutin. Tapi kebencian tidak diarahkan hanya di Palestina. Israel menyerang Haredim, atau orang Yahudi Ortodoks, karena tidak melayani tentara; toko kopi serangan Haredim yang terbuka di Shabbat. articles.originalTitle: Thirty years after Rabin's assassination, Israel is again flirting with political violence
articles.originalDescription: Thirty years after Rabin's assassination, Israel is again flirting with political violence Submitted by Lubna Masarwa on Tue, 11/17/2026 - 21:02 In the wake of elections that handed Arabs the balance of power, we are witnessing an unprecedented outpouring of hate speech and racism Benjamin Netanyahu, then the Israeli opposition leader, addresses the Knesset in September 1993, two years before the assassination of Yitzhak Rabin (Menahem Kahana/AFP) Off A week before the recent Israeli elections, I took my 10-year-old nephew to a cinema in West Jerusalem. As we got into a lift in the car park, a young Israeli Jew entered holding an M16 rifle. Other Israeli Jews got in too. When we got out on the cinema level, my nephew said with a smile: “I’ll give you 100 shekels if you dare to speak Arabic in the lift.” Speaking Arabic in public has become a real issue in Israel. It’s the subject of panel debates on television, where speakers compete to express increasingly extreme views and to incite against Palestinian doctors, bus drivers and students. A woman in the mixed Arab city of Yaffa told me she was afraid to use public transport in her town, fearing she would be attacked by Israeli groups. This past summer, three Arab female employees were dismissed from a fashion store in Afula after refusing to comply with a branch manager’s ban on speaking Arabic at work. Hate speech and racism dominate Israeli public life to a degree I have never witnessed before. Attacks by Israeli Jewish groups on Palestinians who speak Arabic, or on women who wear headscarves in the street, have become routine. But the hatred is not directed solely at Palestinians. Secular Israelis attack Haredim, or ultra-Orthodox Jews, for not serving in the army ; the Haredim attack coffee shops that open on Shabbat. articles.title: Update pagi
articles.description: Pagi pembaruan Selamat pagi pembaca Mata Timur Tengah, Berikut adalah perkembangan terbaru: Kementerian Luar Negeri Kuwait telah mengutuk serangan drone Iran terbaru di wilayahnya. Tentara Iran mengatakan itu menembakkan pesawat tak berawak yang menargetkan pangkalan udara Ali di Salem di Kuwait. Komando Umum Pasukan Pertahanan Bahrain juga menuduh Iran serangan yang sedang berlangsung di negara itu, setelah mengatakan itu dicegat sejumlah serangan udara pada hari Rabu. Koalisi Saudi- dipimpin mengatakan itu dicegat dan menghancurkan rudal Houthi diluncurkan menuju Riyadh. Sebelumnya, koalisi juga mengaku telah melakukan "operasi presisi" terhadap kemampuan militer Houthi serta menghancurkan 60 target militer di seluruh Yaman pemerintahan Sanaa, Hodeidah, Amran dan Saada. Departemen Dalam Negeri Bahrain mengatakan bahwa tim pertahanan sipil mengevakuasi gedung multi- lantai di utara Teluk barat karena kebakaran. "Pertahanan sipil mengevakuasi gedung bertingkat di Souq Waqif sebagai tindakan pencegahan, dan memadamkan api di gedung. Tidak ada cedera yang dilaporkan," kata kementrian dalam sebuah pernyataan, menambahkan bahwa investigasi sedang berlangsung untuk menentukan penyebab kebakaran. Menteri Luar Negeri AS Marco Rubio meragukan laporan tentang "ancaman dekat" dari Iran di Washington. Rubio juga mempertanyakan kredibilitas sumber-sumber yang dikutip dalam laporan CNN tentang plot yang diduga Iran menargetkan ibukota AS, yang mengatakan: "Beberapa sumber kecerdasanmu adalah pembohong; yang lain adalah pembohong dan penjahat". Presiden AS Donald Trump mengatakan bahwa AS adalah "melakukannya dengan sangat baik di Iran, dengan sedikit" selama kunjungan ke Filipina. Komentar Trump datang selama pertemuannya dengan Presiden Filipina Ferdinand Marcos Jr, di mana dia juga mengumumkan bahwa Washington memperluas kerjasama pertahanan dengan Manila.
articles.originalTitle: Morning update
articles.originalDescription: Morning update Good morning Middle East Eye readers, Here are the latest developments: Kuwait’s foreign ministry has condemned the latest Iranian drone attack on its territory. Iran’s army has said it fired a drone targeting the Ali al-Salem Airbase in Kuwait. The General Command of the Bahrain Defence Force has also accused Iran of ongoing attacks on the country, after it said it intercepted a number of aerial attacks on Wednesday. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed a Houthi missile launched towards Riyadh. Earlier, the coalition also claimed to have carried out a “precision operation” against Houthi military capabilities as well as destroying 60 military targets across Yemen’s governorates of Sanaa, Hodeidah, Amran and Saada. Bahrain’s Ministry of Interior said that civil defence teams evacuated a multi-storey building in the Gulf country's north west due to a fire. "Civil Defence evacuated a multi-story building in Souq Waqif as a precaution, and extinguished a fire in the building. No injuries were reported," the ministry said in a statement, adding that investigations are underway to determine the cause of the blaze. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio cast doubt about reports of an "imminent threat" from Iran on Washington. Rubio also questioned the credibility of sources cited in a CNN report about an alleged Iranian plot targeting the US capital, saying: "Some of your intelligence sources are liars; others are liars and criminals." US President Donald Trump said that the US is "doing very well in Iran, to put it mildly" during a visit to the Philippines. Trump's comments come during his meeting with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr, where he also announced that Washington is expanding its defence cooperation with Manila.

articles.title: Duta Besar Saudi, Menteri Pendidikan membahas memperluas kemitraan akademik Saudi- AS di Boston
articles.description: BOSTON - Duta Besar Saudi kepada Putri Amerika Serikat Reema Bint Bandar bertemu dengan Menteri Pendidikan Al- Benyan untuk membahas penguatan pendidikan dan kerjasama penelitian antara Arab Saudi dan AS. Pertemuan berlangsung di Boston, Massachusetts selama kunjungan Al- Benyan ke Amerika Serikat, termasuk serangkaian pertemuan dengan pemimpin universitas Amerika dan lembaga pendidikan dan penelitian. Kedua sisi meninjau daerah-daerah pendidikan dan kerjasama penelitian dan cara-cara dieksplorasi untuk memperkuat akademik dan kemitraan ilmiah dengan lembaga-lembaga pendidikan terkemuka Amerika. Diskusi juga berfokus pada kesempatan untuk mengembangkan kerjasama bersama dan pertukaran keahlian pendidikan dan penelitian serta pengalaman dalam mendukung prioritas pengembangan sektor pendidikan Arab Saudi. Pertemuan lebih lanjut membahas pentingnya koordinasi dan integrasi antara Kedutaan Saudi di Amerika Serikat dan Kementerian Pendidikan dalam mendukung inisiatif pendidikan bersama dan program. Dua pejabat juga membahas memfasilitasi komunikasi dengan universitas Amerika dan lembaga dan memperkuat kerjasama dalam pendidikan tinggi, penelitian ilmiah dan perkembangan modal manusia.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Ambassador, Education Minister discuss expanding Saudi-US academic partnerships in Boston
articles.originalDescription: BOSTON — Saudi Ambassador to the United States Princess Reema bint Bandar met with Minister of Education Yousef Al-Benyan to discuss strengthening educational and research cooperation between Saudi Arabia and the US. The meeting took place in Boston, Massachusetts during Al-Benyan’s visit to the United States, which includes a series of meetings with leaders of American universities and educational and research institutions. The two sides reviewed areas of educational and research cooperation and explored ways to strengthen academic and scientific partnerships with leading American educational institutions. Discussions also focused on opportunities to expand joint cooperation and exchange educational and research expertise and experiences in support of Saudi Arabia’s education sector development priorities. The meeting further addressed the importance of coordination and integration between the Saudi Embassy in the United States and the Ministry of Education in supporting joint educational initiatives and programs. The two officials also discussed facilitating communication with American universities and institutions and strengthening cooperation in higher education, scientific research and human capital development.

articles.title: NCM menimbulkan peringatan merah untuk hujan lebat di Mekah sebagai badai terus di Saudi Arab
articles.description: JEDDAH - Bagian dari wilayah Mekah tetap berada di bawah peringatan untuk curah hujan berat pada hari Rabu sementara peringatan oranye telah dikeluarkan untuk bagian-bagian Asir sebagai menengah untuk badai berat terus melintasi bagian-bagian Arab Saudi. Pusat Nasional untuk Meteorologi (NCM) mengeluarkan peringatan merah untuk hujan deras di bagian-bagian wilayah Mekah dari 12: 00 sampai 9: 00, peringatan angin kuat, dekat -nol visibilitas horizontal, hujan es, banjir kilat dan petir. Bagian lain dari wilayah Mekah berada di bawah peringatan oranye untuk curah hujan moderat dari 12 malam sampai 9 malam, disertai oleh angin kuat, dekat - nol visibilitas, hujan es, banjir dan petir. Sementara itu, peringatan oranye berlaku di sebagian wilayah Asir dari 9: 00 sampai 8 malam, meramalkan hujan sedang disertai dengan angin kuat, dekat -nol visibilitas, hujan es, banjir kilat, gelombang tinggi dan petir. Menurut cuaca cuaca nasional NCM untuk hari Rabu, menengah untuk badai petir berat disertai hujan es dan angin aktif diharapkan untuk melanjutkan di seluruh bagian-bagian Jazan, Asir, Al- Baha dan Mekah daerah, berpotensi memicu banjir kilat. Kabut juga mungkin terjadi di sebagian daerah ini, begitu juga daerah pesisir Provinsi Timur.
articles.originalTitle: NCM raises red alert for heavy rainfall in Makkah as thunderstorms continue across Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — Parts of the Makkah region remain under warnings for heavy rainfall on Wednesday while an orange alert has been issued for parts of Asir as moderate to heavy thunderstorms continue across parts of Saudi Arabia. The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) issued a red alert for heavy rainfall in parts of the Makkah region from 12 p.m. to 9 p.m., warning of strong winds, near-zero horizontal visibility, hail, flash floods and lightning. Other parts of the Makkah region are under an orange alert for moderate rainfall from 12 p.m. to 9 p.m., accompanied by strong winds, near-zero visibility, hail, flash floods and lightning. Meanwhile, an orange alert is in effect in parts of the Asir region from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., forecasting moderate rainfall accompanied by strong winds, near-zero visibility, hail, flash floods, high waves and lightning. According to the NCM's nationwide weather forecast for Wednesday, moderate to heavy thunderstorms accompanied by hail and active winds are expected to continue across parts of Jazan, Asir, Al-Baha and Makkah regions, potentially triggering flash floods. Fog is also possible in parts of these regions, as well as coastal areas of the Eastern Province.

articles.title: Koalisi menghancurkan 60 target militer Houthi di Yaman, mencegat rudal pesiar menargetkan Riyadh
articles.description: RIYADH - Koalisi untuk mendukung Legitimasi di Yaman telah menghancurkan 60 target militer Houthi di empat pemerintahan Yaman dan mencegat rudal pesiar yang diluncurkan ke arah wilayah Saudi Arabia Riyadh. Juru bicara Koalisi Mayor Jenderal Turki Al- Malki mengatakan operasi yang ditargetkan, mengumumkan Rabu pagi, bertujuan untuk melemahkan rudal balistik Houthi dan kemampuan drone dan menetralisir ancaman maritim. Al- Malki mengatakan operasi menargetkan situs militer di seluruh Sanaa, Al- Hudaydah, Amran dan Saada mengatur. Operasi ini termasuk penghancuran terowongan digunakan untuk menyimpan rudal balistik di daerah pegunungan, bersama dengan workshop digunakan untuk merakit dan menyimpan drone, menurut Koalisi. Kemudian Rabu pagi, Koalisi secara terpisah mengumumkan bahwa telah dicegat dan menghancurkan rudal pesiar diluncurkan oleh milisi Houthi menuju wilayah Saudi Arabia Riyadh.
articles.originalTitle: Coalition destroys 60 Houthi military targets in Yemen, intercepts cruise missile targeting Riyadh
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen has destroyed 60 Houthi military targets across four Yemeni governorates and intercepted a cruise missile launched toward Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh region. Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Malki said the targeted operation, announced early Wednesday morning, aimed to weaken the Houthi militia’s ballistic missile and drone capabilities and neutralize maritime threats. Al-Malki said the operation targeted military sites across Sanaa, Al-Hudaydah, Amran and Saada governorates. The operation included the destruction of tunnels used to store ballistic missiles in mountainous areas, along with workshops used to assemble and store drones, according to the Coalition. Later Wednesday morning, the Coalition separately announced that it had intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile launched by the Houthi militia toward Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh region.

articles.description: Perhatikan: Israel menetap membunuh nenek-nenek Palestina yang tinggal di Tepi Barat penduduk Israel yang ditembak mati seorang wanita tua Palestina dan melukai delapan anggota keluarganya selama serangan di luar rumahnya di desa Ein al- Duyuk al- Tata, barat Yerikho di Tepi Barat yang diduduki. Menurut saksi mata, pemukim bersenjata ditembak 73- tahun tua Fidda Fheidat di kepala, membunuhnya di tempat. articles.originalTitle: Watch: Israeli settles kill Palestinian grandmother in occupied West Bank
articles.originalDescription: Watch: Israeli settles kill Palestinian grandmother in occupied West Bank Israeli settlers shot dead an elderly Palestinian woman and wounded eight of her family members during an attack outside her home in the village of Ein al-Duyuk al-Tahta, west of Jericho in the occupied West Bank. According to eyewitnesses, armed settlers shot 73-year-old Fidda Fheidat in the head, killing her on the spot. The settlers, who had recently seized eight Palestinian homes in an area adjacent to the village, went on to fire at other members of the family, wounding eight of them. According to Jihad Mahalis, a member of the village’s local committee, the settlers have launched attacks on the village homes every single night since seizing the properties, which are located some 500 metres away from the rest of the village’s homes. articles.title: Saudi Arabia membangun kembali komitmen untuk keamanan daerah, stabilitas energi dan navigasi yang aman
articles.description: RIYADH - Sesi Kabinet, dipimpin oleh Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman di Riyadh pada hari Selasa, meninjau hasil pembicaraan terbaru antara Arab Saudi dan negara-negara ramah ditujukan untuk memperluas cakrawala bilateral dan kerjasama multilateral di berbagai bidang. Kabinet juga mendasari pentingnya mendukung semua upaya untuk memperkuat keamanan daerah dan perdamaian, memastikan stabilitas pasar energi, dan koridor maritim yang dilindungi dan kebebasan navigasi, sehingga mengamankan aliran perdagangan dan rantai pasokan global. Dalam pernyataan kepada Badan Pers Saudi setelah sesi ini, Menteri Media Salman Al- Dossary mengatakan bahwa Kabinet telah diberitahu tentang keseluruhan kinerja negara dan kemajuan dan prestasi dibuat di berbagai bidang, meskipun keadaan yang berlaku dan transformasi berturut-turut berlangsung di seluruh dunia, terutama di lingkungan regional. Dewan menegaskan bahwa Kerajaan bergerak maju dengan upaya untuk memperkuat kemampuannya lebih lanjut, alamat muncul perkembangan dan tantangan, menjaga peningkatan dan prestasi nasional, dan menegakkan berdiri di antara bangsa-bangsa dan peran berpengaruh di kedua tingkat regional dan internasional. Dewan Menteri meninjau perkembangan terbaru dalam ekonomi nasional dan ketahanan telah menunjukkan dalam beradaptasi dengan keadaan beragam. Ketahanan ini didasari oleh kemajuan yang dibuat dalam mengubah sumber pertumbuhan ekonomi di bawah kerangka kerja Saudi Vision 2030, bersama reformasi yang telah mengalami pertumbuhan dan kemakmuran dari aktivitas minyak yang tidak - dan membantu menjaga inflasi di tingkat rendah. Ulasan ini juga menyoroti dukungan berkelanjutan untuk investasi, perluasan kesempatan bagi sektor swasta, kapasitas keuangan publik untuk menanggapi perubahan kondisi, dan keberlanjutan pengeluaran pada layanan dan proyek pembangunan penting. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia reaffirms commitment to regional security, energy stability and safe navigation
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Cabinet session, chaired by Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman in Riyadh on Tuesday, reviewed the outcomes of recent talks between Saudi Arabia and friendly nations aimed at broadening the horizons of bilateral and multilateral cooperation across various fields. The Cabinet also underscored the importance of supporting all efforts to reinforce regional security and peace, ensure the stability of energy markets, and safeguard maritime corridors and freedom of navigation, thereby securing the uninterrupted flow of global trade and supply chains. In a statement to the Saudi Press Agency following the session, Minister of Media Salman Al-Dossary said that the Cabinet had been briefed on the overall performance of the state and the progress and achievements made across various fronts, despite the prevailing circumstances and successive transformations unfolding across the world, particularly in the regional environment. The Council affirmed that the Kingdom is moving forward with efforts to further strengthen its capabilities, address emerging developments and challenges, safeguard its development gains and national achievements, and uphold its standing among nations and its influential role at both regional and international levels. The Council of Ministers reviewed the latest developments in the national economy and the resilience it has demonstrated in adapting to diverse circumstances. This resilience is underpinned by the progress made in diversifying sources of economic growth under the framework of Saudi Vision 2030, alongside reforms that have sustained the growth and prosperity of non-oil activities and helped keep inflation at low levels. articles.originalDescription: ‘We’re in the midst of a divorce with Israel’: Palestinian American zeroes in on Senator Fetterman Submitted by Yasmine El-Sabawi on Tue, 11/17/2026 - 17:21 The first challenger to Pennsylvania's pro-Israel Democratic senator spoke to Middle East Eye about why the time is right for him to run for office Pennsylvania candidate for US Senate in 2028, Ahmed Moor, speaks in a video posted on his X account, on 12 November 2026 (Screengrab/@AhmedMoor) Off A 42-year-old Palestinian -American writer has emerged as the first challenger to Pennsylvania Democratic Senator and staunch pro- Israel ally John Fetterman in his 2028 Senate race. It's not too uncommon for US candidates to declare their bid this early. Election campaigns in this country run for at least 18 months before every election, giving voters little reprieve from the ads and media placements. Speaking to Middle East Eye on Monday, Ahmed Moor said he is centring three foreign policy priorities. "End the war in Iran. End the war in Ukraine. End the war on the Palestinians." The slogan echoes the successful platforms of those who undoubtedly paved the way for him: Democratic Socialist New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, and Democratic Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed. Though in his conversation with MEE, he did not seem to want the comparison to be made. Moor is also an immigrant, an Arab, a Muslim, a millennial, a progressive, a passionate proponent of Palestinian rights, and a father of three girls. Sayed has two children, and played up his "girl dad" persona. Was Moor inspired? "I'm a man of the left," he responded, sticking strictly to his campaign message. "We're going to have the left-right contest in America all the time. What this campaign is about is the shape of the sandbox. The idea that the Constitution and Bill of Rights is under assault is not a left-right issue. That's an American issue." articles.title: Irak melanjutkan pengiriman minyak untuk ekspor ke Turki melalui pipa
articles.description: Irak melanjutkan pengiriman minyak untuk ekspor ke Turki melalui jalur pipa yang diberikan oleh staf MEE pada Tue, 11 / 17 / 2026 - 20: 00 menteri minyak Irak mengatakan Kirkuk- Ceyhan pipa dapat mencapai kapasitas 500.000 bpd dengan perbaikan dan upgrades anggota pemerintahan Irak berjalan ke sebelah pipa di Lapangan Minyak Bai Hassan Oil, barat dari kota Irak Utara Kirkuk, pada 19 Oktober 2017 (Ahmad alk-Ruye / AFAFP) telah memompa minyak ke barat untuk ekspor minyak ke Kirkran. Irak berencana untuk memompa sampai 120.000 barel per hari (bpd) minyak melalui pipa sepanjang 960km- yang berjalan dari kota Irak ke pelabuhan Mediterania Turki, Menteri Minyak Irak Bassem Khudair mengatakan dalam sebuah pernyataan yang dilaporkan oleh Badan Berita Irak milik negara pada hari Selasa. Dia mengatakan aliran bisa mencapai 500.000 bpd setelah "keberhasilan penyelesaian pemeliharaan, rehabilitasi, teknis dan tes operasional" pada pipa, yang telah ditutup selama lebih dari satu dekade. Irak adalah salah satu negara yang paling terpukul oleh AS dan Iran yang bersaing memblokade di Selat Hormuz. Hampir semua ekspor minyak Irak keluar dari jalur air sebelum perang Amerika-Israel di Iran, dan pendapatan dari penjualan berkontribusi hingga 90 persen dari anggaran Irak. Memulai kembali minyak mengalir dari Kirkuk ke Ceyhan adalah langkah pertama dalam upaya Irak untuk mengurangi ketergantungan pada Hormuz. articles.originalDescription: Iraq resumes shipping oil for export to Turkey via pipeline Submitted by MEE staff on Tue, 11/17/2026 - 20:00 Iraqi oil minister says Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline could reach capacity of 500,000 bpd with repairs and upgrades An Iraqi government forces member walks next to a pipeline at the Bai Hassan Oil Field, west of the northern Iraqi city of Kirkuk, on 19 October 2017 (Ahmad al-Rubaye/AFP) Off Iraq has resumed the pumping of crude oil for export through the Kirkuk-Ceyhan Pipeline to Turkey , as it looks to bypass the Strait of Hormuz. Iraq plans to pump up to 120,000 barrels per day (bpd) of oil through the 960km-long pipeline that runs from the Iraqi city to Turkey’s Mediterranean port, Iraqi Oil Minister Bassem Khudair said in a statement reported by the state-owned Iraqi News Agency on Tuesday. He said the flow could reach 500,000 bpd after “successful completion of maintenance, rehabilitation, technical and operational tests” on the pipeline, which has been shuttered for more than a decade. Iraq is one of the countries hardest hit by the US and Iran’s competing blockades in the Strait of Hormuz. Nearly all of Iraq’s oil exports exited the waterway before the US-Israeli war on Iran, and revenue from sales contributed to 90 percent of Iraq’s budget. Restarting oil flows from Kirkuk to Ceyhan is the first step in Iraq’s efforts to reduce its dependence on Hormuz. Baghdad wants to connect Basra, its energy hub in southern Iraq, to the Mediterranean via the Syrian port of Baniyas and Turkey’s port of Ceyhan. Middle East Eye was the first to report US efforts to revive a pipeline connection between Kirkuk and Baniyas. US ambassador to Iraq Tom Barrack hailed the reopening of the Kirkuk-Ceyhan line on Tuesday in a post on social media. “Go Iraq, Go,” Barrack wrote . articles.title: Dewan Penuntut Publik menyetujui Proses Investigasi Kode
articles.description: RIYADH - Dewan Penuntut Umum menyetujui "Kode Investigasi dan Penuntut Umum", panduan untuk anggota Penuntut Umum dalam melaksanakan mereka investigasi dan tuntutan tugas. Sesi ketujuh Dewan dipimpin oleh Jaksa Agung dan Ketua Dewan Dr Khalid Al- Yousef di Riyadh pada hari Selasa. Dewan membahas beberapa hal agenda dan mengeluarkan keputusan yang ditujukan untuk mengembangkan operasi tuntutan dan meningkatkan kinerja profesional dan institusional. Kode bertujuan untuk memastikan integritas dan legalitas prosedur, menjaga hak-hak hukum dan jaminan, dan meningkatkan kualitas investigasi dan tuntutan kerja. Dewan juga menyetujui 2027 rencana pelatihan untuk anggota Jaksa Umum, menegaskan kembali komitmennya untuk pengembangan profesional terus menerus dan memperkuat kemampuan hukum dan keterampilan khusus. Pada masalah personil, dewan menyetujui promosi anggota Penuntut Umum 179 dan mengadopsi beberapa keputusan administratif lainnya sesuai dengan hukum dan peraturan yang berlaku. Keputusan membentuk bagian dari upaya dewan yang sedang berlangsung untuk mengembangkan sistem penuntut, memperkuat kualifikasi profesional, dan berinvestasi di modal manusia untuk meningkatkan kinerja institusi dan memastikan standar tinggi dalam praktek kejaksaan.
articles.originalTitle: Public Prosecution Council approves Code of Investigation Procedures
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Public Prosecution Council approved the “Code of Investigation and Public Prosecution Procedures,” a guide for Public Prosecution members in carrying out their investigative and prosecutorial duties. The seventh session of the Council was chaired by Attorney General and Council Chairman Dr. Khalid Al-Yousef in Riyadh on Tuesday. The council discussed several agenda items and issued decisions aimed at developing prosecutorial operations and enhancing professional and institutional performance.The code aims to ensure the integrity and legality of procedures, safeguard legal rights and guarantees, and improve the quality of investigative and prosecutorial work. The council also approved the 2027 training plan for Public Prosecution members, reaffirming its commitment to continuous professional development and strengthening legal capabilities and specialized skills.On personnel matters, the council approved the promotion of 179 Public Prosecution members and adopted several other administrative decisions in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The decisions form part of the council’s ongoing efforts to develop the prosecutorial system, strengthen professional qualifications, and invest in human capital to improve institutional performance and ensure high standards in prosecutorial practice.

articles.title: Arabian gazelle 's adaptabilitas tercermin dalam warisan Arab
articles.description: RAFHA - tulisan Arab Kuno mencatat pengamatan rusa 'kemampuan untuk bertahan haus dan beradaptasi dengan lingkungan gurun. Salah satu deskripsi tradisional menggambarkan kijang sebagai kompensasi untuk tidak adanya air dengan bernapas dalam angin, sebuah ekspresi yang mencerminkan pengamatan awal Arab tentang alam hewan dan kemampuannya untuk bertahan hidup dalam habitat kering. Ketua Dewan Asosiasi Lingkungan Aman di Northern Borders Daerah Nasser Al- Gazlad mengatakan deskripsi tradisional kizelle melampaui ketangkasan dan kecepatannya untuk menjelajahi kebiasaan makanannya, bagaimana mereka menjelajahi kelangkaan air, dan cara mereka menanggapi ancaman potensial, Badan Pers Saudi melaporkan. Dia menjelaskan bahwa rusa manfaat dari kelembaban tanaman mereka makan, termasuk rumput gurun dan semak-semak, membantu mereka menahan kondisi kering dan mengurangi ketergantungan mereka pada sumber air permukaan. * * media [2795979) * * Data ilmiah yang diterbitkan oleh Komisi Kerajaan untuk AlUla mengindikasikan bahwa gazelle Arab (Gazella arabica) dapat memenuhi persyaratan airnya melalui pola makanannya, tanpa perlu minum langsung. Diet nya meliputi daun tanaman, bunga dan buah, termasuk mereka pohon akasia. * * media [2795980] * althlad mencatat bahwa kemampuan rusa untuk beradaptasi dengan kondisi gurun terhubung dengan diet dan perilaku merumput, serta karakteristik fisiologis yang membantu mereka menahan lingkungan kering. Sifat-sifat ini menawarkan sekilas ke adaptasi alami kijang ke sekitarnya, sedangkan tradisional account mencerminkan minat dari Arab kuno dalam mengamati satwa liar gurun dan mendokumentasikan perilakunya.
articles.originalTitle: Arabian gazelle’s desert adaptability reflected in Arab heritage
articles.originalDescription: RAFHA — Ancient Arabic writings recorded observations of gazelles’ ability to endure thirst and adapt to desert environments. One traditional description portrays the gazelle as compensating for the absence of water by breathing in the breeze, an expression that reflects early Arab observations of the animal’s nature and its ability to survive in arid habitats.Chairman of the Board of Aman Environmental Association in Northern Borders Region Nasser Al-Mujlad said traditional descriptions of the gazelle went beyond its agility and speed to explore its feeding habits, how it copes with water scarcity, and the ways it responds to potential threats, the Saudi Press Agency reported. He explained that gazelles benefit from the moisture in the plants they feed on, including desert grasses and shrubs, helping them withstand dry conditions and reduce their reliance on surface water sources. **media[2795979]**Scientific data published by the Royal Commission for AlUla indicate that the Arabian gazelle (Gazella arabica) can meet its water requirements through its plant-based diet, without necessarily needing to drink water directly. Its diet includes plant leaves, flowers and fruits, including those of acacia trees. **media[2795980]**Al-Mujlad noted that gazelles’ ability to adapt to desert conditions is linked to their diet and grazing behavior, as well as physiological characteristics that help them withstand arid environments. These traits offer a glimpse into the gazelle’s natural adaptation to its surroundings, while traditional accounts reflect the keen interest of ancient Arabs in observing desert wildlife and documenting its behavior.

Many of them wrapped themselves in woollen blankets, some sitting on the ground, others standing, looking for their daily "dose of hope" on a television screen. With no electricity, we used the little power the available solar panels could collect from the sun all day to turn on the TV and watch the news for around 30 minutes. Once the familiar news theme played, those gathering around the screen started calling on others inside the house to hurry and join them. Among them, I stood, very well aware that those sparkling eyes would not find what they were looking for. They would find no international action taken against the war crimes , crimes against humanity and genocide we were witnessing, no appropriate international condemnation, and not even a statement by a world leader clearly naming the perpetrators. articles.originalDescription: Saudi double-tap strike on factory in Yemen kills 14, Houthi health ministry says A Saudi double-tap strike on a sponge factory near Hodeida in western Yemen killed 14 people and wounded 10, the Saba news agency reported, citing the Houthi-run health ministry. Saudi aircraft struck the factory again as emergency workers carried out rescue operations and fought a fire, Saba said. Factory employees and emergency workers were among those killed or wounded. "Pembunuhan terus berlanjut setiap hari, termasuk pembunuhan anak-anak". "Keadaan yang menimbulkan penemuan genosida kita masih beroperasi di dalam Gaza. Kata-katanya mengikuti dua laporan utama oleh komisi Palestina PBB tahun ini, termasuk laporan pada Juni menyimpulkan bahwa Israel sengaja menargetkan anak-anak di Gaza, melakukan genosida, kejahatan terhadap kemanusiaan dan kejahatan perang di daerah pesisir, serta kejahatan perang lebih lanjut di Tepi Barat. "Hukum kami sekarang, atas dasar 18 laporan yang dihasilkan selama lima tahun, adalah bahwa pemerintah Israel, sipil dan militer, bertanggung jawab atas komisi kejahatan perang, kejahatan terhadap kemanusiaan dan di Gaza kejahatan genosida," kata Sidoti.' By instrumentalising massive popular discontent , economic hardships , xenophobia, and the scapegoating of non-western peoples and cultures, Le Pen has turned what used to be a fringe group into France’s largest political party. She has capitalised on a devastated social landscape created by decades of neoliberal capitalist policies, successfully stealing the historical terrain and voters of the left and far left. Today, no other party can compete with the National Rally. Only a large coalition could defeat her at the polls next April. It is thus very probable that France may soon be governed by the xenophobic, Islamophobic , ultra-nationalist far right. But if Le Pen is made of titanium, accusations of antisemitism in her party may prove to be her kryptonite. Jordan Bardella, her chosen heir and potential future prime minister, has denied writing antisemitic messages attributed to him in the mid-2010s, when he was a teenager. But the French outlet Mediapart says it was able to verify Bardella as the author, including by obtaining a judicially certified copy of the original 2013 messages from the US social media giant Meta. So far, the accusations have not made a dent in the National Rally’s support. And in recent weeks, the controversy has been overshadowed by the high-school student protest movement that took France by storm in September. articles.title: Saudi Arabia mencatat 1.8 juta kontrak sewa mobil elektronik di Q3 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - perusahaan penyewaan mobil di Arab Saudi mengeluarkan 1.8 juta kontrak elektronik terpadu selama kuartal ketiga 2026, menurut data yang dirilis oleh Otoritas Umum Transportasi. Sosok ini menyoroti skala aktivitas di sektor ini dan mengembangkan ketergantungan pada solusi digital untuk transaksi rental. Menurut data, wilayah Riyadh berisi kontrak elektronik terbesar yang dikeluarkan di seluruh Kingdom, mencapai 30 persen, diikuti oleh wilayah Mekah dengan 24 persen, Provinsi Timur dengan 14 persen, dan Asir dengan 8 persen. California peringkat berikutnya dengan saham 6 persen, diikuti oleh Qassim 5 persen, Jazan 4 persen, dan Tabuk 3 persen. 6 persen sisanya didistribusikan di wilayah kerajaan lain. Otoritas tersebut menjelaskan bahwa kontrak elektronik yang terpadu membantu menjaga hak-hak dari baik kekurangan dan lessees, meningkatkan keandalan transaksi, meningkatkan kualitas layanan, prosedur sewa ban, dan meningkatkan efisiensi proses operasional. Otoritas terus mengejar inisiatif untuk mengembangkan sektor penyewaan mobil dengan meningkatkan kualitas layanan dan meningkatkan efisiensi operasional, sehingga mendukung pertumbuhan sektor dan ketahanan jangka panjang.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia records 1.8 million electronic car rental contracts in Q3 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Car rental companies in Saudi Arabia issued more than 1.8 million unified electronic contracts during the third quarter of 2026, according to data released by the Transport General Authority. The figure highlights the scale of activity in the sector and the growing reliance on digital solutions to streamline rental transactions.According to the data, the Riyadh region accounted for the largest share of electronic contracts issued across the Kingdom, reaching 30 percent, followed by the Makkah region with 24 percent, the Eastern Province with 14 percent, and Asir with 8 percent.Madinah ranked next with a 6 percent share, followed by Qassim 5 percent, Jazan 4 percent, and Tabuk 3 percent. The remaining 6 percent was distributed among the Kingdom’s other regions. The authority explained that the unified electronic contract helps safeguard the rights of both lessors and lessees, enhance transaction reliability, improve service quality, streamline rental procedures, and boost the efficiency of operational processes.The authority continues to pursue initiatives to develop the car rental sector by enhancing service quality and improving operational efficiency, thereby supporting the sector’s growth and long-term sustainability.

articles.title: Penduduk Israel membunuh nenek Palestina di rumahnya di Jericho
articles.description: Penduduk Israel membunuh nenek-nenek Palestina di rumahnya di Jericho, pemukim Israel menembak mati seorang wanita Palestina tua dan melukai delapan anggota keluarganya, termasuk anak-anaknya dan cucu-cucunya, selama serangan terhadap sebuah rumah di desa Ein al- Duyuk al- Taita, barat dari kota Yerikho dalam menduduki Tepi Barat. Saksi mata mengatakan kepada Mata Timur Tengah bahwa pemukim bersenjata memasuki rumah Palestina di tengah malam pada hari Senin dan menembak 73- tahun Fidda Fheidat tua di kepala, membunuhnya di tempat. Para pemukim, yang baru-baru ini menyita delapan rumah Palestina di daerah yang berdekatan dengan desa, langsung menembaki anggota keluarga lainnya, melukai delapan rumah. Ahmad Fheidat, saudara korban ipar, mengatakan bahwa ketika mendengar tembakan, ia bergegas untuk mengusir pemukim. Dia merasa sakit yang tajam di kakinya dan menyadari ia telah ditembak, melihat ke belakang, ia melihat Fidda berbaring di tanah, pendarahan dari kepalanya. "Meskipun cedera, aku bergegas ke arahnya dan memanggilnya. Ketika saya meletakkan tangan saya di atas kepalanya, saya melihat bahwa tengkoraknya telah terbelah oleh api jarak dekat; darahnya telah berhamburan ke dinding rumah," katanya. Baca lagi: pemukim Israel membunuh nenek Palestina di rumahnya di Jericho
articles.originalTitle: Israeli settlers kill Palestinian grandmother in her home in Jericho
articles.originalDescription: Israeli settlers kill Palestinian grandmother in her home in Jericho Israeli settlers shot dead an elderly Palestinian woman and wounded eight of her family members, including her children and grandchildren, during an attack on a home in the village of Ein al-Duyuk al-Tahta, west of Jericho in the occupied West Bank. Eyewitnesses told Middle East Eye that armed settlers entered the Palestinian home in the middle of the night on Monday and shot 73-year-old Fidda Fheidat in the head, killing her on the spot. The settlers, who had recently seized eight Palestinian homes in an area adjacent to the village, went on to fire at other members of the family, wounding eight of them. Ahmad Fheidat, the victim’s brother-in-law, said that on hearing the gunfire, he rushed to repel the settlers. He felt a sharp pain in his leg and realised he had been shot; looking behind him, he saw Fidda lying on the ground, bleeding from her head. "Despite the injury, I rushed towards her and called out to her. When I placed my hand on her head, I saw that her skull had been split open by the close-range fire; her blood had splattered onto the walls of the house," he said. Read more: Israeli settlers kill Palestinian grandmother in her home in Jericho

articles.title: Badan migrasi PBB memperingatkan lebih banyak kematian hipotermia Gaza, seperti Israel bar 100.000 tenda dari memasuki wilayah
articles.description: Badan migrasi PBB memperingatkan lebih banyak kematian hipotermia Gaza, seperti Israel bar 100.000 tenda dari memasuki wilayah Badan migrasi PBB telah memperingatkan akan kematian lebih lanjut dari hipotermia di Gaza karena Israel terus membatasi akses bantuan penampungan ke wilayah tersebut. Hujan lebat menyapu melalui medan perang-robek pekan lalu, membatalkan ribuan tenda darurat di mana mayoritas penduduk Gaza berlindung. Seorang bayi berusia sembilan puluh bulan meninggal karena kedinginan di tengah suhu jatuh. "Tanpa tempat penampungan yang tepat, tanpa barang pertolongan yang kritis, maka kematian hipotermia akan terjadi", Karl Baker, kepala Organisasi Internasional untuk program Migrasi Gaza, berkata pada hari Selasa, menambahkan bahwa anak-anak sangat rentan, karena mereka kehilangan panas tubuh lebih cepat. "Ini tidak dapat diterima untuk memiliki hipotermia di dunia modern." Baker mengatakan bahwa beberapa 100.000 tenda berada di luar Gaza, namun pihak berwenang Israel telah melarang entri barang yang mereka anggap "kegunaan ganda" - terutama tempat penampungan barang termasuk tiang tenda dan rumah bergerak. Baker menjelaskan pertemuan keluarga yang basah kuyup perlindungan di bawah kendur, buruk - out tarpaulins. "Gaza berubah menjadi satu kamp IDP yang besar (orang-orang pengungsi internal). Ini jajaran sebagai salah satu yang terburuk Aku sudah berjalan melalui," katanya. Pelaporan oleh Reuters
articles.originalTitle: UN migration agency warns of more Gaza hypothermia deaths, as Israel bars 100,000 tents from entering territory
articles.originalDescription: UN migration agency warns of more Gaza hypothermia deaths, as Israel bars 100,000 tents from entering territory The UN migration agency has warned of further deaths from hypothermia in Gaza as Israel continues to heavily restrict the entry of shelter aid into the territory. Heavy rains swept through the war-torn enclave last week, inundating thousands of makeshift tents where the majority of Gaza's population is sheltering. A nine-month-old baby died from the cold amid the plummeting temperatures. "Without proper shelter, without critical relief items, then hypothermia deaths will occur," Karl Baker, head of the International Organization for Migration's Gaza programme, said on Tuesday, adding that children were particularly vulnerable, since they lose body heat more quickly. "It's unacceptable to have hypothermia in the modern world." Baker said that some 100,000 tents were prepositioned outside Gaza, but the Israeli authorities had barred the entry of items which they consider to be "dual use"- predominantly shelter items including tent poles and mobile homes. Baker described meeting a drenched family sheltering beneath sagging, worn-out tarpaulins. "Gaza is turning into one large IDP camp (internally displaced persons). It ranks as one of the worst I've walked through," he said. Reporting by Reuters

articles.title: Kementerian HR: Tidak ada kesepakatan dengan Kenya untuk perekrutan pekerja terampil
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Sumber Daya Manusia dan Pengembangan Sosial telah mengkonfirmasi bahwa annex teknis yang ditandatangani dengan Kenya secara eksklusif dimaksudkan untuk mengatur perekrutan pekerja dalam negeri dan tidak mencakup perekrutan pekerja terampil untuk berbagai sektor. Kementerian menjelaskan bahwa tidak ada kesepakatan saat ini untuk perekrutan pekerja terampil dari Kenya. Dalam pernyataan klarifikasi yang dikeluarkan pada hari Selasa, pelayanan tersebut menjelaskan bahwa perekrutan pekerja dalam negeri dari Kenya terbatas pada pekerjaan tertentu, termasuk pekerja domestik dan pengemudi swasta, dan tidak memperpanjang kesempatan kerja di sektor profesional lain. Kamis lalu, Wakil Menteri Sumber Daya Manusia dan Pengembangan Sosial untuk Tenaga Kerja Abdullah Abuthnain dan Sekretaris Kabinet Kenya untuk Buruh dan Perlindungan Sosial Alfred Nganga Mutua menandatangani annex teknis untuk perjanjian perekrutan pekerja domestik antara Arab Saudi dan Kenya yang telah ditandatangani pada 5 Juli 2026. Upacara penandatanganan itu diadakan selama kunjungan Alfred Nganga Mutua ke Riyadh. Annex adalah bagian dari upaya untuk memperkuat kerjasama dan mengembangkan mekanisme teknis dan regulasi yang mengatur perekrutan pekerja domestik. Departemen mencatat bahwa annex teknis dibangun sekitar tiga pilar utama: mengurangi biaya perekrutan, meningkatkan kualitas pekerja domestik melalui pelatihan dan program kualifikasi, dan menjaga hak-hak dari semua pihak yang terlibat dalam hubungan kontrak. Untuk bagiannya, pihak Kenya menyatakan kesiapan untuk memasok pekerja dalam negeri sesuai dengan peraturan dan prosedur yang berlaku di Kerajaan, sambil berpegang teguh pada persyaratan biaya perekrutan dan jangka waktu. Rekrutmen akan didasarkan pada permintaan yang sebenarnya dan persyaratan dari majikan, baik warga negara maupun penduduk. Mendagri menegaskan pentingnya memastikan keakuratan saat menyebarkan informasi terkait perekrutan, mendesak publik untuk bergantung seca
articles.originalTitle: HR Ministry: No agreement with Kenya for recruitment of skilled workers
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development has confirmed that the technical annex signed with Kenya is exclusively intended to regulate the recruitment of domestic workers and does not cover the recruitment of skilled workers for various sectors. The ministry clarified that no agreement is currently in place for the recruitment of skilled workers from Kenya.In a clarifying statement issued on Tuesday, the ministry explained that the recruitment of domestic workers from Kenya is confined to specific occupations, including domestic workers and private drivers, and does not extend to employment opportunities in other professional sectors.Last Thursday, Deputy Minister of Human Resources and Social Development for Labor Abdullah Abuthnain and Kenya’s Cabinet Secretary for Labour and Social Protection Alfred Nganga Mutua signed a technical annex to the agreement on the recruitment of domestic workers between Saudi Arabia and Kenya that had signed on July 5, 2026. The signing ceremony was held during the visit of Alfred Nganga Mutua to Riyadh. The annex is part of efforts to strengthen cooperation and develop the technical and regulatory mechanisms governing the recruitment of domestic workers.The ministry noted that the technical annex is built around three key pillars: reducing recruitment costs, enhancing the quality of domestic workers through training and qualification programs, and safeguarding the rights of all parties involved in the contractual relationship.For its part, the Kenyan side expressed its readiness to supply domestic workers in accordance with the regulations and procedures in force in the Kingdom, while adhering to the stipulated recruitment costs and timeframes. Recruitment will be based on actual demand and the requirements of employers, both citizens and residents.The ministry underscored the importance of ensuring accuracy when disseminating recruitment-related information, urging the public to rely exclusively on its officia

articles.title: Arab Saudi sangat mengutuk serangan berulang Iran di Bahrain
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Luar Negeri menyatakan kutukan terkuat Arab Saudi atas serangan berulang-ulang Iran di Bahrain, menggambarkan mereka sebagai pelanggaran yang mencolok terhadap hukum internasional dan prinsip-prinsip lingkungan yang baik. "Serangan ini melemahkan upaya perdamaian dan upaya yang berkelanjutan untuk menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas wilayah dan rakyatnya", kata Menteri dalam sebuah pernyataan. Arab Saudi menegaskan kembali solidaritas penuh dengan Bahrain dalam segala hal untuk menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas. The Kingdom juga menekankan kebutuhan mendesak untuk segera berhenti untuk semua serangan terang-terangan Iran terhadap negara-negara di wilayah, sementara mendasari pentingnya memungkinkan upaya diplomatik untuk mengejar perdamaian dan menyelesaikan krisis melalui negosiasi, pernyataan ditambahkan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns repeated Iranian attacks on Bahrain
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed Saudi Arabia’s strongest condemnation of the repeated Iranian attacks on Bahrain, describing them as a flagrant violation of international law and the principles of good neighborliness. “These attacks undermine peace efforts and ongoing endeavors to safeguard the security and stability of the region and its people,” the ministry said in a statement.Saudi Arabia reaffirmed its full solidarity with Bahrain in all measures it takes to safeguard its security and stability. The Kingdom also stressed the urgent need for an immediate halt to all blatant Iranian attacks against the countries of the region, while underscoring the importance of allowing diplomatic efforts to pursue peace and resolve the crisis through negotiations, the statement added.

articles.title: Raja Salman Royal Reserve mencatat dua kelahiran rusa Arab rentan
articles.description: SAKKA - Raja Salman bin Abdulaziz Royal Reserve mencatat dua kelahiran rusa Arab baru pada bulan November 2026, sebagai bagian dari upaya untuk memperkenalkan kembali spesies satwa liar, meningkatkan keanekaragaman hayati dan memulihkan keseimbangan ekologi dalam cadangan. Gazelle Arab (Gazella arabica), dikenal sebagai "Al- Idmi", diklasifikasikan sebagai Vulnerable di International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List dan merupakan salah satu spesies yang ditargetkan oleh program pengenalan ulang cadangan. * * Media [2795757] * Perempuan Arab rusa biasanya melahirkan satu keturunan pada suatu waktu, membuat dua kelahiran dicatat terutama signifikan untuk konservasi upaya ditujukan untuk melindungi spesies. Cadangan sebelumnya tercatat kelahiran rusa Arab pada tahun 2024. Kelahiran terbaru menunjukkan keberhasilan program perawatan dan pembiakan cadangan, serta keikutsertaan habitat alaminya untuk mendukung spesies dan mempertahankan reproduksi. * * media [2795759] * * Raja Salman bin Abdulaziz Royal Reserve Development Authority terus mengimplementasikan inisiatif untuk melindungi satwa liar, mengembangkan habitat alam dan memperkenalkan kembali spesies asli ke lingkungan asli mereka. Upaya ini berkontribusi untuk memulihkan keseimbangan ekologi, memperkaya keanekaragaman hayati dan memajukan tujuan keberlanjutan lingkungan Saudi Arabia.
articles.originalTitle: King Salman Royal Reserve records two births of vulnerable Arabian gazelles
articles.originalDescription: SKAKA — The King Salman bin Abdulaziz Royal Reserve recorded two new Arabian gazelle births in November 2026, as part of its ongoing efforts to reintroduce wildlife species, enhance biodiversity and restore ecological balance within the reserve. The Arabian gazelle (Gazella arabica), locally known as “Al-Idmi,” is classified as Vulnerable on the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List and is among the species targeted by the reserve’s reintroduction programs. **media[2795757]** Female Arabian gazelles typically give birth to one offspring at a time, making the two recorded births particularly significant for conservation efforts aimed at protecting the species. The reserve previously recorded Arabian gazelle births in 2024. The latest births indicate the success of the reserve’s care and breeding programs, as well as the suitability of its natural habitats for supporting the species and sustaining its reproduction. **media[2795759]** The King Salman bin Abdulaziz Royal Reserve Development Authority continues to implement initiatives aimed at protecting wildlife, developing natural habitats and reintroducing native species into their original environments. These efforts contribute to restoring ecological balance, enriching biodiversity and advancing Saudi Arabia’s environmental sustainability objectives.

articles.title: Nilai pasar dari lonjakan aset tak berwujud Saudi Exchange ke SR5.78 triliun
articles.description: RIYADH - Nilai pasar dari aset tak berwujud yang dipegang oleh perusahaan-perusahaan yang terdaftar di Pertukaran Saudi mencapai sekitar SR5.78 triliun pada akhir 2025, akuntansi sebesar 65,6 persen dari total nilai pasar mereka, menurut Asset tak berwujud 2025 di Kerajaan Arab Saudi laporan yang dikeluarkan oleh Saudi Authority for Inteleprential Properti (SAIP). Nilai aset tak berwujud diungkapkan dalam laporan keuangan berdiri di sekitar SR311.52 miliar, laporan menunjukkan. Laporan ini memeriksa kondisi aset tak berwujud saat ini, nilai ekonomi mereka, dan peran mereka dalam meningkatkan persaingan dan mendukung pengetahuan dan inovasi berbasis pertumbuhan ekonomi, sejalan dengan tujuan dari Saudi Vision 2030. Ini bertujuan untuk mengukur nilai pasar aset tak berwujud dipegang oleh perusahaan yang terdaftar di Saudi Exchange dan menganalisis distribusi mereka di sektor. Penerbitan laporan ini adalah bagian dari upaya SAIP untuk meningkatkan kesadaran akan nilai ekonomi dari aset tak berwujud dan mendukung pengembangan praktek pengelolaan dan investasi di dalamnya, sehingga berkontribusi untuk merangsang inovasi, menarik investasi, dan meningkatkan persaingan ekonomi nasional.
articles.originalTitle: Market value of Saudi Exchange’s intangible assets surges to SR5.78 trillion
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The market value of intangible assets held by companies listed on the Saudi Exchange reached approximately SR5.78 trillion at the end of 2025, accounting for 65.6 percent of their total market value, according to Intangible Assets 2025 in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia report issued by the Saudi Authority for Intellectual Property (SAIP).The value of intangible assets disclosed in financial statements stood at approximately SR311.52 billion, the report pointed out. The report examines the current state of intangible assets, their economic value, and their role in enhancing competitiveness and supporting knowledge- and innovation-based economic growth, in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030. It aims to measure the market value of intangible assets held by companies listed on the Saudi Exchange and analyze their distribution across sectors. The report’s publication is part of SAIP’s efforts to raise awareness of the economic value of intangible assets and support the development of practices for managing and investing in them, thereby contributing to stimulating innovation, attracting investment, and enhancing the competitiveness of the national economy.

articles.description: RIYADH - Dewan Insinyur Saudi, bekerja sama dengan platform "Mosadaqa", mendeteksi 603 sertifikat tidak sah dan 990 sertifikat yang tidak terakreditasi antara Januari dan Oktober 2026. Ini adalah bagian dari upaya untuk memverifikasi kualifikasi teknik, melindungi profesi, dan meningkatkan kredibilitas akreditasi profesional. Rekayasa elektrikal mencatat jumlah sertifikat tak valid tertinggi, dengan 174, diikuti dengan teknik sipil, arsitektur, dan konstruksi dengan 83, dan mekanik teknik dengan 79. Sertifikat yang tersisa didistribusikan di berbagai bidang teknik dan disiplin ilmu teknis. Dewan merujuk kasus yang melibatkan sertifikat tidak valid kepada pihak berwenang yang kompeten untuk tindakan lebih lanjut.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Council of Engineers detects 1,593 invalid and unaccredited certificates
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Saudi Council of Engineers, in cooperation with the "Mosadaqa" platform, detected 603 invalid certificates and 990 unaccredited certificates between January and October 2026. This was part of its efforts to verify engineering qualifications, protect the profession, and enhance the credibility of professional accreditation. Electrical engineering recorded the highest number of invalid certificates, with 174, followed by civil engineering, architecture, and construction with 83, and mechanical engineering with 79. The remaining certificates were distributed across other engineering and technical disciplines. The council referred cases involving invalid certificates to the competent authorities for further action.

articles.description: MakKAH - Komisi Kerajaan untuk kota suci dan surga telah mencapai dua tonggak global baru dengan Guinness World Records untuk museum tertinggi di dunia dalam sebuah bangunan dan dek observasi luar tertinggi. Rekor pertama mengakui Museum Clock Tower adalah museum tertinggi di dalam gedung, pada ketinggian 426.875 meter. Prestasi ini mencerminkan upaya-upaya yang sedang berlangsung komisi kerajaan untuk mengembangkan tengara terkemuka dan fasilitas, memanfaatkan sejarah Astan, ilmiah, dan aset arsitektur, memperkaya pengalaman penduduk, peziarah, dan pengunjung, dan memperkuat posisi kota sebagai tujuan global yang menggabungkan keaslian dengan modernitas.
articles.originalTitle: Makkah Clock Tower wins Guinness Records for highest museum, observation deck
articles.originalDescription: MAKKAH — The Royal Commission for Makkah City and Holy Sites has achieved two new global milestones with Guinness World Records for the world’s highest museum in a building and the highest outdoor observation deck. The first record recognizes the Makkah Clock Tower Museum as the highest museum inside a building, at an altitude of 426.875 meters. The second honors the world’s highest outdoor observation deck, located at 560.875 meters within the Makkah Clock Tower complex. This achievement reflects the royal commission’s ongoing efforts to develop prominent landmarks and facilities, harness Makkah’s historical, scientific, and architectural assets, enrich the experiences of residents, pilgrims, and visitors, and reinforce the city’s position as a global destination that blends authenticity with modernity.

articles.title: Britania sanksi pembangunan pemukiman Israel, Gaza pembantu-memblokir aktivis
articles.description: Britania sanksi pembangunan pemukiman Israel, Gaza pembantu-memblokir aktivis Pemerintah Inggris mengumumkan pada hari Selasa itu akan memaksakan sanksi pada delapan perusahaan konstruksi Israel yang terlibat dalam membangun pemukiman di Tepi Barat yang ditempati dan kelompok aktivis yang mencegah pengiriman bantuan ke Gaza. Inggris mengumumkan pembekuan aset dan direktur mendiskualifikasikan delapan perusahaan termasuk Har Hevron Development Company Ltd, Hemdat Shomron Ltd dan S.A.G. (Velvel) Konstruksi dan Pengembangan Ltd, yang membangun dan mengembangkan rumah di Tepi Barat. Pemerintah mengumumkan paket sanksi segera sebelum tenggat waktu akhir untuk E1 tender, proyek penyelesaian yang akan bisect Israel diduduki Bank Barat dan memotongnya dari Yerusalem Timur, fragmenting tanah Palestina harapan akan membentuk jantung negara. "Melindungi kedua solusi negara adalah Bintang Utara pendekatan Pemerintah ini", sekretaris asing Inggris, Ed Miliband, mengatakan dalam sebuah pernyataan. "Itulah sebabnya pesan saya di E1 jelas: jangan menawar, jangan membangun, dan tidak mendapatkan keuntungan dari kehancuran dua negara". Pemerintah juga dikenakan sanksi di Tzav 9, sebuah kelompok yang mengatakan secara teratur diblokir truk bantuan kemanusiaan memberikan makanan, air dan bahan bakar ke Jalur Gaza. Israel pada bulan September mengancam akan menutup pembangunan Konsulat Inggris di Yerusalem Timur dalam menanggapi keputusan London untuk memaksakan sanksi perdagangan terhadap pemukiman Israel di Tepi Barat. diplomat Inggris dan Israel bulan lalu mencapai kesepakatan-menit terakhir untuk menghindari penutupan konsulat. Pelaporan oleh Reuters
articles.originalTitle: Britain sanctions Israeli settlement builders, Gaza aid-blocking activists
articles.originalDescription: Britain sanctions Israeli settlement builders, Gaza aid-blocking activists The British government announced on Tuesday it would impose sanctions on eight Israeli construction companies involved in building settlements in the occupied West Bank and an activist group that prevents the delivery of aid to Gaza. Britain announced asset freezes and director disqualifications on the eight companies including Har Hevron Development Company Ltd, Hemdat Shomron Ltd and S.A.G. (Velvel) Construction and Development Ltd, which construct and develop homes in the West Bank. The government announced the sanctions package shortly before the final deadlines for the E1 tender, a settlement project which would bisect the Israeli-occupied West Bank and cut it off from East Jerusalem, fragmenting the land Palestinians hope will form the heart of a state. "Protecting the two-state solution is the North Star of this Government's approach," the British foreign secretary, Ed Miliband, said in a statement. "That is why my message on E1 is clear: do not bid, do not build, and do not profit from the destruction of the two-state solution." The government also imposed sanctions on Tzav 9, a group which it said had regularly blocked humanitarian aid trucks delivering food, water and fuel to the Gaza Strip. Israel in September threatened to close the British Consulate building in East Jerusalem in response to London’s decision to impose trade sanctions on Israeli settlements in the West Bank. British and Israeli diplomats last month reached a last-minute agreement to avoid the closure of the consulate. Reporting by Reuters

articles.title: Arab Saudi, Inggris menandatangani perjanjian untuk mempercepat akses ke perawatan medis inovatif
articles.description: LONDON - The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) menandatangani sebuah memorandum pemahaman (MoU) dengan Obat-obatan Inggris dan Layanan Kesehatan Produk (MHRA) untuk memajukan evaluasi pengobatan inovatif dan memfasilitasi akses pasien kepada mereka. Persetujuan itu ditandatangani oleh Kepala Eksekutif SFDA, Dr. Hisham bin Saad Al- Jadhey dan Kepala Eksekutif MHRA Lawrence Tallon di pinggir Asosiasi Informasi Obat-obatan dan Obat-obatan serta Badan Regulasi Layanan Kesehatan (DIA-MHRA) Global Summit, diselenggarakan di London pada bulan November 16-17, dengan tujuan untuk mempercepat akses ke pengobatan inovatif sambil mempertahankan keselamatan, kualitas dan standar keberhasilan. Kepala MHRA Profesor Anthony Harnden juga hadir di penandatanganan. Kedua pihak juga mengadakan diskusi mengenai prioritas kerja sama dalam hal perkembangan ilmiah dan regulasi. * * Media [2795632] * Membangun pada kerjasama yang sudah ada dan komitmen bersama untuk memajukan inovasi medis, MoU mencakup evaluasi pengobatan untuk penyakit langka, terapi lanjutan dan produk bioteknologi. Ini juga termasuk pengubahan keahlian tentang penggunaan kecerdasan buatan, pemodelan komputer dan simulasi dalam studi klinis dan uji coba, serta pendaftaran dan evaluasi produk medis, praktek manufaktur yang baik, sistem berkualitas, pengujian produk dan analisis, dan pengawasan rantai pasokan. Kerjasama ini diharapkan untuk membantu mengklarifikasi persyaratan regulasi bagi pengembang pada tahap awal, terutama mereka yang mengembangkan pengobatan untuk pasien dengan pilihan terapi terbatas. Upaya ini bertujuan untuk memperkuat keamanan produk medis di pasar kedua negara dan meningkatkan kemampuan otoritas baik untuk mengidentifikasi dan memantau risiko terkait.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia, UK sign agreement to accelerate access to innovative medical treatments
articles.originalDescription: LONDON — The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the UK's Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) to advance the evaluation of innovative treatments and facilitate timely patient access to them. The agreement was signed by SFDA Chief Executive Officer Dr. Hisham bin Saad Al-Jadhey and MHRA Chief Executive Lawrence Tallon on the sidelines of the Drug Information Association and Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (DIA-MHRA) Global Summit, held in London on November 16–17, with the aim of accelerating access to innovative treatments while maintaining safety, quality and efficacy standards. MHRA Chair Professor Anthony Harnden was also present at the signing. The two sides also held discussions on cooperation priorities in light of recent scientific and regulatory developments. **media[2795632]** Building on existing cooperation and a shared commitment to advancing medical innovation, the MoU covers the evaluation of treatments for rare diseases, advanced therapies and biotechnology products. It also includes exchanging expertise on the use of artificial intelligence, computer modeling and simulation in clinical studies and trials, as well as the registration and evaluation of medical products, good manufacturing practices, quality systems, product testing and analysis, and supply chain monitoring. The cooperation is expected to help clarify regulatory requirements for developers at an early stage, particularly those developing treatments for patients with limited therapeutic options. These efforts aim to strengthen medical product safety in both countries' markets and enhance the ability of both authorities to identify and monitor associated risks.

According to news reports and campaigners, more than 40 international activists have been deported since 1 October over allegations including entering a restricted zone, disrupting public order and terrorism. “Despite their obsessive and extensive surveillance apparatus, the occupation is afraid of people knowing the truth about what’s going on. The activist, who declined to be identified, was arrested on 6 November and subsequently deported. “They even took away people’s phones or destroyed them,” she added. articles.title: Arab Saudi pulih hampir 70.000 artefak arkeologi, termasuk 28.577 dari luar negeri
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi telah pulih sekitar 70.000 artefak arkeologi dari dalam Kerajaan dan di luar negeri pada tahun 2026, termasuk 28.577 artefak kembali dari luar negeri, menurut Komisi Warisan Saudi. Komisi mengungkapkan bahwa lebih dari 41.000 artefak ditemukan di Arab Saudi, sementara yang diambil dari luar negeri dihitung lebih dari 40 persen dari total. Di antara pemulihan yang terkenal, keluarga Amerika mengembalikan 1,127 artefak arkeologi ke Arab Saudi pada tahun 2019. Barang-barang ini telah diselenggarakan oleh kerabat yang sebelumnya bekerja di Kingdom pada tahun 1960-an. Dalam kasus lain, sebuah tablet batu bantalan prasasti kuno Arab dari wilayah Tabuk dikembalikan dari Perancis setelah tersisa dalam kepemilikan warga negara Perancis selama sekitar 40 tahun. Kembalinya telah dikoordinasikan dengan otoritas Saudi dan UNESCO. Dalam Kerajaan, upaya pemulihan telah termasuk handover sukarela oleh warga negara dan kejang artefak yang ditawarkan untuk dijual secara ilegal. Dalam Hail, seorang warga negara menyerahkan kapal perunggu dating ke periode Islam, dihiasi dengan motif bunga dan ayat-ayat Quraisy. Di Bisha, warga negara lain kembali enam artefak arkeologi, beberapa tanggal untuk masa pra-Islam, termasuk batu terukir dengan ayat-ayat Surah Al- Falaq. Sementara itu, di Al- Ahsa, Komisi Warisan menyita langka artefak tanggal ke awal Islam periode pada tahun 2025 setelah ditawarkan untuk dijual secara ilegal melalui media sosial.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia recovers nearly 70,000 archaeological artifacts, including 28,577 from abroad
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia has recovered approximately 70,000 archaeological artifacts from within the Kingdom and abroad as of 2026, including 28,577 artifacts returned from overseas, according to the Saudi Heritage Commission. The commission revealed that more than 41,000 artifacts were recovered within Saudi Arabia, while those retrieved from abroad accounted for more than 40 percent of the total. Among the notable recoveries, American families returned 1,127 archaeological artifacts to Saudi Arabia in 2019. The items had been held by relatives who previously worked in the Kingdom during the 1960s. In another case, a stone tablet bearing ancient Arabic inscriptions from the Tabuk region was returned from France after remaining in the possession of a French citizen for approximately 40 years. Its return was coordinated with Saudi authorities and UNESCO. **media[2795591]** Within the Kingdom, recovery efforts have included voluntary handovers by citizens and the seizure of artifacts offered for sale illegally. In Hail, a citizen handed over a bronze vessel dating to the Islamic period, decorated with floral motifs and Quranic verses. In Bisha, another citizen returned six archaeological artifacts, some dating to the pre-Islamic period, including a stone engraved with verses from Surah Al-Falaq. Meanwhile, in Al-Ahsa, the Heritage Commission seized a rare artifact dating to the early Islamic period in 2025 after it was offered for sale illegally through social media.

articles.title: Transportasi Saudi dan registrasi penyimpanan meningkat 31% menjadi 185.554 di Q3 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - Registrasi komersial aktif di sektor transportasi dan penyimpanan Arab Saudi naik 31 persen menjadi 185.554 di akhir Q3 dari 2026, sementara transportasi transportasi di jalan registrasi meningkat 52 persen, menurut Departemen Perdagangan. Departemen melaporkan pertumbuhan pendaftaran komersial yang aktif di beberapa kegiatan transportasi dan logistik, mencerminkan memperluas aktivitas perdagangan dan pengembangan rantai pasokan sejalan dengan Saudi Vision 2030. Registrasi komersial aktif dalam layanan logistik mencapai 29.992 pada akhir kuartal ketiga 2026, naik 35 persen dari 22.097 selama periode yang sama pada 2025. Sementara itu, sektor transportasi dan penyimpanan mencatat peningkatan 31 persen, dengan pendaftaran komersial yang aktif mencapai 185.554, dibandingkan dengan 141.180 per tahun sebelumnya. Transportasi angkutan jalan mencatat laju pertumbuhan tertinggi di antara kegiatan yang disorot, dengan pendaftaran meningkat 52 persen dari 68.697 pada kuartal ketiga 2025 sampai 104.612 pada kuartal ketiga 2026. Registrasi komersial untuk penyimpanan di pelabuhan, fasilitas bea cukai dan zona bebas juga meningkat 46 persen, mencapai 9.111 dibandingkan dengan 6.228 selama periode yang sama tahun lalu. Departemen mengatakan pertumbuhan mencerminkan memperluas peluang bisnis dan investasi dan sektor swasta meningkatkan peran dalam mengembangkan ekosistem logistik, mendukung persaingan ekonomi dan memperkuat Saudi Arabia sebagai pusat logistik global.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi transport and storage registrations rise 31% to 185,554 in Q3 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Active commercial registrations in Saudi Arabia’s transport and storage sector rose 31 percent to 185,554 by the end of Q3 of 2026, while road freight transport registrations surged 52 percent, according to the Ministry of Commerce. The ministry reported growth in active commercial registrations across several transport and logistics activities, reflecting expanding trade activity and supply chain development in line with Saudi Vision 2030. Active commercial registrations in logistics services reached 29,992 by the end of the third quarter of 2026, up 35 percent from 22,097 during the same period in 2025. Meanwhile, the transport and storage sector recorded a 31 percent increase, with active commercial registrations reaching 185,554, compared with 141,180 a year earlier. Road freight transport recorded the highest growth rate among the activities highlighted, with registrations rising 52 percent from 68,697 in the third quarter of 2025 to 104,612 in the third quarter of 2026. Commercial registrations for storage at ports, customs facilities and free zones also increased 46 percent, reaching 9,111 compared with 6,228 during the same period last year. The ministry said the growth reflects expanding business and investment opportunities and the private sector’s increasing role in developing the logistics ecosystem, supporting economic competitiveness and strengthening Saudi Arabia’s position as a global logistics hub.

articles.originalTitle: Iran’s Ghalibaf warns US, Israel against targeting civilian infrastructure
articles.originalDescription: Iran’s Ghalibaf warns US, Israel against targeting civilian infrastructure Iran’s top negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has warned of retaliation to the US and Israel after a New York Times report quoted analysts pointing to Tehran's "dual-use" of civilian infrastructure. "Prepping the next round on civilian infra, their 'experts' tell NYT: 'dams near Iran’s missile sites are dual-use.'," he mockingly referenced the article. "Cool. New rule: Any dam, port, or power plant near a US or Israeli base is dual-use. We’ll apply your logic consistently and even-handedly," Ghalibaf added. The US and Israel have previously attacked civilian areas and infrastructure across the region under the guise that they are used for military purpose, despite having no evidence for such claims. As a result, countless civilians have been killed and wounded in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.

articles.title: Mamdani untuk membubarkan unit khusus NYPD yang dikerahkan selama protes pro-Palestina
articles.description: Mamdani untuk membubarkan unit khusus NYPD yang dikerahkan selama protes protes walikota New York Zohran Mamdani diumumkan pada hari Senin bahwa ia akan menepati janji kampanyenya untuk membubarkan Grup Respon Strategis Departemen Kepolisian New York (SRG) dan menggantinya dengan "de- eskalasi group". Armour-clad SRG terdiri dari 500 perwira NYPD yang sangat terlatih yang telah menjadi terkenal karena "taktik pengendalian massa" mereka dan penangkapan massal selama protes di New York City, di mana mereka menggunakan baton, gas air mata, semprotan merica dan senjata "de- eskalasi" lainnya pada demonstran yang mengganggu. Kelompok tersebut berada di bawah pengawasan khusus selama protes di Palestina selama puncak genosida Israel di Gaza dan protes kampus yang dipimpin oleh gerakan pelajar yang dimulai di Universitas Columbia. Baca lebih lanjut: Mamdani untuk membubarkan unit khusus NYPD yang dikerahkan selama protes pro-Palestina
articles.originalTitle: Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests
articles.originalDescription: Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced on Monday that he will keep his campaign promise to disband the New York Police Department's Strategic Response Group (SRG) and replace it with “de-escalation groups”. The armour-clad SRG is made up of 500 highly trained NYPD officers who have become infamous for their “crowd control tactics” and mass arrests during protests in New York City, where they use batons, tear gas, pepper spray and other “de-escalation” weapons on disruptive protesters. The group came under particular scrutiny during pro-Palestine protests during the height of Israel’s genocide in Gaza and campus protests led by the student movement that started at Columbia University. Read more: Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests
