articles.title: Militer Islam Coalition meluncurkan program kontraterorisme tahun ke-2 di Chad
articles.description: N 'DJAMENA - Kontra Militer Islam Terorisme Koalisi (IMCTC) diluncurkan pada hari Senin tahun kedua program untuk negara-negara Sahel di N' Djamena, ibukota Chad, dengan dukungan dari Arab Saudi. Program empat minggu, berjalan dari 16 November ke 11 Desember 2026, bertujuan untuk melatih 150 personil sipil dan militer melalui serangkaian program dan workshop meliputi ideologi, media, pembiayaan teroris, dan aspek militer. Upacara peluncuran itu dihadiri oleh Menteri Tempur Chad, Veteran, dan Korban Perang Issakha Maloua Djaous; Sekretaris Jendral IMCTC. Jenderal Moghedi Al-, dan beberapa militer, keamanan, dan pejabat sipil dari Chad. Tahun kedua dibangun dengan pencapaian program ini pada tahun pertama, di mana koalisi yang dilakukan dengan 22 kegiatan menguntungkan 2,300 orang di lima negara: Mauritania, Mali, Niger, Atlantis Faso, dan Chad. Dalam alamatnya, Menteri Djaous menyatakan kebanggaan Chad dalam keanggotaan dalam koalisi, mengatakan peluncuran program tahun kedua mencerminkan dukungan IMCTC yang berkelanjutan untuk negara-negara Sahel dalam memerangi terorisme. Dia mengatakan empat bidang pekerjaan ditujukan taktik berkembang kelompok teroris, termasuk penyebaran ideologi ekstrimis, mengeksploitasi platform media, mengamankan pendanaan, dan melaksanakan operasi. Dia menambahkan bahwa pelatihan 150 personil sipil dan militer akan membantu memperkuat kemampuan lembaga Chadian bertanggung jawab untuk menangani ancaman ini. Menteri mengatakan terorisme tetap menjadi salah satu tantangan utama dari era ini, melintasi perbatasan dan harapan untuk kerjasama dan stabilitas. Dia menekankan bahwa pergerakan kelompok teroris di seluruh negara Sahel diperlukan koordinasi regional dan internasional, menegaskan komitmen Chad untuk keamanan dan pertahanan kolektif upaya sejalan dengan prioritas nasional dan kerjasama regional. Dia berterima kasih kepada Penjaga dari dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman untuk peran Keraja
articles.originalTitle: Islamic Military Coalition launches 2nd year of Saudi-backed counterterrorism program in Chad
articles.originalDescription: N’DJAMENA — The Islamic Military Counter Terrorism Coalition (IMCTC) launched on Monday the second year of its program for the Sahel countries in N’Djamena, capital of Chad, with support from Saudi Arabia.The four-week program, running from November 16 to December 11, 2026, aims to train 150 civilian and military personnel through a series of programs and workshops covering ideological, media, counter-terrorist financing, and military aspects.The launch ceremony was attended by Chad’s Minister of the Armed Forces, Veterans, and War Victims Issakha Maloua Djamous; IMCTC Secretary General Maj. Gen. Mohammed Al-Moghedi; and several military, security, and civilian officials from Chad. The second year builds on the achievements of the program’s first year, during which the coalition conducted 22 activities benefiting 2,300 people across five countries: Mauritania, Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso, and Chad. **media[2795492]**In his address, Minister Djamous expressed Chad’s pride in its membership in the coalition, saying the launch of the program’s second year reflected IMCTC’s continued support for Sahel countries in combating terrorism.He said the four areas of work addressed the evolving tactics of terrorist groups, including spreading extremist ideology, exploiting media platforms, securing funding, and carrying out operations. He added that training 150 civilian and military personnel would help strengthen the capabilities of Chadian institutions responsible for addressing these threats.The minister said terrorism remained one of the major challenges of the present era, crossing borders and undermining prospects for cooperation and stability. articles.description: Somalia-Amerika Pengemudi Uber koma setelah dugaan kejahatan di Minnesota dikeluarkan oleh staf MEE pada Mon, 11 / 16 / 2026 - 18: 46 Mohamed Yusuf dilaporkan dijalankan berkali-kali dengan kendaraan miliknya sendiri setelah seorang penumpang mengatakan dia tidak menyukai nama muslim-nya sebuah foto penggalangan dana GofundMe diluncurkan untuk mendukung Mohamed Yusuf, pengemudi Uber Somalia-Amerika yang diduga mengalami serangan terhadap kejahatan di Minnesota Off A Somalia-Amerika yang diduga memiliki kebencian terhadap keluarganya sendiri dengan kendaraan-nya sendiri setelah mengalami serangan anti-bunuh diri sendiri. Mohamed Yusuf bekerja di Hopkins, pinggiran kota Minneapolis, awal hari Sabtu ketika seorang penumpang diduga bertanya namanya sebelum mengatakan bahwa dia tidak suka nama "Mohamed". Menurut keluarga Yusuf, penumpang kemudian diduga mencekiknya dari belakang, mengambil alih kendaraan dan menabraknya berkali-kali. "Dia ditabrak beberapa kali dengan kendaraan sendiri", anak Yusuf, Mustafa Osman, mengatakan The Somalia Brief. Yusuf dilaporkan ditemukan di selokan hampir satu mil jauhnya, menderita patah kaki dan tulang rusuk, dua paru-paru runtuh, cedera tulang belakang dan pendarahan internal. Dia tetap dirawat di rumah sakit dalam keadaan koma, menurut keluarganya. Polisi Hopkins mengkonfirmasi bahwa petugas menanggapi laporan kendaraan mencurigakan sekitar pukul 1.20 pagi pada hari Sabtu menemukan seorang pria terluka serius dan kemudian mengambil tersangka laki-laki ke dalam tahanan. Menurut Times of India, catatan penangkapan menunjukkan bahwa seorang pria diidentifikasi sebagai Samit Aspuva Patel ditangkap oleh Polisi Hopkins pada 14 November pada tuduhan penyerangan tingkat pertama. Namun, pihak berwenang belum mengkonfirmasi apakah Patel apos; s penangkapan berhubungan dengan serangan Yusuf atau publik mengidentifikasi tersangka dalam kasus ini. articles.originalTitle: Somali-American Uber driver left in coma after alleged hate crime in Minnesota
articles.originalDescription: Somali-American Uber driver left in coma after alleged hate crime in Minnesota Submitted by MEE staff on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 18:46 Mohamed Yusuf was reportedly run over multiple times with his own vehicle after a passenger said he disliked his Muslim name A screenshot of a GoFundMe fundraiser launched to support Mohamed Yusuf, the Somali-American Uber driver who was the victim of a suspected hate crime in Minnesota Off A Somali-American Uber driver is fighting for his life after being strangled and repeatedly run over with his own vehicle, allegedly by a passenger in Minnesota, in an attack his family believes was motivated by anti-Muslim hatred. Mohamed Yusuf was working in Hopkins, a suburb of Minneapolis, early on Saturday when a passenger allegedly asked him his name before telling him he did not like the name "Mohamed". According to Yusuf's relatives, the passenger then allegedly choked him from behind, seized control of his vehicle and ran him over multiple times. "He was run over multiple times with his own vehicle," Yusuf's son, Mustafa Osman, told The Somali Brief . Yusuf was reportedly found in a ditch nearly a mile away, suffering from broken legs and ribs, two collapsed lungs, a spinal injury and internal bleeding. He remains hospitalised in a coma, according to his family. Hopkins police confirmed that officers responding to a report of a suspicious vehicle at around 1.20am on Saturday discovered a seriously injured man and subsequently took a male suspect into custody. According to the Times of India , arrest records show that a man identified as Samit Apurva Patel was taken into custody by Hopkins Police on 14 November on a first-degree assault charge. However, authorities have not confirmed whether Patel's arrest is connected to Yusuf's assault or publicly identified the suspect in the case. articles.title: Gubernur Texas datang untuk membalikkan sebutan teror bagi kelompok kebebasan sipil Muslim
articles.description: Masuk Gubernur Texas untuk membalikkan panggilan teror bagi pemerintah kebebasan sipil Muslim-memilih staf MEE pada Mon, 11 / 16 / 2026 - 15: 57 Gina Hinojosa mengatakan menindak non-profit tidak meningkatkan keamanan publik Pemerintah Texas - memilih Gina Hinojosa muncul dengan pendukung di luar Pusat Rekreasi Austin - sebelum polling ditutup pada Hari Pemilihan, pada 3 November 2026, di Austin, Texas (Chip Somodevilla / Getty Ofration Off) kelompok teroris yang dipilih nya dari partai Republik Texas, yang akan memilih kelompok tersebut, Dalam sebuah wawancara yang diterbitkan oleh The Washington Post pada hari Sabtu, Hinojosa, yang dengan rela mengalahkan tiga orang Gubernur Greg Abbott di pertengahan semester pemilihan awal bulan ini untuk menjadi wanita Hispanik pertama dalam peran, mengatakan dia akan menarik perintah eksekutif untuk memeras Dewan tentang Hubungan Islam Amerika (Cair). "Kita harus menggunakan langkah-langkah keamanan publik untuk keselamatan publik", katanya. Hinojosa akan dilantik ke kantor pada bulan Januari. Kelompok hak-hak sipil di negara bagian menyambut pergerakan, stasiun lokal di Austin, Fox7, dilaporkan. "Greg Abbott digunakan kantornya untuk bahan bakar anti-Muslim permusuhan dan mengintimidasi organisasi membela hak-hak masyarakat mereka," Sam Robles, direktur eksekutif Texas Nonprofit Protection Network, mengatakan dalam sebuah pernyataan. "Abbott secara politis termotivasi sebagai CAIR sebagai organisasi teroris adalah eskalasi lain dalam kampanye yang berusaha menggambarkan partisipasi warga Muslim dan advokasi sebagai ancaman keselamatan publik". Hampir setahun yang lalu, Abbott mengumumkan bahwa ia menunjuk Persaudaraan Muslim serta Cair sebagai organisasi teroris asing dan organisasi kriminal transnasional. Akibatnya, kedua kelompok tersebut dilarang "dari pembelian atau memperoleh tanah" di Texas. Pengumuman itu memberi Jaksa Agung pemerintah untuk menuntut kelompok-kelompok tersebut. Aipac menghabiskan 55m dolar untuk kehila
articles.originalTitle: Incoming Texas governor to reverse terror designation for Muslim civil liberties group
articles.originalDescription: Incoming Texas governor to reverse terror designation for Muslim civil liberties group Submitted by MEE staff on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 15:57 Gina Hinojosa said cracking down on nonprofits does not increase public safety Texas Democratic governor-elect Gina Hinojosa appears with supporters outside the Austin Recreation Center before polls closed on Election Day, on 3 November 2026, in Austin, Texas (Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images via AFP) Off The Democratic governor-elect of Texas, Gina Hinojosa, has revealed she will reverse her predecessor's designation of the largest Muslim civil liberties group in the US as a terrorist organisation. In an interview published by The Washington Post on Saturday, Hinojosa, who handily beat three-term Governor Greg Abbott in the midterm elections earlier this month to become the first Hispanic woman in the role, said she would withdraw the executive order blacklisting the Council on American Islamic Relations (Cair). “We have to use public safety measures for public safety," she said. Hinojosa will be sworn into office in January. Civil rights groups in the state welcomed the move, the local station in Austin, Fox7, reported. "Greg Abbott used his office to fuel anti-Muslim hostility and intimidate the organizations defending their communities' rights," Sam Robles, executive director of the Texas Nonprofit Protection Network, said in a statement. "Abbott’s politically motivated designation of CAIR as a terrorist organization was another escalation in a campaign that sought to portray Muslim civic participation and advocacy as a public safety threat." Almost a year ago to the day, Abbott announced that he was designating the Muslim Brotherhood as well as Cair as foreign terrorist organisations and transnational criminal organisations. As a result, both groups were barred "from purchasing or acquiring land" in Texas. The proclamation gave the state's attorney general leeway to sue the groups accordingly. articles.title: Saudi, Mesir, dan menteri luar negeri Qatar mendiskusikan de- eskalasi daerah dalam panggilan telepon
articles.description: RIYADH - Saudi Menteri Luar Negeri Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan mengangkat telepon dengan menteri asing Mesir dan Qatar pada hari Senin. Selama panggilan, Pangeran Faisal dan Menteri Luar Negeri Mesir, Kerjasama Internasional, dan Mesir Expatriates Dr Badar Abdelatty meninjau hubungan bilateral antara dua negara dan menjelajahi cara untuk memperkuat dan memajukan kerjasama di berbagai bidang. Dua menteri juga mendiskusikan perkembangan regional terbaru, mendasari pentingnya koordinasi dan konsultasi yang berkelanjutan, serta dukungan untuk upaya diplomatik yang bertujuan untuk mengurangi eskalasi untuk membantu konsolidasi keamanan dan stabilitas regional. Dalam percakapan telepon yang terpisah, Pangeran Faisal dan Qatar Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Luar Negeri Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani mendiskusikan perkembangan regional terbaru dan upaya yang berkelanjutan untuk mempromosikan pengurangan dan menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas di wilayah tersebut.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi, Egyptian, and Qatari foreign ministers discuss regional de-escalation in phone call
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan held phone calls with foreign ministers of Egypt and Qatar on Monday.During the call, Prince Faisal and Egypt’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation, and Egyptian Expatriates Dr. Badr Abdelatty reviewed bilateral relations between the two countries and explored ways to further strengthen and advance cooperation across various fields. The two ministers also discussed the latest regional developments, underscoring the importance of continued coordination and consultation, as well as support for diplomatic efforts aimed at de-escalation to help consolidate regional security and stability.In a separate telephone conversation, Prince Faisal and Qatari Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani discussed the latest regional developments and ongoing efforts to promote de-escalation and maintain security and stability in the region.

articles.originalDescription: The paper trail that leads from the UAE to a dead boy in Sudan Submitted by Ahmed Ismat Ahmed on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 14:01 The RSF killed Osama, my little brother's 12-year-old best friend. This is what made it possible Osama (r) and his best friend Mohammed, pictured a week before the war in Sudan began in April 2023 (Ahmed Ismat Ahmed/MEE) On Osama was my younger brother’s best friend. He was 12. The Rapid Support Forces killed him when they attacked a town in al-Jazira state , Sudan , in 2023. The two of them used to share the same bicycle - one pedalling, the other running beside it, hand on the seat. Then one of them simply stopped existing. After the Khartoum sit-in was broken in the spring of 2019 and the resistance committees - nationwide groups of local activists of which I was a part - moved into the neighbourhoods, a few of us found ourselves guarding wool. Eid was coming. Families who could still afford it had bought sheep. When the slaughtering was done, the wool was left in the open lot where we used to meet. Someone said it was a waste to sell it in small piles for almost nothing. Someone else said the locality had not touched the streetlights on our main road in months. Children fell when it rained. Old people stopped walking to the mosque after dark because they could not see the path. We gathered the wool and took turns sitting with it at night. When the money came - folded, counted twice - we sat down and wrote it into a cheap notebook with a blue cover. I learned early that there are two kinds of paperwork. They do not answer to the same people Different hands. The wool money. The cost of the generator. Who had counted. The names of the boys who brought something. articles.description: Bagaimana Maroko menjadi pusat keamanan Israel di Afrika Diberikan oleh Ahmed Alqarout di Fri, 11 / 13 / 2026 - 18: 04 Rabat menawarkan kepada Abraham Accates nya mitra tempat aman industri, jauh dari rudal dan sanksi Seorang tentara Israel meluncurkan kendaraan udara tak berawak Elbit, digunakan untuk pengawasan, dekat perbatasan Gaza pada 30 September 2025 (Jack Guez / AFP) Off Di Pertunjukan Udara Marrakech bulan lalu, Departemen Pertahanan Israel membuka paviliun resmi pertamanya di Maroko. Delapan perusahaan Israel, di antara mereka dimiliki Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) dan Rafael, menunjukkan drone, berkeliaran amunisi dan sistem pertahanan udara, sementara Elbit 's Maroko usaha gabungan mengumumkan bahwa hal itu akan memberikan menara ke tentara Maroko dari Maret 2027. Juga di pertunjukan udara, kelompok pertahanan UAE Edge menandatangani kontrak untuk mempersenjatai drone Maroko. Acara ini bertepatan dengan ulang tahun 7 Oktober, yang menarik demonstran untuk berjaga-jaga di luar parlemen di Rabat. Acara-acara yang disebut di beberapa 30 kota Maroko, mendesak pemerintah untuk menjatuhkan langkah-langkah baru bertujuan lebih lanjut normalisasi hubungan dengan Israel. Perang di Gaza mempercepat kemitraan itu, sebagai boikot global dan sanksi terhadap Israel diperluas. Iran mengatakan hal itu menyerang Rafael dan situs IAI, bersama dengan pemasok pesawat tanpa awak, dan Emirates Global Aluminium' s Abu Dhabi tanaman mengalami kerusakan yang signifikan. articles.originalTitle: How Morocco is becoming Israel's security hub in Africa
articles.originalDescription: How Morocco is becoming Israel's security hub in Africa Submitted by Ahmed Alqarout on Fri, 11/13/2026 - 18:04 Rabat offers its Abraham Accords partners an industrial safe haven, away from missiles and sanctions An Israeli soldier launches an Elbit unmanned aerial vehicle, used for surveillance, near the border with Gaza on 30 September 2025 (Jack Guez/AFP) Off At the Marrakech Air Show last month, Israel ’s defence ministry opened its first official pavilion in Morocco . Eight Israeli firms , among them the state-owned Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) and Rafael, showed drones, loitering munitions and air defence systems, while Elbit’s Moroccan joint venture announced that it would deliver turrets to the Moroccan army from March 2027. Also at the air show, the UAE ’s defence group Edge signed a contract to arm Morocco’s drones. The event coincided with the anniversary of 7 October, which drew protesters to a vigil outside parliament in Rabat. Events were called in some 30 Moroccan cities, urging the government to drop new measures aimed at further normalising ties with Israel . BDS Morocco called for a boycott of the Marrakech show. The air show illustrates how, since joining the Abraham Accords in 2020, Morocco has moved from buying Israeli weapons to building them . The war on Gaza accelerated that partnership, as global boycotts and sanctions against Israel expanded. In Europe, Spain cancelled €1.2bn ($1.3bn) of Israeli military contracts, and France barred Israel from the Eurosatory defence exhibition. The war with Iran further exposed Israeli and Emirati industries. Iran said it struck Rafael and IAI sites, along with a drone supplier , and Emirates Global Aluminium’s Abu Dhabi plant suffered significant damage . articles.description: Hakim ICC memerintahkan untuk mengakhiri penyelidikan terhadap dugaan kejahatan oleh pasukan AS di Afghanistan Diberikan oleh Sondos Asem pada Mon, 11 / 16 / 2026 - 10: 56 Keputusan, ditandai dalam urutan pertama yang dilaporkan oleh MEE pada bulan Agustus, menimbulkan pertanyaan atas apakah pengadilan sedang berusaha untuk meringankan AS berikut Sanctions Rosario Salvatore Aitala, sekarang hakim dari ICC 's Preal Chamber II, pada sumpah-nya dalam upacara di The Hague pada 9 Maret 2018 (ICC / Flirr) Off Hakim di International Crime Court (ICC) telah memerintahkan penutupan pengadilan pengadilan yang meliput kasus-kasus yang sedang berlangsung oleh pihak-pihak yang mengajukan tuntutan oleh pihak-tuntutan pengadilan internasional. Mengakhiri penyelidikan terhadap dugaan kejahatan AS alamat salah satu Washington' s lama keberatan kepada ICC dan salah satu alasan di balik sanksi pada pengadilan dan pejabat tersebut. Karena itu, kemungkinan besar untuk menimbulkan pertanyaan tentang apakah pengadilan mencari untuk meringankan ketegangan dengan Washington dengan menandatangani bahwa hal itu tidak akan lagi mengejar tuduhan terhadap pasukan AS dan sekutu mereka. Situasi Afghanistan di ICC tanggal kembali ke November 2017, ketika kemudian-Jaksa Fatou Bensouda pertama kali meminta otorisasi untuk menyelidiki dugaan kejahatan yang dilakukan sejak 2003, termasuk oleh Afghanistan dan pasukan AS serta kelompok Taliban dan ISK. Permintaan itu awalnya ditolak oleh yang berbeda terdiri ruang pra-pengadilan pada tahun 2019, sebelum ruang banding terbalik keputusan pada bulan Maret 2020 dan berwenang penyelidikan untuk melanjutkan. Bensouda disetujui oleh pemerintah AS beberapa bulan kemudian atas upaya dugaan untuk subjek Amerika ke yurisdiksi pengadilan. Anggota dari ruang banding yang berwenang keputusan juga kemudian sanksi. articles.originalDescription: ICC judges order end to investigation into alleged crimes by US forces in Afghanistan Submitted by Sondos Asem on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 10:56 The decision, signalled in an order first reported by MEE in August, raises questions over whether the court is seeking to ease US pressure following sanctions Rosario Salvatore Aitala, now presiding judge of the ICC’s Pre-Trial Chamber II, at his swearing-in ceremony in The Hague on 9 March 2018 (ICC/Flikr) Off Judges at the International Criminal Court (ICC) have ordered the closure of the court’s Afghanistan investigation that covered alleged war crimes by US forces, despite ongoing attempts by prosecutors to appeal the decision. Ending the investigation into alleged US crimes addresses one of Washington ’s longstanding objections to the ICC and one of the reasons behind the sanctions on the court and its officials. The move is therefore likely to raise questions about whether the court is seeking to ease tensions with Washington by signalling that it will no longer pursue allegations against US forces and their allies. The Afghanistan situation at the ICC dates back to November 2017, when then-prosecutor Fatou Bensouda first requested authorisation to investigate alleged crimes committed since 2003, including by Afghan and US forces as well as the Taliban and the IS-K group. That request was initially rejected by a differently composed pre-trial chamber in 2019, before the appeals chamber overturned the decision in March 2020 and authorised the investigation to proceed. Bensouda was sanctioned by the US government a few months later over alleged attempts to subject Americans to the court's jurisdiction. Members of the appeals chamber that authorised the decision were also later sanctioned. articles.title: Saudi-pasukan mundur dari Bab al- Mandab sebagai tanah galian Houthis
articles.description: Saudi- pasukan mundur dari Bab al- Mandab sebagai Houthis tanah gain Dikirimkan oleh staf MEE pada Mon, 11 / 16 / 2026 - 12: 09 Angkatan Bersenjata Selatan mengatakan bahwa tindakan ini dimaksudkan untuk memperkuat Aden, sementara klaim Houthis mereka mendorong pasukan dari posisi yang menghadap ke arah laut strategis di Yaman Yang berwenang berkumpul selama protes terhadap Saudi Intervention di Sanaa, 9 Oktober 2026 (Mohammed Huwais / AFP) Off Saudi - didukung pasukan di Yaman telah ditarik dari posisi yang menghadap Bab al- Mandab Selat strategis, meninggalkan Houthis dengan pengaruh yang lebih besar di pintu masuk selatan ke Laut Merah. Angkatan Bersenjata Selatan, yang didukung oleh Arab Saudi dan berjuang bersama pemerintah Yaman yang diakui internasional, berkata pada hari Minggu mereka mengerahkan pasukan dari bandara Dhubab dan daerah Bab al- Mandab untuk memperkuat pertahanan di sekitar ibukota internal Aden. "Langkah ini diambil berdasarkan prioritas mengamankan ibukota, Aden, dan pemerintah tetangga, serta memperkuat garis depan dan mengatasi ancaman yang sudah ada", kata kelompok dalam sebuah pernyataan. Perumahan, secara resmi dikenal sebagai Ansar Allah, menawarkan rekening yang berbeda. Seorang sumber militer dikutip oleh agen berita Houthi- run Saba mengatakan bahwa mereka telah memaksa Saudi-didukung pasukan keluar dari posisi sekitar Dhubab dan Bab al- Mandab setelah memisahkan rute pasokan belakang mereka, memaksa mereka untuk bergerak menuju Aden. The Houthi- run outlet juga melaporkan bahwa pasukan kelompok telah melakukan operasi mengapit di lebih dari 60km daerah pegunungan dari Taiz dan Lahij, memaksa pasukan musuh untuk mundur dari posisi di sekitar bandara Dhubab, pinggiran Kahbub dan daerah sekitar Bab al- Mandab. Perkembangan terbaru memberikan Houthis pengaruh lebih atas bagaimana Bab Al- Mandab, salah satu titik yang paling kritis dari lalu lintas jalur air di dunia, dikendalikan. articles.originalTitle: Saudi-backed forces retreat from Bab al-Mandab as Houthis gain ground
articles.originalDescription: Saudi-backed forces retreat from Bab al-Mandab as Houthis gain ground Submitted by MEE staff on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 12:09 The Southern Armed Forces say the move is intended to reinforce Aden, while the Houthis claim they drove troops from positions overlooking the strategic waterway Supporters of Yemen’s Houthi authorities gather during a protest against Saudi intervention in Sanaa, 9 October 2026 (Mohammed Huwais/AFP) Off Saudi-backed forces in Yemen have withdrawn from positions overlooking the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait, leaving the Houthis with greater leverage over the southern entrance to the Red Sea after weeks of fighting. The Southern Armed Forces, who are backed by Saudi Arabia and fighting alongside the internationally recognised Yemeni government, said on Sunday they had "redeployed" troops from Dhubab airport and surrounding regions of Bab al-Mandab to strengthen defences around the interim capital Aden. “This step is taken based on the priority of securing the capital, Aden, and the neighbouring governorates, as well as strengthening the front lines and addressing existing threats,” the group said in a statement. The Houthis, officially known as Ansar Allah, offered a different account. A military source quoted by the Houthi-run Saba news agency said that they had forced Saudi-backed forces out of positions around Dhubab and Bab al-Mandab after severing their rear supply routes, forcing them to move towards Aden. The Houthi-run outlet also reported that the group's forces had carried out a flanking operation across more than 60km of the mountainous regions of Taiz and Lahij, forcing enemy troops to retreat from positions around Dhubab airport, the outskirts of Kahbub and areas around Bab al-Mandab. The latest developments give the Houthis more leverage over how Bab al-Mandab, one of the most critical points of waterway traffic in the world, is controlled. articles.title: Bus angkutan umum Saudi mengangkut lebih dari 25,5 juta penumpang di Q3 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - Otoritas Umum Transportasi (TGA) mengumumkan bahwa transportasi umum bus di kota-kota di Arab Saudi membawa lebih dari 25,5 juta penumpang di kuartal ketiga 2026, peningkatan 3.6 persen dibandingkan dengan periode yang sama pada tahun 2025. Hal ini mencerminkan peningkatan ketergantungan pada transportasi umum dan tingkat penggunaan yang lebih tinggi di seluruh kota-kota Kerajaan. Riyadh topped daftar kota dengan jumlah tertinggi penumpang bus publik, merekam lebih dari 19.29 juta, diikuti dengan lebih dari 2.89 juta dan Jeddah dengan lebih dari 1.19 juta. Nomor penumpang di daerah Metropolitan Dammam dan pemerintah Qatif melebihi 789.000, sedangkan Madinah merekam lebih dari 568.000. Angka-angka ini mencerminkan upaya TGA untuk memperluas layanan transportasi publik di dalam kota-kota dan menyediakan pilihan transportasi yang efisien dan berkelanjutan yang meningkatkan mobilitas, sejalan dengan tujuan Transportasi Nasional dan Strategi Logistik.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi public transport buses carry over 25.5 million passengers in Q3 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Transport General Authority (TGA) announced that public transport buses in cities across Saudi Arabia carried more than 25.5 million passengers in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 3.6 percent compared with the same period in 2025. This reflects growing reliance on public transport and higher usage rates across the Kingdom's cities. Riyadh topped the list of cities with the highest number of public bus passengers, recording more than 19.29 million, followed by Makkah with more than 2.89 million and Jeddah with more than 1.19 million. Passenger numbers in the Dammam Metropolitan Area and Qatif governorate exceeded 789,000, while Madinah recorded more than 568,000. These figures reflect TGA's efforts to expand public transport services within cities and provide efficient, sustainable transport options that improve mobility, in line with the objectives of the National Transport and Logistics Strategy.

articles.originalDescription: Home Office pressured council to cancel event featuring pro-Palestine activist, disclosures suggest Submitted by Katherine Hearst on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 12:35 Home Office warned Hackney officials that Tribune event could breach counter-terror laws despite an initial assessment finding Andreas Malm was 'unlikely to meet the threshold for disruption' Andreas Malm attends the "How To Blow Up A Pipeline" premiere during the 2022 Toronto International Film Festival on 10 September 2022 in Toronto, Ontario (Jeremy Chan/Getty Images/AFP ) Off The UK Home Office pushed Hackney Council to cancel an event featuring Swedish climate scholar Andreas Malm and Palestine Action co-founder Huda Ammori, despite the Home Office's own assessment which found the event "did not meet the threshold for disruption," disclosures suggest. In October, Malm was barred from entering the UK by the Home Office, and instead was set to appear by video link at the event for the magazine Tribune on 4 November at a venue owned by Hackney Council. The event coincided with a legal challenge against the UK government’s controversial ban against Palestine Action which Ammori is fighting in the Supreme Court. Freedom of Information and Subject Access Request documents released to Tribune appear to show that in the run-up to the event, the Home Office tried to pressure Hackney Council officials into cancelling it by warning them that it could breach the Terrorism Act 2000 due to Ammori’s participation. The disclosures reveal that an initial Home Office assessment found that the event was “unlikely to meet the threshold for disruption”. Despite this, the Home Office contacted the Prevent and Hate Crime coordinator of Hackney Council, warning them that the event would feature “two speakers of concern” and sharing with them an intelligence summary used to bar Malm from entering the UK, which described him “legitimis[ing] and encoura[ing] attacks on energy infrastructure and terrorism”. Rumah-rumah itu kosong pada saat itu, dan pemukim menghancurkan pintu mereka sebelum menempati properti, sumber keamanan mengatakan agen berita Wafa. articles.title: Arab Saudi meluncurkan kampanye nasional untuk mengembalikan keseimbangan lingkungan
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup, Air dan Pertanian, melalui Inisiatif Kesadaran Lingkungan, diluncurkan pada hari Senin Kampanye Keseimbangan Lingkungan 2026 di bawah slogan "Keseimbangan Kami". Kampanye ini berjalan selama 15 hari, dari Nov 15 sampai 29, dengan partisipasi dari berbagai lembaga dan pusat dalam sistem lingkungan, serta pemerintah, swasta, dan sektor nirlaba, dan anggota masyarakat dari semua daerah di Kingdom. Kampanye ini didasarkan pada visi nasional yang menekankan bahwa perlindungan lingkungan adalah tanggung jawab dari sistem yang saling berhubungan, di mana peran dari pelayanan dan pusat-pusat spesialnya saling melengkapi. Upaya mereka bersatu untuk melindungi sumber daya alam dan mempertahankan keseimbangan sistem ekologi, penyatuan pesan kesadaran dan mencapai tujuan dari Saudi Vision 2030 dan Strategi Lingkungan Nasional dalam mempertahankan sumber daya alam dan mengurangi semua bentuk polusi. Kampanye ini mempromosikan praktek-praktek lingkungan yang bertanggung jawab dan perlindungan alam, alam, padang gurun, dan daerah pesisir, menyoroti interketergantungan dari unsur-unsur lingkungan melalui isu-isu kunci seperti memancing satwa liar dan berkelanjutan; perlindungan vegetasi dan pemulihan habitat; lingkungan laut, terumbu karang, dan penyu laut; dampak infrastruktur dan pelayanan lingkungan; limbah dan ekonomi lingkaran; cuaca dan pemantauan iklim; dan memungkinkan solusi dan pembiayaan lingkungan. Kementrian menyerukan semua lembaga pemerintah, lembaga pendidikan, sektor swasta dan organisasi nirlaba, dan masyarakat umum untuk terlibat dengan kampanye melalui platform digital dan inisiatif-ground. Hal ini didasarkan pada prinsip yang mempertahankan keseimbangan lingkungan adalah tanggung jawab bersama yang menyatukan individu, organisasi, dan bisnis dalam mendukung tujuan lingkungan dan memastikan keberlanjutan sumber daya alam Kerajaan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia launches nationwide campaign to restore environmental balance
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through the Environmental Awareness Initiative, launched on Monday the 2026 Environmental Balance Campaign under the slogan “Balance Connects Us.” The campaign runs for 15 days, from Nov. 15 to 29, with participation from various agencies and centers within the environmental system, as well as government, private, and nonprofit sectors, and members of the public from all regions of the Kingdom. The campaign is based on a national vision that emphasizes that environmental protection is the responsibility of an interconnected system, in which the roles of the ministry and its specialized centers complement one another. Their efforts are united to safeguard natural resources and maintain the balance of ecological systems, unifying awareness messages and achieving the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Environment Strategy in preserving natural resources and reducing all forms of pollution. The campaign promotes responsible environmental practices and the protection of natural, wilderness, and coastal areas, highlighting the interdependence of environmental elements through key issues such as wildlife and sustainable fishing; vegetation cover and habitat restoration; the marine environment, coral reefs, and sea turtles; infrastructure impact and environmental stewardship; waste and the circular economy; weather and climate monitoring; and enabling solutions and environmental financing. The ministry called on all government agencies, educational institutions, private-sector and nonprofit organizations, and the general public to engage with the campaign through digital platforms and on-the-ground initiatives. This is based on the principle that preserving environmental balance is a shared responsibility that unites individuals, organizations, and businesses in supporting environmental goals and ensuring the sustainability of the Kingdom’s natural resources.

articles.title: Britania definisi 'anti- Muslim permusuhan' melindungi negara, bukan mereka yang menjadi target
articles.description: Definisi Inggris dari 'anti- Muslim permusuhan' melindungi negara, bukan mereka yang sedang ditargetkan oleh Karsen Trull pada Thu, 11 / 12 / 2026 - 14: 09 Laporan baru dari Cage International menunjukkan bagaimana kebijakan Inggris meninggalkan mekanisme pusat postingan -9 / 11 Islammophobia tidak tersentuh - dan meminjamkan secara resmi menutupi definisi Inggris anti- permusuhan Muslim 'bukanlah upaya gagal untuk melindungi umat Islam. Ini adalah upaya sukses untuk melindungi negara' (Reuters) Off Tahun ini ditandai seperempat abad sejak awal "perang terhadap teror", dan pada saat itu, Inggris telah membangun salah satu yang paling luas countermisme sistem di dunia. Juga tahun ini, Inggris diproduksi - untuk pertama kalinya - definisi resmi dari apa yang disebut "anti- Muslim permusuhan". Akan lebih mudah untuk menganggap ini sebagai kisah yang terpisah, satu tentang keamanan dan lainnya tentang hubungan masyarakat - tapi laporan baru dari Cage International berpendapat bahwa mereka tidak. Definisi telah dibentuk begitu tepat di sekitar negara keamanan yang, membaca dekat, berfungsi kurang sebagai perlindungan bagi umat Islam daripada sebagai perlindungan bagi lembaga yang telah menghabiskan dua dekade memperlakukan mereka sebagai tersangka. Kuncinya, saat laporan ditetapkan, terletak pada satu kata yang berjalan melalui setiap bagian dari definisi: maksud. Permusuhan anti- Muslim, seperti pemerintah mendefinisikan itu, berarti sengaja terlibat dalam tindakan kriminal terhadap Muslim, atau stereotip mereka "dengan maksud mendorong kebencian". Ini berarti diskriminasi di mana perilaku "dimaksudkan untuk merugikan umat Muslim dalam kehidupan publik dan ekonomi". Diskriminasi jarang mengumumkan sendiri dengan cara ini. Unit Respon Islammophobia, sebuah badan amal yang menangani kasus diskriminasi, telah memperingatkan bahwa ambang batas tidak termasuk kasus yang dilihatnya: bias, hambatan institusi, dan perekrutan proses yang diam-diam menyaring pelamar dengan nama M
articles.originalTitle: Britain's definition of 'anti-Muslim hostility' protects the state, not those being targeted
articles.originalDescription: Britain's definition of 'anti-Muslim hostility' protects the state, not those being targeted Submitted by Karsen Trull on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 14:09 New report from Cage International shows how UK policy leaves the central mechanism of post-9/11 Islamophobia untouched - and lends it official cover Britain's definition of anti-Muslim hostility 'is not a failed attempt to protect Muslims. It is a successful attempt to protect the state' (Reuters) Off This year marked a quarter of a century since the beginning of the “war on terror”, and in that time, the British state has built one of the most extensive counter-extremism systems in the world. Also this year, Britain produced - for the first time - an official definition of what it calls “anti-Muslim hostility” . It would be easy to treat these as separate stories, one about security and the other about community relations - but a new report from Cage International argues that they are not. The definition has been shaped so precisely around the security state that, read closely, it functions less as a protection for Muslims than as a protection for the institutions that have spent two decades treating them as suspects. The key, as the report sets out, lies in a single word that runs through every part of the definition: intent. Anti-Muslim hostility, as the government defines it, means intentionally engaging in criminal acts against Muslims, or stereotyping them “with the intention of encouraging hatred.” It means discrimination where the conduct “is intended to disadvantage Muslims in public and economic life”. Discrimination rarely announces itself this way. The Islamophobia Response Unit, a charity that handles discrimination casework, has warned that the threshold excludes most of the cases it sees: bias, institutional barriers, and recruitment processes that quietly filter out applicants with Muslim names. articles.title: Saudi Arabia terpilih menjadi Dewan ITU untuk 2027- 2030
articles.description: DOHA - Arab Saudi telah terpilih untuk Dewan Internasional Telekomunikasi Uni (ITU) untuk 2027- 2030 istilah, bergabung dengan 47 negara lain pada dewan anggota 48, yang mendukung kegiatan serikat antara konferensi besar. Pemilu berlangsung selama Konferensi Plenipotentiary ITU (PP-26), saat ini sedang diadakan di Doha, Qatar, dengan dewan yang terdiri dari 48 negara terpilih dari negara-negara anggota serikat 194. Pemilihan ini mencerminkan berdiri internasional Kingdom dan kontribusi untuk mengembangkan komunikasi, sektor ruang dan teknologi, sambil memperkuat perannya dalam membentuk arah strategis ITU dan membangun konsensus pada prioritas internasional. Hal ini juga memperkuat upaya Arab Saudi untuk menjembatani kesenjangan digital, memperkuat konektivitas dan memperluas akses ke teknologi dan kecerdasan buatan, sementara memanfaatkan energi dan kemampuan komputasi untuk mendukung masa depan digital yang lebih inklusif. Menteri Komunikasi dan Teknologi Informasi dan Ketua Komunikasi, Space and Technology Commission (CST), Eng. Al- Swaha mengatakan pemilu Kingdom mencerminkan masyarakat internasional pengakuan dan kepercayaan diri dalam kepemimpinan dan kontribusi untuk mengembangkan komunikasi, sektor ruang dan teknologi dan memperkuat kemitraan internasional. Dia menekankan bahwa Arab Saudi mengukur nilai kemajuan teknologi dengan pengaruhnya pada kehidupan masyarakat dan bekerja dengan mitra internasional untuk memperluas akses ke teknologi dan membantu negara-negara mengembangkan kemampuan digital mereka. Gubernur CST Eng. "Arab Saudi memainkan peran penting dalam pekerjaan ITU dengan berkontribusi dalam pengembangan kebijakan dan strateginya, membangun konsensus di antara anggota negara dan pertukaran keahlian yang mendukung kemajuan komunikasi, sektor ruang dan teknologi", kata Al- Ohaly. Dia menambahkan bahwa Arab Saudi akan bekerja dengan rekannya selama jangka waktu mendatang untuk memperkuat infrastruktur digital, mengembangkan kemampuan dan mendukung

Abdullah Al-Swaha, congratulated Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman on the occasion. articles.description: RIYADH - Hukum Perlindungan Konsumen Arab Saudi yang baru memperkenalkan pelanggaran stricter, menaikkan denda maksimum ke SR8 juta dari langit-langit SR2 juta sebelumnya diatur di bawah Hukum Penipuan Anti- Komersial, menurut Departemen Perdagangan. Disetujui oleh Dewan Menteri pada 10 November 2026, Hukum Perlindungan Konsumen pertama di Kingdom menetapkan kerangka kerja yang terpadu mengatur hak konsumen dalam produk dan jasa. Ini menggantikan pendekatan sebelumnya dari mendistribusikan ketentuan perlindungan konsumen ke beberapa undang-undang, dengan lebih dari 20 entitas pemerintah yang terlibat dalam implementasi tersebut. Ini memungkinkan periklanan komparatif dalam kondisi yang membutuhkan akurasi dan melarang praktek menyesatkan atau merugikan pesaing, sementara melarang ulasan palsu, memanipulasi peringkat dan praktek komersial penipuan lainnya. ketentuan khusus melindungi anak-anak, dewasa dan orang-orang dengan cacat, termasuk pembatasan pada iklan ditujukan pada anak-anak yang bisa membahayakan hidup mereka atau keselamatan. Undang-undang juga memungkinkan asosiasi konsumen untuk mengajukan tuntutan hukum atas nama konsumen dan memperkenalkan alternatif yang lebih cepat untuk menyelesaikan perselisihan di luar pengadilan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s new Consumer Protection Law raises maximum fines to SR8 million
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s new Consumer Protection Law introduces stricter penalties for violations, raising maximum fines to SR8 million from the SR2 million ceiling previously set under the Anti-Commercial Fraud Law, according to the Ministry of Commerce. Approved by the Council of Ministers on November 10, 2026, the Kingdom’s first comprehensive Consumer Protection Law establishes a unified framework governing consumer rights in products and services. It replaces the previous approach of distributing consumer protection provisions across several laws, with more than 20 government entities involved in its implementation. The law also strengthens consumer protections in service transactions and introduces measures against unjustified price increases during crises and pandemics, including the possibility of setting prices and imposing maximum profit margins. It permits comparative advertising under conditions requiring accuracy and prohibiting misleading practices or harm to competitors, while banning fake reviews, manipulated ratings and other fraudulent commercial practices. Special provisions protect children, older adults and people with disabilities, including restrictions on advertisements directed at children that could harm their lives or safety. The legislation also allows consumer associations to file lawsuits on behalf of consumers and introduces faster alternatives for resolving disputes outside the courts.

articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s R&D spending rises 17% to SR34.51 billion in 2025
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s expenditure on research and development (R&D) rose 17 percent year-on-year to approximately SR34.51 billion in 2025, while employment in the sector increased by 20 percent to 67,691, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The authority’s Research and Development Statistics 2025 report also showed that the number of researchers increased by 19 percent compared with 2024, reaching 49,383. The business sector accounted for the largest share of R&D expenditure at 44.8 percent, equivalent to SR15.47 billion, followed by the government sector at 37.5 percent, or SR12.95 billion, and higher education at 17.7 percent, totaling SR6.10 billion. Meanwhile, the government sector provided the largest share of R&D funding at SR16.27 billion, representing 47.1 percent of the total, followed by the business sector at SR15.40 billion, or 44.6 percent, and higher education at SR2.84 billion, accounting for 8.2 percent. The report also revealed that large entities accounted for 97.9 percent of total R&D expenditure, amounting to SR33.79 billion, while micro, small and medium-sized entities contributed SR0.73 billion, representing 2.1 percent. **media[2795079]** R&D expenditure as a proportion of the Kingdom’s gross domestic product (GDP) reached 0.72 percent in 2025. In terms of employment, the higher education sector accounted for the largest share of R&D personnel at 65.7 percent, with 44,469 employees, followed by the business sector with 18,354 employees, or 27.1 percent, and the government sector with 4,868 employees, representing 7.2 percent. Higher education also accounted for 79.3 percent of all researchers, totaling 39,141, of whom 56.1 percent were male and 43.9 percent were female. articles.title: NCM mengeluarkan peringatan merah untuk hujan lebat di Mekah sebagai badai petir mengancam daerah Saudi lainnya
articles.description: JEDDAH - Pusat Nasional Meteorologi (NCM) telah mengeluarkan peringatan merah untuk hujan deras di Ibukota Suci pada hari Senin, sementara moderat untuk badai petir berat juga diperkirakan di seluruh daerah Jazan, Asir dan Al- Baha daerah. Peringatan merah untuk Mekah akan tetap berlaku dari 02: 00 sampai 09: 00, dengan hujan lebat diharapkan disertai dengan angin kuat, dekat- nol visibilitas, hujan es, banjir kilat dan petir. Dalam cuaca nasional cuaca cuaca, yang mengatakan moderat untuk badai petir berat mampu memicu banjir kilat diharapkan di seluruh bagian Jazan, Asir, Al- Baha dan Mekah daerah, disertai dengan hujan dan angin aktif. Kabut mungkin juga terbentuk di beberapa daerah yang terkena. Di Mekah, suhu diperkirakan berkisar dari 23 ° C sampai 35 ° C, dengan kelembaban mencapai 85 persen, sementara Al- Baha diharapkan untuk merekam suhu antara 12 ° C dan 20 ° C, dengan kelembaban mencapai 95 persen. Abha diperkirakan mengalami suhu berkisar dari 11 ° C sampai 21 ° C, dengan kelembaban mencapai 95 persen, sementara Jazan diharapkan untuk merekam suhu antara 26 ° C dan 33 ° C, dengan kelembaban mencapai 90 persen. Keempat lokasi diperkirakan akan mengalami badai besar dan angin kencang. Sementara itu, Riyadh diharapkan untuk mengalami kondisi berawan, dengan suhu berkisar dari 11 ° C sampai 25 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 70 persen. Jeddah diperkirakan mengalami kondisi berawan sebagian dan kabut, dengan suhu antara 25 ° C dan 34 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 90 persen. Dammam diharapkan untuk mengalami angin aktif, dengan suhu berkisar dari 15 ° C ke 26 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 65 persen. Ramalan lainnya termasuk beberapa kondisi berawan di Madinah, dengan suhu antara 20 ° C dan 32 ° C, dan berawan pada kondisi berawan di Tabuk, Buraydah, Hail dan Najran. Arar dan Sakaka diramalkan untuk mengalami kondisi awan, dengan suhu berkisar dari 12 ° C sampai 26 ° C dan 11 ° C sampai 25 ° C, hormat.
articles.originalTitle: NCM issues red alert for heavy rainfall in Makkah as thunderstorms threaten other Saudi regions
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) has issued a red alert for heavy rainfall in the Holy Capital on Monday, while moderate to heavy thunderstorms are also forecast across parts of Jazan, Asir and Al-Baha regions. The red alert for Makkah will remain in effect from 2 p.m. to 9 p.m., with heavy rainfall expected to be accompanied by strong winds, near-zero visibility, hail, flash floods and lightning. In its nationwide daily weather forecast, the NCM said moderate to heavy thunderstorms capable of triggering flash floods are expected across parts of Jazan, Asir, Al-Baha and Makkah regions, accompanied by hail and active winds. Fog may also form in some affected areas. In Makkah, temperatures are forecast to range from 23°C to 35°C, with humidity reaching 85 percent, while Al-Baha is expected to record temperatures between 12°C and 20°C, with humidity reaching 95 percent. Abha is forecast to experience temperatures ranging from 11°C to 21°C, with humidity reaching 95 percent, while Jazan is expected to record temperatures between 26°C and 33°C, with humidity reaching 90 percent. All four locations are forecast to experience moderate to heavy thunderstorms and active winds. Meanwhile, Riyadh is expected to experience cloudy conditions, with temperatures ranging from 11°C to 25°C and humidity reaching 70 percent. Jeddah is forecast to experience partly cloudy conditions and fog, with temperatures between 25°C and 34°C and humidity reaching 90 percent. Dammam is expected to experience active winds, with temperatures ranging from 15°C to 26°C and humidity reaching 65 percent. Other forecasts include partly cloudy conditions in Madinah, with temperatures between 20°C and 32°C, and cloudy to partly cloudy conditions in Tabuk, Buraydah, Hail and Najran. Arar and Sakaka are forecast to experience cloudy conditions, with temperatures ranging from 12°C to 26°C and 11°C to 25°C, respectively.

articles.title: Harga produsen Arab Saudi naik 6,6% pada bulan September, didorong oleh pertumbuhan manufaktur
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi Producer Price Index (PPI) naik 6,6 persen tahun -pada September 2026, didorong oleh peningkatan 7 persen dalam harga produksi, menurut Authority Umum untuk Statistik (GASTAT). Peningkatan juga didukung dengan kenaikan 3,4 persen harga untuk persediaan air, sewerage dan aktivitas pengelolaan limbah, bersama peningkatan listrik 2,2 persen, gas, uap dan harga penyediaan udara. Dalam produksi, mengenakan pakaian tercatat peningkatan harga tahunan tertinggi pada 12.3 persen, diikuti dengan bahan kimia dan produk kimia pada 12,2 persen dan logam dasar pada 9.5 persen. Harga untuk produk minyak halus naik 8.4 persen, sementara harga pangan meningkat 6.1 persen. Sebaliknya, harga untuk produk logam buatan, tanpa mesin dan peralatan, menurun 3 persen, sedangkan kegiatan ekonomi lainnya mencatat penurunan 3,7 persen. * * Media [2795063] * Secara bulanan, PPI meningkatkan 1,7 persen pada bulan September dibandingkan dengan Agustus 2026, didorong terutama oleh kenaikan 3.7 persen dalam harga pabrik minyak halus dan 2,9 persen peningkatan bahan kimia dan produk kimia. Harga produksi pangan juga naik 0,7 persen bulan, sementara aktivitas ekonomi lainnya meningkat 0,2 persen. Sementara itu, harga produksi tekstil menurun sebesar 4,3 persen, diikuti dengan penurunan 2,6 persen dari harga pembuatan peralatan listrik. Harga listrik, gas, uap, dan sektor pendingin udara tetap tidak berubah selama sebulan, sementara pasokan air, sewerage dan kegiatan pengelolaan limbah merekam peningkatan 0,1 persen. The Producer Price Index mengukur perubahan dalam harga produsen domestik di seluruh manufaktur, listrik, gas, uap dan penyediaan udara, dan pasokan air, sewerage dan sampah kegiatan manajemen.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s producer prices rise 6.6% in September, driven by manufacturing growth
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s Producer Price Index (PPI) rose 6.6 percent year-on-year in September 2026, driven by a 7 percent increase in manufacturing prices, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The increase was also supported by a 3.4 percent rise in prices for water supply, sewerage and waste management activities, alongside a 2.2 percent increase in electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply prices. Within manufacturing, wearing apparel recorded the highest annual price increase at 12.3 percent, followed by chemicals and chemical products at 12.2 percent and basic metals at 9.5 percent. Prices for refined petroleum products rose 8.4 percent, while food manufacturing prices increased 6.1 percent. In contrast, prices for fabricated metal products, excluding machinery and equipment, declined by 3 percent, while other economic activities recorded a 3.7 percent decrease. **media[2795063]** On a monthly basis, the PPI increased by 1.7 percent in September compared with August 2026, driven primarily by a 3.7 percent rise in refined petroleum product manufacturing prices and a 2.9 percent increase in chemicals and chemical products. Food manufacturing prices also rose 0.7 percent month-on-month, while other economic activities increased by 0.2 percent. Meanwhile, textile manufacturing prices declined by 4.3 percent, followed by a 2.6 percent decrease in electrical equipment manufacturing prices. Prices in the electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply sector remained unchanged during the month, while water supply, sewerage and waste management activities recorded a 0.1 percent increase. The Producer Price Index measures changes in domestic producer prices across manufacturing, electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply, and water supply, sewerage and waste management activities.

articles.title: Rumah sakit Yaman menghadapi risiko shutdown karena sege di Taiz
articles.description: Rumah sakit Yaman menghadapi risiko mati karena menyegel di Taiz Sebuah rumah sakit di kota Yaman Taiz telah terdengar alarm atas obat dan kekurangan bahan bakar, peringatan bahwa menghadapi risiko shutdown jika akses ke bantuan dan persediaan tidak dipulihkan. "Selama dua bulan kami telah menelepon dan menarik bagi masyarakat internasional, organisasi kemanusiaan: menyelamatkan Taiz, menyelamatkan kesehatan di Taiz, menyelamatkan rumah sakit Yaman-Swedia. Tidak ada bahan bakar. Kami berada di napas terakhir kami", kata direktur rumah sakit Sami Al- Sharabi. Houthis telah mengepung Taiz selama lebih dari sebulan karena mereka mencoba untuk masuk ke wilayah yang diselenggarakan oleh Saudi - didukung pasukan pemerintah Yaman. Sejak pertempuran dinyalakan kembali di musim panas, hampir 330.000 orang telah dipindahkan. "Selamatkan Taiz, simpan kesehatan di Taiz, selamatkan rumah sakit Yaman-Swedia. Tidak ada bahan bakar. Kami berada di napas terakhir kami." Sebuah rumah sakit di kota Yaman Taiz telah terdengar alarm atas obat dan kekurangan bahan bakar disebabkan oleh pengepungan oleh Houthis yang telah berlangsung selama lebih dari sebulan. https: / / t.co / vUoimztr5h - Middle East Eye (@ MiddleEastEye) November 15, 2026
articles.originalTitle: Yemen hospital faces shutdown risk due to sege on Taiz
articles.originalDescription: Yemen hospital faces shutdown risk due to sege on Taiz A hospital in the Yemeni city of Taiz has sounded the alarm over medicine and fuel shortages, warning that it is facing the risk of a shutdown if access to aid and supplies is not restored. "For two months we have been calling and appealing to the international community, the humanitarian organisations: save Taiz, save health in Taiz, save the Yemeni-Swedish hospital. There is no fuel. We are at our last breath," said the hospital director Sami Al-Sharabi. The Houthis have besieged Taiz for more than a month as they try to break into territory held by the Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces. Since fighting reignited in the summer, nearly 330,000 people have been displaced. "Save Taiz, save health in Taiz, save the Yemeni-Swedish hospital. There is no fuel. We are at our last breath." A hospital in the Yemeni city of Taiz has sounded the alarm over medicine and fuel shortages caused by a siege by the Houthis that has lasted for more than a month. https://t.co/vUoimztr5h — Middle East Eye (@MiddleEastEye) November 15, 2026

articles.title: Raja Salman memerintahkan promosi dan janji 167 hakim di Departemen Kehakiman
articles.description: RIYADH - Penjaga Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman telah mengeluarkan perintah kerajaan mempromosikan dan menunjuk 167 hakim di Departemen Kehakiman di berbagai peringkat. Menteri Kehakiman dan Presiden Bertindak Agung Dewan Judisial Walid Al- Samaani mengatakan bahwa perintah mencerminkan raja terus dukungan untuk sektor peradilan, bersama dengan follow- up dan dukungan Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman dan komitmen mereka untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan meningkatkan hasilnya. Dia mencatat bahwa promosi dan janji akan berkontribusi terhadap pengembangan sektor tersebut, meningkatkan kinerja peradilan, dan meningkatkan kualitas putusan, sejalan dengan kemajuan sistem peradilan yang sedang berlangsung. Al- Samaani menyatakan rasa terima kasihnya kepada kepemimpinan Kerajaan untuk dukungan sektor peradilan, berdoa untuk keberhasilan para juri dalam melaksanakan tugas mereka dan menegakkan keadilan.
articles.originalTitle: King Salman orders promotion and appointment of 167 judges at Justice Ministry
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman has issued a royal order promoting and appointing 167 judges at the Ministry of Justice across various ranks.Minister of Justice and Acting President of the Supreme Judicial Council Walid Al-Samaani said that the order reflects the King’s continued support for the judicial sector, along with the follow-up and backing of Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman and their commitment to raising its efficiency and improving its outcomes.He noted that the promotions and appointments will contribute to the development of the sector, enhance judicial performance, and improve the quality of rulings, in line with the ongoing advancement of the justice system. Al-Samaani expressed his gratitude to the Kingdom’s leadership for its support of the judicial sector, praying for the judges’ success in carrying out their duties and upholding justice.

articles.title: Houthis mengatakan mereka menembakkan rudal di bandara Riyadh dan distrik keuangan
articles.description: Houthis mengatakan mereka menembakkan rudal di bandara Riyadh dan distrik keuangan Houthis mengatakan mereka menembakkan dua rudal balistik di ibukota Saudi, menyebutkan distrik keuangan dan King Khalid International Airport. Juru bicara militer Houthi Yahya Saree mengatakan kelompok tersebut meluncurkan enam rudal balistik lebih pada pasukan Saudi di pemerintahan Lahj selatan, menargetkan perkemahan Qa 'wa dan posisi di dekatnya. Arab Saudi belum merespon. Al Jazeera melaporkan bahwa dua ledakan berbunyi di kota Yaman Aden.
articles.originalTitle: Houthis say they fired missiles at Riyadh airport and financial district
articles.originalDescription: Houthis say they fired missiles at Riyadh airport and financial district The Houthis say they fired two ballistic missiles at targets in the Saudi capital, naming the financial district and King Khalid International Airport. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said the group launched six more ballistic missiles at Saudi troops in Yemen’s southern Lahj governorate, targeting Qa’wa camp and nearby positions. Saudi Arabia has yet to respond. Al Jazeera reports that two explosions rang out in the Yemeni city of Aden.

Writing on Telegram, Saree said the group directs its operations exclusively at oil installations and military bases in Saudi Arabia.
